import { Hono } from "hono";
import type { Container } from "../../composition.ts";
import type { ApiError, SetPocketSmithKeyRequest, SetPocketSmithKeyResponse, SettingsResponse } from "../contract.ts";
import { resolveSession, UNAUTHENTICATED } from "../http.ts";

export function registerSettings(api: Hono, container: Container): void {
  api.get("/settings", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const key = await container.secrets.get(session.userId, "pocketsmith_developer_key");
    const lastSyncAt = await container.store.getLastSyncAt(session.userId);
    const res: SettingsResponse = {
      deployMode: container.config.deployMode,
      hasPocketSmithKey: key !== null,
      lastSyncAt,
    };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  api.post("/settings/pocketsmith-key", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const req = (await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Partial<SetPocketSmithKeyRequest>;
    if (typeof req.developerKey !== "string" || req.developerKey.trim().length === 0) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Missing developer key.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    // Stored as per-user secret material; never logged, never echoed (ISC-56).
    await container.secrets.set(session.userId, "pocketsmith_developer_key", req.developerKey);
    const res: SetPocketSmithKeyResponse = { ok: true };
    return c.json(res);
  });
}

 * envelope matches the entered NAB statement balance as at the statement date,
 * and reports the drift (the named euphoric tripwire). Scoped to the user.

import { Hono } from "hono";
import type { Container } from "../../composition.ts";
import type { Services } from "../services.ts";
import type {
  ApiError,
  LastReconcileResponse,
  NetPositionResponse,
  ReconcileBalanceLine,
  ReconcileBalancesResponse,
  ReconcileConfirmation,
  ReconcileConfirmRequest,
  ReconcileConfirmResponse,
  ReconcileRequest,
  ReconcileResponse,
} from "../contract.ts";
import type { ReconciliationRecord } from "../../budget/ports.ts";
import { currentPeriod, resolveSession, UNAUTHENTICATED } from "../http.ts";
import { PocketSmithClient } from "../../ingest/client.ts";
import { buildBalanceLines, type ReconcileAccount } from "../../reconcile/balances.ts";

export function registerReconcile(api: Hono, container: Container, services: Services): void {
  api.post("/reconcile", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const req = (await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as ReconcileRequest;
    const asOf = req.statementDate;
    const holdingCents = await services.envelopes.holdingBalance(
      session.userId,
      asOf || undefined,
    );
    const nabStatementCents = req.nabStatementCents ?? 0;
    const driftCents = holdingCents - nabStatementCents;
    const res: ReconcileResponse = {
      holdingCents,
      nabStatementCents,
      driftCents,
      matched: driftCents === 0,
    };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  /**
   * Persist a reconciliation confirmation (Phase 4, ISC-37). The holding balance
   * and drift are recomputed server-side from the engine — the client-sent NAB
   * figure is the only input trusted — so a recorded confirmation reflects the
   * system's own numbers, never a fabricated or client-forged figure (ISC-83).
   */
  const toRecordResponse = (rec: ReconciliationRecord): ReconcileConfirmation => ({
    id: rec.id,
    confirmedAt: rec.ts,
    statementDate: rec.statementDate,
    holdingCents: rec.holdingCents,
    nabStatementCents: rec.nabStatementCents,
    driftCents: rec.driftCents,
    matched: rec.matched,
  });

  api.post("/reconcile/confirm", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const req = (await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Partial<ReconcileConfirmRequest>;
    if (typeof req.nabStatementCents !== "number" || typeof req.statementDate !== "string") {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "nabStatementCents and statementDate are required.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    const holdingCents = await services.envelopes.holdingBalance(
      session.userId,
      req.statementDate || undefined,
    );
    const driftCents = holdingCents - req.nabStatementCents;
    const rec: ReconciliationRecord = {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      ts: Date.now(),
      statementDate: req.statementDate,
      holdingCents,
      nabStatementCents: req.nabStatementCents,
      driftCents,
      matched: driftCents === 0,
    };
    await container.store.appendReconciliation(session.userId, rec);
    const res: ReconcileConfirmResponse = { ok: true, confirmation: toRecordResponse(rec) };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  api.get("/reconcile/last", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const latest = await container.store.getLatestReconciliation(session.userId);
    const res: LastReconcileResponse = { confirmation: latest ? toRecordResponse(latest) : null };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  /**
   * Penny vs PocketSmith balance reconciliation (P0 trust surface). Pulls the
   * tenant's PocketSmith account balances live and compares each to Penny's
   * computed per-account figure, anchored on the Credit Card Holding vs card
   * tripwire (ISC-37, ISC-43) and generalised across every tracked account. On
   * any failure (no key, network/auth) it returns ok:false with a key-free reason
   * so the screen degrades to a clear "could not reach PocketSmith" state rather
   * than erroring. The developer key is resolved through the SecretStore inside

   */

    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);

    const fail = (message: string): ReconcileBalancesResponse => ({
      ok: false,
      lines: [],
      cardDriftCents: 0,
      asOf: Date.now(),
      message,
    });

    try {
      const client = await PocketSmithClient.forUser(container.secrets, session.userId);
      const user = await client.getAuthenticatedUser();
      if (user.id === undefined || user.id === null) {
        return c.json(fail("PocketSmith did not return an account id."));
      }
      const [accounts, txs] = await Promise.all([
        client.listTransactionAccounts(user.id),
        container.store.listTransactions(session.userId),
      ]);
      const accIn: ReconcileAccount[] = accounts.map((a) => ({
        id: String(a.id),
        title: a.name ?? `Account ${a.id}`,
        type: a.type ?? "",
        currentBalance: a.current_balance,
      }));
      const lines: ReconcileBalanceLine[] = buildBalanceLines(
        accIn,
        txs.map((t) => ({ accountId: t.accountId, amountCents: t.amountCents, isPending: t.isPending })),
        services.engineConfig.nabCardAccountIds,
      );
      const cardDriftCents = lines
        .filter((l) => l.kind === "card")
        .reduce((s, l) => s + l.driftCents, 0);
      const res: ReconcileBalancesResponse = { ok: true, lines, cardDriftCents, asOf: Date.now() };
      return c.json(res);
    } catch {
      // Never surface the underlying error verbatim: it could narrow the key.
      return c.json(fail("Could not reach PocketSmith. Check the developer key in Settings."));
    }
  });

  /**
   * Net-position master reconciliation (the whole point of envelope budgeting).
   * Pulls the tenant's live PocketSmith account balances and reconciles the real
   * liquid position (cash on hand minus what is owed on credit cards) against the
   * budget's total "left" (sum of leaf-envelope leftCents plus income leftCents).
   *
   * Account classification mirrors the balances surface but is coarser by design:
   * any account whose type contains "credit" is a card (its balance is negative,
   * so we report the owed amount as a positive magnitude); everything else
   * (bank, cash) is cash on hand. Only LEAF envelopes are summed so the rolled-up
   * parent rows are not double-counted.
   *
   * On any PocketSmith failure it returns ok:false with a key-free reason (ISC-56),
   * mirroring the balances handler, so the widget degrades cleanly.
   */
  api.get("/net-position", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);

    const fail = (message: string): NetPositionResponse => ({
      ok: false,
      cashOnHandCents: 0,
      cardOwedCents: 0,
      totalLeftCents: 0,
      sectionLeftCents: { income: 0, saving: 0, expense: 0, envelope: 0, working: 0 },
      reconciledDeltaCents: 0,
      asOf: Date.now(),
      message,
    });

    // Decimal-dollar PocketSmith balance to integer cents, rounding float dust.
    const toCents = (amount: number | undefined | null): number =>
      amount === undefined || amount === null || Number.isNaN(amount) ? 0 : Math.round(amount * 100);

    try {
      const client = await PocketSmithClient.forUser(container.secrets, session.userId);
      const user = await client.getAuthenticatedUser();
      if (user.id === undefined || user.id === null) {
        return c.json(fail("PocketSmith did not return an account id."));
      }
      const accounts = await client.listTransactionAccounts(user.id);

      let cashOnHandCents = 0;
      let cardBalanceCents = 0; // signed; cards report a negative balance.
      for (const a of accounts) {
        const isCard = (a.type ?? "").toLowerCase().includes("credit");
        const cents = toCents(a.current_balance);
        if (isCard) cardBalanceCents += cents;
        else cashOnHandCents += cents;
      }
      // Card balances are negative; owed is the magnitude reported positive.
      const cardOwedCents = Math.abs(cardBalanceCents);

      // Total "left": sum of LEAF expense/saving/envelope rows (a leaf is a row no
      // other row names as its parentId) plus the income envelopes' contribution.
      const grid = await services.envelopes.getGrid(session.userId, currentPeriod());
      const parentIds = new Set(
        grid.rows.map((r) => r.parentId).filter((p): p is string => p !== null),
      );
      // Working envelopes sit outside the ZERO-BASE budget but still move real cash,
      // so they ARE part of the net-position reconciliation as their own section line
      // (their balance begins at 0 today and accrues forward).
      const leaves = grid.rows.filter((r) => !parentIds.has(r.id));
      const leafLeftCents = leaves.reduce((s, r) => s + r.leftCents, 0);
      // Income contributes carryover + surplus/deficit (variance), NOT carryover +
      // received. The budgeted income is already represented in the expense envelopes'
      // allocations (zero-base), so including the full received here would double-count
      // the budget. carry + (received - budget) makes the budgets cancel and the sum
      // reconcile to cash - card. The income row's own "left" stays carry + received.
      const incomeLeftCents = grid.income.reduce((s, i) => s + i.carryoverCents + i.varianceCents, 0);
      const totalLeftCents = leafLeftCents + incomeLeftCents;

      // Per-section "left": income from the income envelopes, and each spending
      // type from its leaf rows, so the four figures sum to totalLeftCents.
      const leftByType = (type: string): number =>
        leaves.filter((r) => r.type === type).reduce((s, r) => s + r.leftCents, 0);
      const sectionLeftCents = {
        income: incomeLeftCents,
        saving: leftByType("saving"),
        expense: leftByType("expense"),
        envelope: leftByType("envelope"),
        working: leftByType("working"),
      };

      const reconciledDeltaCents = cashOnHandCents - cardOwedCents - totalLeftCents;
      const res: NetPositionResponse = {
        ok: true,
        cashOnHandCents,
        cardOwedCents,
        totalLeftCents,
        sectionLeftCents,
        reconciledDeltaCents,
        asOf: Date.now(),
      };
      return c.json(res);
    } catch {
      // Never surface the underlying error verbatim: it could narrow the key.
      return c.json(fail("Could not reach PocketSmith. Check the developer key in Settings."));
    }
  });

 * Service composition for the route layer. Builds the envelope engine, the
 * budget engine, and the Pulse source from the container's resolved store, and
 * resolves the engine wiring constants (Holding envelope id, NAB card accounts)
 * from configuration.
 *
 * The engine config is read from environment here, NOT from DEPLOY_MODE — these
 * are per-deployment data ids, not deployment-mode behaviour, so reading them
 * outside the composition root does not violate ISC-51. The store is already
 * typed BudgetStore on the container, so the engines are constructed without an
 * unsafe cast.
 */

import type { Container } from "../composition.ts";
import type { EngineConfig } from "../envelope/ports.ts";
import { EnvelopeService } from "../envelope/service.ts";
import { BudgetService } from "../budget/service.ts";
import { StorePulseSource } from "../pulse/source.ts";

export interface Services {
  readonly envelopes: EnvelopeService;
  readonly budget: BudgetService;
  readonly pulse: StorePulseSource;
  readonly engineConfig: EngineConfig;
}

/** Resolve the engine wiring constants from env, with local-sensible defaults. */
export function resolveEngineConfig(
  env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env,
): EngineConfig {
  const nab = (env.PENNY_NAB_ACCOUNT_IDS ?? env.PENNY_NAB_ACCOUNT_ID ?? "acc-nab")
    .split(",")
    .map((s) => s.trim())
    .filter((s) => s.length > 0);
  const holding = env.PENNY_HOLDING_ENVELOPE_ID?.trim();
  return {
    holdingEnvelopeId: holding && holding.length > 0 ? holding : null,
    nabCardAccountIds: nab,
  };
}

/** Construct the per-request-stateless services once from the container. */
export function buildServices(container: Container): Services {
  const engineConfig = resolveEngineConfig();
  const envelopes = new EnvelopeService(container.store, engineConfig);
  const budget = new BudgetService(container.store, envelopes);

  const sourceOpts: { nabAccountId?: string; holdingMatch?: string } = {};
  const nab = process.env.PENNY_NAB_ACCOUNT_ID?.trim();
  const holdingMatch = process.env.PENNY_HOLDING_MATCH?.trim();
  if (nab) sourceOpts.nabAccountId = nab;
  if (holdingMatch) sourceOpts.holdingMatch = holdingMatch;
  const pulse = new StorePulseSource(container.store, sourceOpts);

  return { envelopes, budget, pulse, engineConfig };
}

 *     test to prove a value is absent.

const REDACTED = "[REDACTED]";

/** Escape a string for safe use inside a RegExp. */
function escapeRegExp(s: string): string {
  return s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
}

/**
 * Mask every non-trivial secret value found in `text`. Secrets shorter than 8
 * chars are ignored to avoid masking incidental substrings; real PocketSmith
 * developer keys are long opaque tokens.
 */
export function redact(text: string, secrets: readonly (string | null | undefined)[]): string {
  let out = text;
  for (const secret of secrets) {
    if (!secret || secret.length < 8) continue;
    out = out.replace(new RegExp(escapeRegExp(secret), "g"), REDACTED);
  }
  return out;
}

/** True if `secret` appears verbatim in `text`. Used by the hygiene assertions. */
export function containsPlaintext(text: string, secret: string): boolean {
  if (!secret) return false;
  return text.includes(secret);
}

/**

 * currently-registered secret before it is written. `getSecrets` is called per
 * log so freshly-loaded keys are covered. Returns a disposer restoring the
 * original methods.
 */
export function installLogRedaction(getSecrets: () => readonly (string | null | undefined)[]): () => void {
  const methods = ["log", "info", "warn", "error", "debug"] as const;
  const originals = new Map<(typeof methods)[number], (...args: unknown[]) => void>();

  for (const m of methods) {
    const original = console[m].bind(console) as (...args: unknown[]) => void;
    originals.set(m, original);
    console[m] = ((...args: unknown[]) => {
      const secrets = getSecrets();
      const scrubbed = args.map((a) =>
        typeof a === "string" ? redact(a, secrets) : redactDeep(a, secrets),
      );
      original(...scrubbed);
    }) as typeof console.log;
  }

  return () => {
    for (const m of methods) {
      const original = originals.get(m);
      if (original) console[m] = original as typeof console.log;
    }
  };

/** Best-effort redaction of non-string log arguments via JSON round-trip. */
function redactDeep(value: unknown, secrets: readonly (string | null | undefined)[]): unknown {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return value;
  if (typeof value === "object") {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(redact(JSON.stringify(value), secrets));
    } catch {

    }
  }

import { loadConfig, type AppConfig } from "./platform/config.ts";
import type { AuthProvider } from "./platform/auth.ts";
import type { SecretStore } from "./platform/secrets.ts";
import type { BudgetStore } from "./budget/ports.ts";

export interface Container {
  readonly config: AppConfig;
  /**
   * The persistence adapter, typed at the richest business surface (BudgetStore =
   * Store + the envelope and budget extras). Both concrete adapters implement it,
   * so handlers can construct the engines without an unsafe cast. The composition
   * root is the only place that decides which concrete adapter backs it.
   */
  readonly store: BudgetStore;
  readonly secrets: SecretStore;
  readonly auth: AuthProvider;
}

export async function buildContainer(): Promise<Container> {
  const config = loadConfig();

  // --- Store adapter ---
  const store: BudgetStore =
    config.deployMode === "cloud"
      ? new (await import("./store/postgres.ts")).PostgresStore(config.postgresUrl!)
      : new (await import("./store/sqlite.ts")).SqliteStore(config.sqlitePath);
  await store.migrate();

  // --- SecretStore adapter ---
  const secrets: SecretStore =
    config.deployMode === "cloud"
      ? new (await import("./platform/secrets/cloud.ts")).KmsSecretStore(store)
      : new (await import("./platform/secrets/local.ts")).LocalSecretStore();

  // --- AuthProvider adapter ---
  const auth: AuthProvider =
    config.deployMode === "cloud"
      ? new (await import("./platform/auth/cloud.ts")).MagicLinkAuth(store, secrets)
      : new (await import("./platform/auth/local.ts")).TailscalePinAuth(secrets);

  return { config, store, secrets, auth };
}

import type { UserId } from "./auth.ts";

/** Named secrets a tenant can hold. Extend as needed; PocketSmith dev key is the first. */
export type SecretName = "pocketsmith_developer_key" | "auth_pin";

export interface SecretStore {
  /** Fetch a secret for a tenant. Returns null if unset. Never logs the value. */
  get(userId: UserId, name: SecretName): Promise<string | null>;

  /** Store/replace a secret for a tenant. Local: keychain/encrypted file. Cloud: KMS-encrypt then persist ciphertext. */
  set(userId: UserId, name: SecretName, value: string): Promise<void>;

  /** Remove a secret for a tenant (offboarding). */
  delete(userId: UserId, name: SecretName): Promise<void>;
}

/** Convenience: resolve the PocketSmith X-Developer-Key for a tenant, or throw if missing. */
export async function requirePocketSmithKey(store: SecretStore, userId: UserId): Promise<string> {
  const key = await store.get(userId, "pocketsmith_developer_key");
  if (!key) throw new Error(`No PocketSmith developer key configured for user ${userId}`);
  return key;
}

 * Secret hygiene tests (ISC-56): a PocketSmith developer key never appears as
 * plaintext at rest, in env files, in git, or in logs.
 *
 *   Behaviour : the redactor scrubs a key from log output; the LocalSecretStore
 *               writes ciphertext, never the plaintext key, to disk.
 *   Static    : a repo grep proves no high-entropy secret literal is committed
 *               in source, and no committed .env carries a developer key.
 */

import { describe, test, expect, afterAll } from "bun:test";
import { Glob } from "bun";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { rm } from "node:fs/promises";
import { redact, containsPlaintext, installLogRedaction } from "../src/security/redact.ts";
import { LocalSecretStore } from "../src/platform/secrets/local.ts";

const REPO_ROOT = join(import.meta.dir, "..");
const SAMPLE_KEY = "ps_dev_9f3a7b21c4e84d0fa6b15e2c8d7049ab"; // a fake, key-shaped token

describe("redactor (ISC-56)", () => {
  test("masks a key wherever it appears in a string", () => {
    const line = `GET /v2/me X-Developer-Key: ${SAMPLE_KEY} done`;
    const safe = redact(line, [SAMPLE_KEY]);
    expect(containsPlaintext(safe, SAMPLE_KEY)).toBe(false);
    expect(safe).toContain("[REDACTED]");
  });

  test("ignores trivially short secrets to avoid masking noise", () => {
    expect(redact("the value is abc", ["abc"])).toBe("the value is abc");
  });

  test("installLogRedaction scrubs console output", () => {
    const captured: string[] = [];
    const realLog = console.log;
    console.log = ((...args: unknown[]) => captured.push(args.join(" "))) as typeof console.log;
    const dispose = installLogRedaction(() => [SAMPLE_KEY]);
    try {
      console.log(`leaking key=${SAMPLE_KEY}`);
    } finally {
      dispose();
      console.log = realLog;
    }
    expect(captured.length).toBe(1);
    expect(containsPlaintext(captured[0] ?? "", SAMPLE_KEY)).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("LocalSecretStore writes ciphertext, never plaintext (ISC-56)", () => {
  const vault = join(tmpdir(), `penny-vault-${process.pid}.enc`);
  const keyFile = join(tmpdir(), `penny-vault-${process.pid}.key`);

  afterAll(async () => {
    await rm(vault, { force: true });
    await rm(keyFile, { force: true });
  });

  test("the key round-trips but is absent from the on-disk vault", async () => {
    const store = new LocalSecretStore(vault, keyFile);
    await store.set("nick", "pocketsmith_developer_key", SAMPLE_KEY);
    expect(await store.get("nick", "pocketsmith_developer_key")).toBe(SAMPLE_KEY);

    const onDisk = await Bun.file(vault).text();
    expect(containsPlaintext(onDisk, SAMPLE_KEY)).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("no committed secret material (ISC-56)", () => {
  test("no high-entropy secret literal on a key/secret line in src/scripts", async () => {
    // A leaked developer key looks like a quoted run of >= 32 token chars sitting
    // on a line that also names a secret. Requiring the secret context avoids
    // flagging legitimate high-entropy constants like the pinned OpenAPI git SHA.
    const tokenLiteral = /['"`][A-Za-z0-9+/_-]{32,}['"`]/;
    const secretContext = /\b(secret|developer.?key|api.?key|password|credential|token|x-developer-key)\b/i;
    const glob = new Glob("{src,scripts}/**/*.ts");
    const offenders: string[] = [];
    for await (const rel of glob.scan({ cwd: REPO_ROOT })) {
      const text = await Bun.file(join(REPO_ROOT, rel)).text();
      for (const line of text.split("\n")) {
        if (tokenLiteral.test(line) && secretContext.test(line)) {
          offenders.push(`${rel}: ${line.trim().slice(0, 80)}`);
        }
      }
    }
    expect(offenders).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("no committed .env file carries a developer key", async () => {
    const glob = new Glob("**/.env*");
    const offenders: string[] = [];
    for await (const rel of glob.scan({ cwd: REPO_ROOT, dot: true })) {
      if (rel.includes("node_modules")) continue;
      const text = await Bun.file(join(REPO_ROOT, rel)).text();
      if (/developer.?key/i.test(text)) offenders.push(rel);
    }
    expect(offenders).toEqual([]);
  });
});

    this.m.set(`${userId}:${name}`, value);

import { buildContainer } from "../src/composition.ts";
import { PocketSmithClient } from "../src/ingest/client.ts";

const userId = process.env.PENNY_USER_ID ?? "local";

}

export class EnvelopeService {
  constructor(
    private readonly store: EnvelopeStore,
    private readonly config: EngineConfig,
  ) {}

  private async event(
    userId: UserId,
    kind: string,
    payload: unknown,
    correlationId = uuid(),
  ): Promise<void> {
    await this.store.appendEvent(userId, {
      id: uuid(),
      ts: Date.now(),
      actor: "ui",
      correlationId,
      kind,
      payloadJson: JSON.stringify(payload),
    });
  }

  /** Create or replace an envelope, persisting the full tree row (ISC-18, ISC-73). */
  async upsertEnvelope(userId: UserId, input: EnvelopeInput): Promise<void> {
    await this.store.upsertEnvelope(userId, toStoreEnvelope(input));
    await this.event(userId, "envelope.upsert", input);
  }

  /**
   * Manually reset an envelope's carried starting balance to a chosen value, e.g.
   * to reconcile against the bank. Works for income and expense/saving/envelope
   * envelopes alike. The change is appended to the audit log as a traceable
   * "carryover.reset" event with the before/after values (ISC-15), and today
   * becomes the new rollover-start.
   */
  async resetCarryover(
    userId: UserId,
    envelopeId: string,
    newCarryoverCents: number,
  ): Promise<{ beforeCents: number; afterCents: number }> {
    const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const incomes = await this.store.listIncomeEnvelopes(userId);
    const isIncome = incomes.some((i) => i.id === envelopeId);
    let beforeCents = 0;
    if (isIncome) {
      const carrys = await this.store.listIncomeCarryover(userId);
      beforeCents = carrys.find((c) => c.incomeEnvelopeId === envelopeId)?.carryoverCents ?? 0;
      await this.store.setIncomeCarryover(userId, envelopeId, newCarryoverCents, today);
    } else {
      const carrys = await this.store.listEnvelopeCarryover(userId);
      beforeCents = carrys.find((c) => c.envelopeId === envelopeId)?.carryoverCents ?? 0;
      await this.store.setEnvelopeCarryover(userId, envelopeId, newCarryoverCents, today);
    }
    await this.event(userId, "carryover.reset", { envelopeId, beforeCents, afterCents: newCarryoverCents, on: today });
    return { beforeCents, afterCents: newCarryoverCents };
  }

  /**
   * Archive or unarchive an envelope (archive feature). Sets the flag and appends a
   * traceable "envelope.archive" event with the before/after, mirroring resetCarryover.
   * An archived envelope drops out of the grid entirely; unarchiving restores it.
   */
  async archiveEnvelope(
    userId: UserId,
    envelopeId: string,
    archived: boolean,
  ): Promise<{ before: boolean; after: boolean }> {
    const envelopes = await this.store.listEnvelopes(userId);
    const before = envelopes.find((e) => e.id === envelopeId)?.archived ?? false;
    await this.store.setEnvelopeArchived(userId, envelopeId, archived);
    await this.event(userId, "envelope.archive", { envelopeId, before, after: archived });
    return { before, after: archived };
  }

  /** The archived envelopes, for the budget page's "Show archived" list. */
  async listArchived(userId: UserId): Promise<ArchivedEnvelopeView[]> {
    const envelopes = await this.store.listEnvelopes(userId);
    return envelopes
      .filter((e) => e.archived === true)
      .map((e) => ({ id: e.id, name: e.name, type: e.type ?? "expense" }));
  }

  /** The Dave Ramsey grid for a single month, with rolled-up four figures (ISC-70). */

 * Change-PIN unit tests (Phase 4, ISC-52).
 *
 * Proves the change-PIN path reuses the exact sign-in verification (no weaker
 * scheme), rejects a wrong current PIN without mutating the stored PIN, accepts
 * a valid change, refuses a trivially weak new PIN, and is refused in cloud mode.
 */

import { describe, test, expect } from "bun:test";
import type { Store } from "../src/platform/store.ts";
import { TailscalePinAuth, LOCAL_USER_ID } from "../src/platform/auth/local.ts";
import { MagicLinkAuth } from "../src/platform/auth/cloud.ts";
import { HmacSessionCodec } from "../src/platform/auth/session.ts";
import { AuthError } from "../src/platform/auth.ts";
import { MemorySecretStore, FIXED_SESSION_KEY } from "./helpers.ts";

async function makeLocal() {
  const secrets = new MemorySecretStore();
  await secrets.set(LOCAL_USER_ID, "auth_pin", "8421");
  const auth = new TailscalePinAuth(secrets, new HmacSessionCodec(FIXED_SESSION_KEY));
  return { auth, secrets };
}

describe("TailscalePinAuth.changePin (local)", () => {
  test("a correct current PIN changes to the new PIN", async () => {
    const { auth, secrets } = await makeLocal();
    await auth.changePin("8421", "1357");
    // Stored PIN is the new one, verified through the same beginSignIn scheme.
    expect(await secrets.get(LOCAL_USER_ID, "auth_pin")).toBe("1357");
    const session = await auth.beginSignIn({ kind: "pin", pin: "1357" });
    expect(session?.userId).toBe(LOCAL_USER_ID);
    await expect(auth.beginSignIn({ kind: "pin", pin: "8421" })).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(AuthError);
  });

  test("a wrong current PIN is rejected and the stored PIN is unchanged", async () => {
    const { auth, secrets } = await makeLocal();
    await expect(auth.changePin("0000", "1357")).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(AuthError);
    // The stored PIN must NOT have changed.
    expect(await secrets.get(LOCAL_USER_ID, "auth_pin")).toBe("8421");
    const session = await auth.beginSignIn({ kind: "pin", pin: "8421" });
    expect(session?.userId).toBe(LOCAL_USER_ID);
  });

  test("a trivially weak new PIN is refused (cannot lower the bar)", async () => {
    const { auth, secrets } = await makeLocal();
    await expect(auth.changePin("8421", "12")).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(AuthError);
    await expect(auth.changePin("8421", "abcd")).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(AuthError);
    // Wrong-length/format new PIN leaves the current one in place.
    expect(await secrets.get(LOCAL_USER_ID, "auth_pin")).toBe("8421");
  });
});

describe("MagicLinkAuth.changePin (cloud)", () => {
  test("PIN change is refused in cloud (email) mode", async () => {
    const auth = new MagicLinkAuth({ ensureUser: async () => {} } as unknown as Store, new MemorySecretStore(), {
      codec: new HmacSessionCodec(FIXED_SESSION_KEY),
    });
    await expect(auth.changePin("8421", "1357")).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(AuthError);
  });
});

import { runSync } from "../src/ingest/sync.ts";
import { PocketSmithClient, type FetchFn, type PocketSmithTransaction } from "../src/ingest/client.ts";

function recordingClient(): PocketSmithClient {
  const fetchFn: FetchFn = async () => {

    expect(await store.getLastSyncAt(USER)).toBeNull();

    const result = await runSync({

      client: recordingClient(),

      pocketsmithUserId: 42,
      now: () => new Date("2026-06-26T05:30:00.000Z"),

    await store.close();
  });
});

 * PIN brute-force throttling (auth attempt tracking).
 *
 * The local PIN is short by nature, so unthrottled guessing would walk the
 * keyspace quickly. This tracker persists consecutive-failure counts per key
 * (e.g. "signin:pin", "change-pin:local") and, once a threshold is crossed,
 * imposes an exponential backoff window measured from the LAST failure:
 *
 *   failures < 5              → no delay
 *   failures ≥ 5              → min(2^(failures - 4), 900) seconds
 *                               (2s, 4s, 8s, … capped at 15 minutes)
 *
 * A success resets the key. State is a JSON file under the same ~/.penny data
 * dir the SecretStore uses, written 0600, so the throttle survives a restart —
 * an attacker cannot clear the window by bouncing the process. The clock is
 * injectable (`now`) so tests can cross the window without sleeping.
 *

import { mkdir, writeFile, chmod, readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { dirname } from "node:path";

/** The outcome of a pre-attempt check. */
export interface AttemptGate {
  /** True when the key is inside its backoff window; the attempt must be refused. */
  readonly blocked: boolean;
  /** Milliseconds until the window opens again (0 when not blocked). */
  readonly retryAfterMs: number;
}

export interface AttemptTracker {
  /** Check whether an attempt on `key` is currently allowed. */
  check(key: string): Promise<AttemptGate>;
  /** Record a failed attempt on `key` (extends/starts the backoff window). */
  recordFailure(key: string): Promise<void>;
  /** Record a successful attempt on `key` (clears the window entirely). */
  recordSuccess(key: string): Promise<void>;
}

interface AttemptState {
  failures: number;
  lastFailedAt: number;
}

const HOME = process.env.HOME ?? ".";
const DEFAULT_PATH = `${HOME}/.penny/auth-attempts.json`;

const DEFAULT_THRESHOLD = 5;
const CAP_MS = 15 * 60 * 1000;

export interface FileAttemptTrackerOptions {
  /** JSON state file. Defaults to ~/.penny/auth-attempts.json (written 0600). */
  readonly path?: string;
  /** Injectable clock for tests. Defaults to Date.now. */
  readonly now?: () => number;
  /** Consecutive failures before backoff engages. Defaults to 5. */
  readonly threshold?: number;
}

export class FileAttemptTracker implements AttemptTracker {
  private readonly path: string;
  private readonly now: () => number;
  private readonly threshold: number;

  constructor(options: FileAttemptTrackerOptions = {}) {

 * echoed back).
 */
export async function parseBody<S extends z.ZodTypeAny>(
  c: Context,
  schema: S,
): Promise<ParsedBody<z.infer<S>>> {
  const raw: unknown = await c.req.json().catch(() => undefined);
  const result = schema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!result.success) {
    const issue = result.error.issues[0];
    const at = issue && issue.path.length > 0 ? ` at ${issue.path.join(".")}` : "";

      error: `Invalid request body${at}: ${issue?.message ?? "malformed JSON"}.`,
      code: "bad_request",
    };

 * Route-layer HTTP helpers shared by every handler: authentication gating,
 * the current period, and the session cookie.
 *
 * Tenant scoping (ISC-49) starts here: every tenant route resolves the
 * authenticated userId from the AuthProvider session and refuses the request
 * with 401 when there is none. Handlers never read a user_id from the request
 * body — the session is the only source of identity.
 */

import type { Context } from "hono";
import type { Container } from "../composition.ts";
import type { Session } from "../platform/auth.ts";
import type { ApiError } from "./contract.ts";
import type { Period } from "../domain/types.ts";
import { SESSION_COOKIE } from "../platform/auth/session.ts";

/** The current calendar-month period in UTC. */
export function currentPeriod(now: Date = new Date()): Period {
  return { year: now.getUTCFullYear(), month: now.getUTCMonth() + 1 };
}

/** Uniform unauthenticated error body. */
export const UNAUTHENTICATED: ApiError = {
  error: "Not authenticated.",
  code: "unauthenticated",
};

/**
 * Resolve the authenticated session for a request, or null. Pure pass-through
 * to the active AuthProvider so the route layer never branches on local/cloud.
 */
export function resolveSession(c: Context, container: Container): Promise<Session | null> {
  return container.auth.resolveSession(c.req.raw);
}

const IDLE_MAX_AGE_S = 30 * 60;

/**
 * Build the Set-Cookie value for a freshly minted session token. httpOnly +
 * SameSite=Strict always; Secure only in cloud (so the loopback dev probe and
 * tailscale-fronted local HTTPS both work). 30-minute idle window (ISC-39).
 */
export function sessionCookie(token: string, secure: boolean): string {
  const attrs = [
    `${SESSION_COOKIE}=${token}`,
    "Path=/",
    "HttpOnly",
    "SameSite=Strict",
    `Max-Age=${IDLE_MAX_AGE_S}`,
  ];
  if (secure) attrs.push("Secure");
  return attrs.join("; ");
}

/** Build the Set-Cookie value that clears the session cookie on sign-out. */
export function clearCookie(): string {
  return `${SESSION_COOKIE}=; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=0`;
}

 * Envelope route handlers: the Dave Ramsey grid with four-figure rollups, the
 * time-travel as-of grid, per-envelope detail, and conserved move-money. Every
 * route is scoped to the authenticated user (ISC-49) and reads/writes through
 * the real envelope and budget engines. Every mutation body is validated with
 * zod at the boundary (see ../validate.ts) before it can reach the ledger.
 *
 * The grid first ensures the current month has its budget (auto-roll, ISC-29 /
 * ISC-76) so a freshly opened month is never blank without any manual step.
 */

import { Hono } from "hono";
import type { Context } from "hono";
import type { Container } from "../../composition.ts";
import type { Services } from "../services.ts";
import type { ApiError, MoveMoneyResponse, DistributeResponse, CreateEnvelopeResponse, SetCarryoverResponse, ArchiveEnvelopeResponse, ArchivedEnvelopesResponse, SetRolloverResponse, EditEnvelopeResponse, MovementsResponse, MovementView } from "../contract.ts";
import type { BudgetPeriod } from "../../domain/types.ts";
import { currentPeriod, resolveSession, UNAUTHENTICATED } from "../http.ts";
import { todayISO } from "../../platform/time.ts";
import { monthBounds, periodRange, resolveNamedPeriod, rangeFromDates, type NamedPeriod } from "../../envelope/period.ts";
import {
  parseBody,
  moveMoneySchema,
  distributeSchema,
  createEnvelopeSchema,
  editEnvelopeSchema,
  setCarryoverSchema,
  archiveEnvelopeSchema,
  setRolloverSchema,
} from "../validate.ts";

export function registerEnvelopes(api: Hono, container: Container, services: Services): void {
  const tz = container.config.timezone;

  api.get("/envelopes", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const now = currentPeriod(tz);
    // Period selection (ISC-103/104): an explicit from/to custom range wins, else a
    // named period (this/last month, this/last FY), else this month. The grid
    // recomputes over the whole selected range.
    const from = c.req.query("from");
    const to = c.req.query("to");
    const name = c.req.query("period") as NamedPeriod | undefined;
    const named = name === "this-month" || name === "last-month" || name === "this-fy" || name === "last-fy";
    const range = from && to ? rangeFromDates(from, to) : named ? resolveNamedPeriod(name!, now) : { from: now, to: now };
    // ISC-29 / ISC-76: auto-roll the template into every month in the range.
    for (const m of periodRange(range.from, range.to)) {
      await services.budget.ensureMonth(session.userId, m);
    }
    const grid = await services.envelopes.getGridRange(session.userId, range);
    return c.json(grid);
  });

  api.get("/envelopes/as-of", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const date = c.req.query("date");
    if (!date) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Missing date.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    const grid = await services.envelopes.getGridAsOf(session.userId, date);
    return c.json(grid);
  });

  api.get("/envelopes/detail", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const id = c.req.query("id");
    if (!id) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Missing id.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    // An explicit from/to (YYYY-MM-DD) scopes the row + transactions to a period
    // range, so the detail page reads one row for the selected period rather than
    // pulling the whole grid. Omitting both is the current month.
    const from = c.req.query("from");
    const to = c.req.query("to");
    const range = from && to ? rangeFromDates(from, to) : undefined;
    const detail = await services.envelopes.getDetail(session.userId, id, currentPeriod(tz), range);
    if (!detail) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Envelope not found.", code: "not_found" };
      return c.json(err, 404);
    }
    return c.json(detail);
  });

  // Spend-over-time series for the envelope-detail chart (GAP-A, ISC-16).
  api.get("/envelopes/trend", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const id = c.req.query("id");
    if (!id) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Missing id.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    const bounds = monthBounds(currentPeriod(tz));
    const from = c.req.query("from") ?? bounds.first;
    const to = c.req.query("to") ?? bounds.last;
    // Materialise the template into every month in the range (ISC-29 / ISC-76) so the
    // per-month budget buckets are populated even for months not yet opened on the grid.
    const range = rangeFromDates(from, to);
    for (const m of periodRange(range.from, range.to)) {
      await services.budget.ensureMonth(session.userId, m);
    }
    const trend = await services.envelopes.getTrend(session.userId, id, from, to);
    if (!trend) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Envelope not found.", code: "not_found" };
      return c.json(err, 404);
    }
    return c.json(trend);
  });

  // Conserved move-money. Registered at BOTH contract paths: the UI's
  // MoveMoneyModal posts /api/move, the original registration was
  // /api/envelopes/move — one handler, two routes, zero drift.
  const moveHandler = async (c: Context) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, moveMoneySchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    try {
      const res: MoveMoneyResponse = await services.budget.moveMoney(session.userId, currentPeriod(tz), parsed.value);
      return c.json(res);
    } catch (e) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Move failed.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
  };
  api.post("/envelopes/move", moveHandler);
  api.post("/move", moveHandler);

  // Distribute surplus: a conserved, multi-leg reallocation (mirrors move). The
  // legs must net to exactly zero; a non-conserved set is rejected with a 400.
  api.post("/envelopes/distribute", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, distributeSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    try {
      const res: DistributeResponse = await services.budget.distribute(session.userId, currentPeriod(tz), parsed.value);
      return c.json(res);
    } catch (e) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Distribute failed.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
  });

  // Create a new envelope from the budget page, income or expense (ISC-87).
  api.post("/envelopes", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, createEnvelopeSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    const req = parsed.value;
    const id = crypto.randomUUID();
    if (req.type === "income") {
      await container.store.upsertIncomeEnvelope(session.userId, {
        id,
        userId: session.userId,
        name: req.name,
        source: req.name,
        budgetedCents: req.budgetedCents ?? 0,
        actualCents: 0,
      });
    } else {
      await container.store.upsertEnvelope(session.userId, {
        id,
        parentId: req.parentId ?? null,
        name: req.name,
        group: "",
        // The runtime rollover vocabulary is "roll_carry" (see imported data); the
        // platform Store.Envelope type still carries the legacy enum. Cast around
        // that pre-existing divergence rather than fork the value here.
        rolloverRule: (req.rolloverRule ?? "roll_carry") as never,
        targetType: "no_target",
        targetAmountCents: 0,
        type: req.type,
        ...(req.active !== undefined ? { active: req.active } : {}),
      });
      // The schedule anchor (ISC-25..28): a new budget resets at its interval from
      // the chosen start date. Default to today when none is given. Carryover starts
      // at zero; setEnvelopeCarryover is the owned writer for the (carryover, start) pair.
      const rolloverStart = req.rolloverStart ?? todayISO(tz);
      await container.store.setEnvelopeCarryover(session.userId, id, 0, rolloverStart);
      if (typeof req.budgetedCents === "number" && req.budgetedCents !== 0) {
        await container.store.putTemplateLine(session.userId, {
          id: `bt-${id}`,
          userId: session.userId,
          envelopeId: id,
          amountCents: req.budgetedCents,
          period: req.period ?? "monthly",
        });
        await services.budget.ensureMonth(session.userId, currentPeriod(tz));
      }
    }
    const res: CreateEnvelopeResponse = { id, type: req.type };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // Edit an existing envelope's name/type/parent/active/budget fields (ISC-91,
  // ISC-94, ISC-100). Income envelopes update their target/budget in place;
  // expense-family envelopes update the tree row, and a budget change routes
  // through the budget engine so history and the current period stay true.
  api.post("/envelopes/edit", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, editEnvelopeSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    const req = parsed.value;

    // Income envelope: the budget IS the target (ISC-92); preserve actuals/source.
    const incomes = await container.store.listIncomeEnvelopes(session.userId);
    const income = incomes.find((i) => i.id === req.id);
    if (income) {
      await container.store.upsertIncomeEnvelope(session.userId, {
        ...income,
        name: req.name ?? income.name,
        source: req.name ?? income.source,
        budgetedCents: req.budgetedCents ?? req.targetCents ?? income.budgetedCents,
        targetCents: req.targetCents ?? income.targetCents ?? 0,
      });
      const res: EditEnvelopeResponse = { id: req.id, ok: true };
      return c.json(res);
    }

    const envelopes = await container.store.listEnvelopes(session.userId);
    const existing = envelopes.find((e) => e.id === req.id);
    if (!existing) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Envelope not found.", code: "not_found" };
      return c.json(err, 404);
    }
    if (req.type === "income") {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "An expense envelope cannot be converted to income.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }

    await container.store.upsertEnvelope(session.userId, {
      ...existing,
      name: req.name ?? existing.name,
      parentId: req.parentId !== undefined ? req.parentId : existing.parentId,
      type: req.type ?? existing.type ?? "expense",
      active: req.active ?? existing.active ?? true,
    });

    // Budget amount changes go through the budget engine (template + current
    // period + history, scope ongoing), matching the Edit Budget wizard's path.
    if (req.budgetedCents !== undefined) {
      await services.budget.editBudget(session.userId, currentPeriod(tz), {
        lines: [
          {
            envelopeId: req.id,
            amountCents: req.budgetedCents,
            ...(req.period !== undefined ? { period: req.period } : {}),
          },
        ],
        scope: "ongoing",
      });
    }
    // A period relabel with an unchanged amount is skipped by editBudget (no
    // amount delta), so write the label onto the template line directly.
    if (req.period !== undefined) {
      const template = await container.store.listTemplate(session.userId);
      const line = template.find((t) => t.envelopeId === req.id);
      if (line && line.period !== req.period) {
        await container.store.putTemplateLine(session.userId, { ...line, period: req.period });
      }
    }

    const res: EditEnvelopeResponse = { id: req.id, ok: true };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // Manually reset an envelope's carried starting balance; logged as a traceable event.
  api.post("/envelopes/carryover", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, setCarryoverSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    const res: SetCarryoverResponse = await services.envelopes.resetCarryover(
      session.userId,
      parsed.value.envelopeId,
      parsed.value.carryoverCents,
    );
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // Archive or unarchive an envelope; logged as a traceable envelope.archive event.
  api.post("/envelopes/archive", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, archiveEnvelopeSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    const result = await services.envelopes.archiveEnvelope(session.userId, parsed.value.envelopeId, parsed.value.archived);
    const res: ArchiveEnvelopeResponse = { envelopeId: parsed.value.envelopeId, archived: result.after };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // Set an envelope's rollover schedule: the anchor date and optional interval.
  // Recomputes the schedule (running balances + Left). Logged as a traceable event.
  api.post("/envelopes/rollover", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, setRolloverSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    const req = parsed.value;
    // Move the anchor (preserving carryover) and write the new period onto the
    // recurring template line when one exists; the template holds the budget period.
    await services.envelopes.setRolloverAnchor(session.userId, req.envelopeId, req.rolloverStart, req.period);
    const template = await container.store.listTemplate(session.userId);
    const line = template.find((t) => t.envelopeId === req.envelopeId);
    const resolvedPeriod: BudgetPeriod = req.period ?? line?.period ?? "monthly";
    if (req.period !== undefined && line !== undefined) {
      await container.store.putTemplateLine(session.userId, { ...line, period: req.period });
    }
    const res: SetRolloverResponse = {
      envelopeId: req.envelopeId,
      rolloverStart: req.rolloverStart,
      period: resolvedPeriod,
    };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // The archived envelopes, for the budget page's "Show archived" list.
  api.get("/envelopes/archived", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const res: ArchivedEnvelopesResponse = { envelopes: await services.envelopes.listArchived(session.userId) };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // Traceable money-movements history (ISC-89, ISC-90), newest-first, with the
  // envelope names resolved for display (null when an envelope no longer exists).
  api.get("/movements", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const [movements, envelopes, incomes] = await Promise.all([
      container.store.listMovements(session.userId),
      container.store.listEnvelopes(session.userId),
      container.store.listIncomeEnvelopes(session.userId),
    ]);
    const names = new Map<string, string>();
    for (const e of envelopes) names.set(e.id, e.name);
    for (const i of incomes) names.set(i.id, i.name);
    const views: MovementView[] = movements.map((m) => ({
      id: m.id,
      ts: m.ts,
      fromEnvelopeId: m.fromEnvelopeId,
      fromEnvelopeName: names.get(m.fromEnvelopeId) ?? null,
      toEnvelopeId: m.toEnvelopeId,
      toEnvelopeName: names.get(m.toEnvelopeId) ?? null,
      amountCents: m.amountCents,
      scope: m.scope,
      actor: m.actor,
      correlationId: m.correlationId,
    }));
    const res: MovementsResponse = { movements: views };
    return c.json(res);
  });
}

 * Envelope route handlers: the Dave Ramsey grid with four-figure rollups, the
 * time-travel as-of grid, per-envelope detail, and conserved move-money. Every
 * route is scoped to the authenticated user (ISC-49) and reads/writes through
 * the real envelope and budget engines. Every mutation body is validated with
 * zod at the boundary (see ../validate.ts) before it can reach the ledger.
 *
 * The grid first ensures the current month has its budget (auto-roll, ISC-29 /
 * ISC-76) so a freshly opened month is never blank without any manual step.
 */

import { Hono } from "hono";
import type { Context } from "hono";
import type { Container } from "../../composition.ts";
import type { Services } from "../services.ts";
import type { ApiError, MoveMoneyResponse, DistributeResponse, CreateEnvelopeResponse, SetCarryoverResponse, ArchiveEnvelopeResponse, ArchivedEnvelopesResponse, SetRolloverResponse, EditEnvelopeResponse, MovementsResponse, MovementView } from "../contract.ts";
import type { BudgetPeriod } from "../../domain/types.ts";
import { currentPeriod, resolveSession, UNAUTHENTICATED } from "../http.ts";
import { todayISO } from "../../platform/time.ts";
import { monthBounds, periodRange, resolveNamedPeriod, rangeFromDates, type NamedPeriod } from "../../envelope/period.ts";
import {
  parseBody,
  moveMoneySchema,
  distributeSchema,
  createEnvelopeSchema,
  editEnvelopeSchema,
  setCarryoverSchema,
  archiveEnvelopeSchema,
  setRolloverSchema,
} from "../validate.ts";

export function registerEnvelopes(api: Hono, container: Container, services: Services): void {
  const tz = container.config.timezone;

  api.get("/envelopes", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const now = currentPeriod(tz);
    // Period selection (ISC-103/104): an explicit from/to custom range wins, else a
    // named period (this/last month, this/last FY), else this month. The grid
    // recomputes over the whole selected range.
    const from = c.req.query("from");
    const to = c.req.query("to");
    const name = c.req.query("period") as NamedPeriod | undefined;
    const named = name === "this-month" || name === "last-month" || name === "this-fy" || name === "last-fy";
    const range = from && to ? rangeFromDates(from, to) : named ? resolveNamedPeriod(name!, now) : { from: now, to: now };
    // ISC-29 / ISC-76: auto-roll the template into every month in the range.
    for (const m of periodRange(range.from, range.to)) {
      await services.budget.ensureMonth(session.userId, m);
    }
    const grid = await services.envelopes.getGridRange(session.userId, range);
    return c.json(grid);
  });

  api.get("/envelopes/as-of", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const date = c.req.query("date");
    if (!date) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Missing date.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    const grid = await services.envelopes.getGridAsOf(session.userId, date);
    return c.json(grid);
  });

  api.get("/envelopes/detail", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const id = c.req.query("id");
    if (!id) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Missing id.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    // An explicit from/to (YYYY-MM-DD) scopes the row + transactions to a period
    // range, so the detail page reads one row for the selected period rather than
    // pulling the whole grid. Omitting both is the current month.
    const from = c.req.query("from");
    const to = c.req.query("to");
    const range = from && to ? rangeFromDates(from, to) : undefined;
    const detail = await services.envelopes.getDetail(session.userId, id, currentPeriod(tz), range);
    if (!detail) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Envelope not found.", code: "not_found" };
      return c.json(err, 404);
    }
    return c.json(detail);
  });

  // Spend-over-time series for the envelope-detail chart (GAP-A, ISC-16).
  api.get("/envelopes/trend", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const id = c.req.query("id");
    if (!id) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Missing id.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    const bounds = monthBounds(currentPeriod(tz));
    const from = c.req.query("from") ?? bounds.first;
    const to = c.req.query("to") ?? bounds.last;
    // Materialise the template into every month in the range (ISC-29 / ISC-76) so the
    // per-month budget buckets are populated even for months not yet opened on the grid.
    const range = rangeFromDates(from, to);
    for (const m of periodRange(range.from, range.to)) {
      await services.budget.ensureMonth(session.userId, m);
    }
    const trend = await services.envelopes.getTrend(session.userId, id, from, to);
    if (!trend) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Envelope not found.", code: "not_found" };
      return c.json(err, 404);
    }
    return c.json(trend);
  });

  // Conserved move-money. Registered at BOTH contract paths: the UI's
  // MoveMoneyModal posts /api/move, the original registration was
  // /api/envelopes/move — one handler, two routes, zero drift.
  const moveHandler = async (c: Context) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, moveMoneySchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    try {
      const res: MoveMoneyResponse = await services.budget.moveMoney(session.userId, currentPeriod(tz), parsed.value);
      return c.json(res);
    } catch (e) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Move failed.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
  };
  api.post("/envelopes/move", moveHandler);
  api.post("/move", moveHandler);

  // Distribute surplus: a conserved, multi-leg reallocation (mirrors move). The
  // legs must net to exactly zero; a non-conserved set is rejected with a 400.
  api.post("/envelopes/distribute", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, distributeSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    try {
      const res: DistributeResponse = await services.budget.distribute(session.userId, currentPeriod(tz), parsed.value);
      return c.json(res);
    } catch (e) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Distribute failed.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
  });

  // Create a new envelope from the budget page, income or expense (ISC-87).
  api.post("/envelopes", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, createEnvelopeSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    const req = parsed.value;
    const id = crypto.randomUUID();
    if (req.type === "income") {
      await container.store.upsertIncomeEnvelope(session.userId, {
        id,
        userId: session.userId,
        name: req.name,
        source: req.name,
        budgetedCents: req.budgetedCents ?? 0,
        actualCents: 0,
      });
    } else {
      await container.store.upsertEnvelope(session.userId, {
        id,
        parentId: req.parentId ?? null,
        name: req.name,
        group: "",
        // The runtime rollover vocabulary is "roll_carry" (see imported data); the
        // platform Store.Envelope type still carries the legacy enum. Cast around
        // that pre-existing divergence rather than fork the value here.
        rolloverRule: (req.rolloverRule ?? "roll_carry") as never,
        targetType: "no_target",
        targetAmountCents: 0,
        type: req.type,
        ...(req.active !== undefined ? { active: req.active } : {}),
      });
      // The schedule anchor (ISC-25..28): a new budget resets at its interval from
      // the chosen start date. Default to today when none is given. Carryover starts
      // at zero; setEnvelopeCarryover is the owned writer for the (carryover, start) pair.
      const rolloverStart = req.rolloverStart ?? todayISO(tz);
      await container.store.setEnvelopeCarryover(session.userId, id, 0, rolloverStart);
      if (typeof req.budgetedCents === "number" && req.budgetedCents !== 0) {
        await container.store.putTemplateLine(session.userId, {
          id: `bt-${id}`,
          userId: session.userId,
          envelopeId: id,
          amountCents: req.budgetedCents,
          period: req.period ?? "monthly",
        });
        await services.budget.ensureMonth(session.userId, currentPeriod(tz));
      }
    }
    const res: CreateEnvelopeResponse = { id, type: req.type };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // Edit an existing envelope's name/type/parent/active/budget fields (ISC-91,
  // ISC-94, ISC-100). Income envelopes update their target/budget in place;
  // expense-family envelopes update the tree row, and a budget change routes
  // through the budget engine so history and the current period stay true.
  api.post("/envelopes/edit", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, editEnvelopeSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    const req = parsed.value;

    // Income envelope: the budget IS the target (ISC-92); preserve actuals/source.
    const incomes = await container.store.listIncomeEnvelopes(session.userId);
    const income = incomes.find((i) => i.id === req.id);
    if (income) {
      await container.store.upsertIncomeEnvelope(session.userId, {
        ...income,
        name: req.name ?? income.name,
        source: req.name ?? income.source,
        budgetedCents: req.budgetedCents ?? req.targetCents ?? income.budgetedCents,
        targetCents: req.targetCents ?? income.targetCents ?? 0,
      });
      const res: EditEnvelopeResponse = { id: req.id, ok: true };
      return c.json(res);
    }

    const envelopes = await container.store.listEnvelopes(session.userId);
    const existing = envelopes.find((e) => e.id === req.id);
    if (!existing) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Envelope not found.", code: "not_found" };
      return c.json(err, 404);
    }
    if (req.type === "income") {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "An expense envelope cannot be converted to income.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }

    await container.store.upsertEnvelope(session.userId, {
      ...existing,
      name: req.name ?? existing.name,
      parentId: req.parentId !== undefined ? req.parentId : existing.parentId,
      type: req.type ?? existing.type ?? "expense",
      active: req.active ?? existing.active ?? true,
    });

    // Budget amount changes go through the budget engine (template + current
    // period + history, scope ongoing), matching the Edit Budget wizard's path.
    if (req.budgetedCents !== undefined) {
      await services.budget.editBudget(session.userId, currentPeriod(tz), {
        lines: [
          {
            envelopeId: req.id,
            amountCents: req.budgetedCents,
            ...(req.period !== undefined ? { period: req.period } : {}),
          },
        ],
        scope: "ongoing",
      });
    }
    // A period relabel with an unchanged amount is skipped by editBudget (no
    // amount delta), so write the label onto the template line directly.
    if (req.period !== undefined) {
      const template = await container.store.listTemplate(session.userId);
      const line = template.find((t) => t.envelopeId === req.id);
      if (line && line.period !== req.period) {
        await container.store.putTemplateLine(session.userId, { ...line, period: req.period });
      }
    }

    const res: EditEnvelopeResponse = { id: req.id, ok: true };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // Manually reset an envelope's carried starting balance; logged as a traceable event.
  api.post("/envelopes/carryover", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, setCarryoverSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    const res: SetCarryoverResponse = await services.envelopes.resetCarryover(
      session.userId,
      parsed.value.envelopeId,
      parsed.value.carryoverCents,
    );
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // Archive or unarchive an envelope; logged as a traceable envelope.archive event.
  api.post("/envelopes/archive", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, archiveEnvelopeSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    const result = await services.envelopes.archiveEnvelope(session.userId, parsed.value.envelopeId, parsed.value.archived);
    const res: ArchiveEnvelopeResponse = { envelopeId: parsed.value.envelopeId, archived: result.after };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // Set an envelope's rollover schedule: the anchor date and optional interval.
  // Recomputes the schedule (running balances + Left). Logged as a traceable event.
  api.post("/envelopes/rollover", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, setRolloverSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    const req = parsed.value;
    // Move the anchor (preserving carryover) and write the new period onto the
    // recurring template line when one exists; the template holds the budget period.
    await services.envelopes.setRolloverAnchor(session.userId, req.envelopeId, req.rolloverStart, req.period);
    const template = await container.store.listTemplate(session.userId);
    const line = template.find((t) => t.envelopeId === req.envelopeId);
    const resolvedPeriod: BudgetPeriod = req.period ?? line?.period ?? "monthly";
    if (req.period !== undefined && line !== undefined) {
      await container.store.putTemplateLine(session.userId, { ...line, period: req.period });
    }
    const res: SetRolloverResponse = {
      envelopeId: req.envelopeId,
      rolloverStart: req.rolloverStart,
      period: resolvedPeriod,
    };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // The archived envelopes, for the budget page's "Show archived" list.
  api.get("/envelopes/archived", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const res: ArchivedEnvelopesResponse = { envelopes: await services.envelopes.listArchived(session.userId) };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // Traceable money-movements history (ISC-89, ISC-90), newest-first, with the
  // envelope names resolved for display (null when an envelope no longer exists).
  api.get("/movements", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const [movements, envelopes, incomes] = await Promise.all([
      container.store.listMovements(session.userId),
      container.store.listEnvelopes(session.userId),
      container.store.listIncomeEnvelopes(session.userId),
    ]);
    const names = new Map<string, string>();
    for (const e of envelopes) names.set(e.id, e.name);
    for (const i of incomes) names.set(i.id, i.name);
    const views: MovementView[] = movements.map((m) => ({
      id: m.id,
      ts: m.ts,
      fromEnvelopeId: m.fromEnvelopeId,
      fromEnvelopeName: names.get(m.fromEnvelopeId) ?? null,
      toEnvelopeId: m.toEnvelopeId,
      toEnvelopeName: names.get(m.toEnvelopeId) ?? null,
      amountCents: m.amountCents,
      scope: m.scope,
      actor: m.actor,
      correlationId: m.correlationId,
    }));
    const res: MovementsResponse = { movements: views };
    return c.json(res);
  });
}

import { Hono } from "hono";
import type { Container } from "../../composition.ts";
import type { Services } from "../services.ts";
import type { EditBudgetRequest } from "../contract.ts";
import { currentPeriod, resolveSession, UNAUTHENTICATED } from "../http.ts";

export function registerBudget(api: Hono, container: Container, services: Services): void {
  api.get("/budget/history", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    return c.json(await services.budget.getHistory(session.userId));
  });

  api.post("/budget/edit", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);

    return c.json(await services.budget.editBudget(session.userId, currentPeriod(), req));

{"parentUuid":"71ab3a36-9586-4e07-877b-42abfba96ada","isSidechain":true,"agentId":"a02ab3a7b4621aa3c","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CczptUdUu61Kpe1aJhdgt","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01NjvHPmuCrwmxiJ5hquKaCZ","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/nicholas-wood/Documents/workspace/projects/envelope-os/src/server/handlers/auth.ts","content":"/**
 * Auth route handlers. Drives the active AuthProvider seam: local PIN sign-in
 * mints a session cookie immediately; cloud email sign-in sends a magic link and
 * the follow-up verify mints the cookie. Neither path leaks which user exists
 * (AuthError is surfaced as a flat 401). The session route reflects the resolved
 * session; signout clears the cookie.
 *
 * Brute-force throttling: both sign-in and the current-PIN check inside
 * change-pin run through an AttemptTracker. Five consecutive failures start an
 * exponential backoff window; while it is open the request is refused with 429
 * BEFORE any PIN comparison, even for a correct PIN. Success resets the key.
 * The response never reveals a remaining-attempt count.
 */

import { Hono } from "hono";
import type { Container } from "../../composition.ts";
import { AuthError, type BeginSignInInput } from "../../platform/auth.ts";
import type { AttemptTracker } from "../../platform/auth/attempts.ts";
import type { ApiError, ChangePinResponse, SessionResponse, SignInResponse } from "../contract.ts";
import { clearCookie, resolveSession, sessionCookie, UNAUTHENTICATED } from "../http.ts";
import { parseBody, signInSchema, verifyLinkSchema, changePinSchema } from "../validate.ts";

/** Uniform 429 body. Names the wait, never the remaining attempts. */
function tooManyAttempts(c: Parameters<typeof rateLimited>[0], retryAfterMs: number) {
  return rateLimited(c, retryAfterMs);
}

function rateLimited(c: { json: (o: ApiError, s: 429) => Response; header: (k: string, v: string) => void }, retryAfterMs: number): Response {
  const seconds = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(retryAfterMs / 1000));
  c.header("Retry-After", String(seconds));
  const err: ApiError = {
    error: `Too many attempts. Try again in ${seconds}s.`,
    code: "rate_limited",
  };
  return c.json(err, 429);
}

export function registerAuth(api: Hono, container: Container, attempts: AttemptTracker): void {
  const secure = container.config.deployMode === "cloud";

  api.post("/auth/signin", async (c) => {
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, signInSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    const body = parsed.value;

    const input: BeginSignInInput =
      body.kind === "pin" ? { kind: "pin", pin: body.pin } : { kind: "email", email: body.email };
    // Local mode has a single principal, so PIN guesses share one key; email
    // sign-in throttles per address so one address cannot exhaust another's window.
    const key = body.kind === "pin" ? "signin:pin" : `signin:email:${body.email.toLowerCase()}`;

    const gate = await attempts.check(key);
    if (gate.blocked) return tooManyAttempts(c, gate.retryAfterMs);

    try {
      const session = await container.auth.beginSignIn(input);
      await attempts.recordSuccess(key);
      if (session) {
        // Local PIN: a session was minted immediately. Set the cookie.
        const token = await container.auth.mintToken(session);
        c.header("Set-Cookie", sessionCookie(token, secure));
        const res: SignInResponse = { status: "authenticated", userId: session.userId };
        return c.json(res);
      }
      // Cloud email: link sent, second step (verify) required.
      const res: SignInResponse = { status: "link_sent", userId: null };
      return c.json(res);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof AuthError) {
        await attempts.recordFailure(key);
        const err: ApiError = { error: "Sign-in failed.", code: "auth_failed" };
        return c.json(err, 401);
      }
      throw e;
    }
  });

  api.post("/auth/verify", async (c) => {
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, verifyLinkSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    try {
      const session = await container.auth.completeSignIn(parsed.value.token);
      const token = await container.auth.mintToken(session);
      c.header("Set-Cookie", sessionCookie(token, secure));
      const res: SessionResponse = {
        authenticated: true,
        userId: session.userId,
        idleExpiresAt: session.idleExpiresAt,
      };
      return c.json(res);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof AuthError) {
        const err: ApiError = { error: "Verification failed.", code: "auth_failed" };
        return c.json(err, 401);
      }
      throw e;
    }
  });

  api.get("/auth/session", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    const res: SessionResponse = session
      ? { authenticated: true, userId: session.userId, idleExpiresAt: session.idleExpiresAt }
      : { authenticated: false, userId: null, idleExpiresAt: null };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  api.post("/auth/signout", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (session) await container.auth.signOut(session);
    c.header("Set-Cookie", clearCookie());
    return c.json({ ok: true } as const);
  });

  // Change the local PIN. Must be authenticated (the session gates who can change
  // it). The current PIN is re-verified by the AuthProvider with the same scheme
  // sign-in uses; a wrong current PIN or invalid new PIN returns 400 — NEVER 401,
  // which would trip the client idle-lock and sign the user out mid-change.
  api.post("/auth/change-pin", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, changePinSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    const body = parsed.value;

    // New-PIN policy is checked BEFORE the current-PIN verification so a weak
    // new PIN (which says nothing about whether the caller knows the current
    // PIN) is never counted as a brute-force failure. Mirrors the provider's
    // own policy in src/platform/auth/local.ts.
    if (!/^\d{4,}$/.test(body.newPin)) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "New PIN must be at least four digits.", code: "pin_change_failed" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }

    const key = `change-pin:${session.userId}`;
    const gate = await attempts.check(key);
    if (gate.blocked) return tooManyAttempts(c, gate.retryAfterMs);

    try {
      await container.auth.changePin(body.currentPin, body.newPin);
      await attempts.recordSuccess(key);
      const res: ChangePinResponse = { ok: true };
      return c.json(res);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof AuthError) {
        // With the new-PIN policy pre-checked above, an AuthError here means the
        // current-PIN verification failed — a throttled guess.
        await attempts.recordFailure(key);
        // Never leak whether it was the current PIN or the new PIN policy at 401;
        // surface the specific-but-safe message at 400 so the app stays signed in.
        const err: ApiError = { error: e.message, code: "pin_change_failed" };
        return c.json(err, 400);
      }
      throw e;
    }

 *
 * Builds the container at the composition root (the only place DEPLOY_MODE is
 * read), registers every API route from the typed handlers, serves the built
 * web/dist SPA as static assets with an index.html fallback, and mounts the whole
 * app under config.basePath ("/" local, "/budget" cloud). The listener binds
 * 127.0.0.1 at config.port; in local mode `tailscale serve` fronts it with HTTPS.
 *

 * integration phases fill them in without touching this wiring or the contract.

import { Hono } from "hono";
import { serveStatic } from "hono/bun";
import { buildContainer, type Container } from "../composition.ts";
import { installEgressGuard } from "../security/egress.ts";
import { buildServices } from "./services.ts";
import { registerAuth } from "./handlers/auth.ts";
import { registerEnvelopes } from "./handlers/envelopes.ts";
import { registerReconcile } from "./handlers/reconcile.ts";
import { registerBudget } from "./handlers/budget.ts";
import { registerSettings } from "./handlers/settings.ts";
import { registerPulse } from "./handlers/pulse.ts";
import { registerTransactions } from "./handlers/transactions.ts";
import { registerSync } from "./handlers/sync.ts";
import { registerBackup } from "./handlers/backup.ts";

const WEB_DIST = "./web/dist";

export interface Server {
  readonly app: Hono;
  readonly container: Container;
}

/** Build the full application: container + routed API + static SPA, mounted at basePath. */
export async function createServer(): Promise<Server> {
  const container = await buildContainer();

  // Local-mode no-egress guarantee (ISC-45): nothing financial leaves the box.
  // PocketSmith and loopback/tailnet stay allowed; cloud mode is permissive.
  installEgressGuard(container.config.deployMode);

  const services = buildServices(container);

  // All API routes live under /api on this sub-app.
  const api = new Hono();
  registerAuth(api, container);
  registerEnvelopes(api, container, services);
  registerReconcile(api, container, services);
  registerBudget(api, container, services);
  registerSettings(api, container);
  registerPulse(api, container, services);
  registerTransactions(api, container, services);
  registerSync(api, container);
  registerBackup(api, container);

  // Liveness probe, mode-agnostic.
  api.get("/health", (c) => c.json({ ok: true, mode: container.config.deployMode } as const));

  const inner = new Hono();
  inner.route("/api", api);
  // Static assets first, then SPA fallback to index.html for client-side routing.
  inner.use("/*", serveStatic({ root: WEB_DIST }));
  inner.get("*", serveStatic({ path: `${WEB_DIST}/index.html` }));

  // Mount under the configured base path. "/" local, "/budget" cloud.
  const app = new Hono();
  app.route(container.config.basePath === "/" ? "/" : container.config.basePath, inner);

  return { app, container };
}

const { app, container } = await createServer();

// Bun reads this default export. Bind loopback; tailscale serve / the cloud
// platform terminates TLS in front. Enforces local-mode non-public exposure.
export default {
  port: container.config.port,
  hostname: "127.0.0.1",
  fetch: app.fetch,
};
