import type { Context } from "hono";
import type { Container } from "../composition.ts";
import type { Session } from "../platform/auth.ts";
import type { ApiError } from "./contract.ts";
import type { Period } from "../domain/types.ts";
import { SESSION_COOKIE } from "../platform/auth/session.ts";

/** The current calendar-month period in UTC. */
export function currentPeriod(now: Date = new Date()): Period {
  return { year: now.getUTCFullYear(), month: now.getUTCMonth() + 1 };
}

/** Uniform unauthenticated error body. */
export const UNAUTHENTICATED: ApiError = {
  error: "Not authenticated.",
  code: "unauthenticated",
};

/**
 * Resolve the authenticated session for a request, or null. Pure pass-through
 * to the active AuthProvider so the route layer never branches on local/cloud.
 */
export function resolveSession(c: Context, container: Container): Promise<Session | null> {
  return container.auth.resolveSession(c.req.raw);
}

const IDLE_MAX_AGE_S = 30 * 60;

/**
 * Build the Set-Cookie value for a freshly minted session token. httpOnly +
 * SameSite=Strict always; Secure only in cloud (so the loopback dev probe and
 * tailscale-fronted local HTTPS both work). 30-minute idle window (ISC-39).
 */
export function sessionCookie(token: string, secure: boolean): string {
  const attrs = [
    `${SESSION_COOKIE}=${token}`,
    "Path=/",
    "HttpOnly",
    "SameSite=Strict",
    `Max-Age=${IDLE_MAX_AGE_S}`,
  ];
  if (secure) attrs.push("Secure");
  return attrs.join("; ");
}

/** Build the Set-Cookie value that clears the session cookie on sign-out. */
export function clearCookie(): string {
  return `${SESSION_COOKIE}=; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=0`;
}

 * Envelope route handlers: the Dave Ramsey grid with four-figure rollups, the
 * time-travel as-of grid, per-envelope detail, and conserved move-money. Every
 * route is scoped to the authenticated user (ISC-49) and reads/writes through
 * the real envelope and budget engines.
 *
 * The grid first ensures the current month has its budget (auto-roll, ISC-29 /
 * ISC-76) so a freshly opened month is never blank without any manual step.
 */

import { Hono } from "hono";
import type { Container } from "../../composition.ts";
import type { Services } from "../services.ts";
import type { ApiError, MoveMoneyRequest, MoveMoneyResponse, DistributeRequest, DistributeResponse, CreateEnvelopeRequest, CreateEnvelopeResponse, SetCarryoverRequest, SetCarryoverResponse, ArchiveEnvelopeRequest, ArchiveEnvelopeResponse, ArchivedEnvelopesResponse, SetRolloverRequest, SetRolloverResponse } from "../contract.ts";
import type { BudgetPeriod } from "../../domain/types.ts";
import { currentPeriod, resolveSession, UNAUTHENTICATED } from "../http.ts";
import { monthBounds, periodRange, resolveNamedPeriod, rangeFromDates, type NamedPeriod } from "../../envelope/period.ts";

export function registerEnvelopes(api: Hono, container: Container, services: Services): void {
  api.get("/envelopes", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const now = currentPeriod();
    // Period selection (ISC-103/104): an explicit from/to custom range wins, else a
    // named period (this/last month, this/last FY), else this month. The grid
    // recomputes over the whole selected range.
    const from = c.req.query("from");
    const to = c.req.query("to");
    const name = c.req.query("period") as NamedPeriod | undefined;
    const named = name === "this-month" || name === "last-month" || name === "this-fy" || name === "last-fy";
    const range = from && to ? rangeFromDates(from, to) : named ? resolveNamedPeriod(name!, now) : { from: now, to: now };
    // ISC-29 / ISC-76: auto-roll the template into every month in the range.
    for (const m of periodRange(range.from, range.to)) {
      await services.budget.ensureMonth(session.userId, m);
    }
    const grid = await services.envelopes.getGridRange(session.userId, range);
    return c.json(grid);
  });

  api.get("/envelopes/as-of", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const date = c.req.query("date");
    if (!date) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Missing date.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    const grid = await services.envelopes.getGridAsOf(session.userId, date);
    return c.json(grid);
  });

  api.get("/envelopes/detail", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const id = c.req.query("id");
    if (!id) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Missing id.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    // An explicit from/to (YYYY-MM-DD) scopes the row + transactions to a period
    // range, so the detail page reads one row for the selected period rather than
    // pulling the whole grid. Omitting both is the current month.
    const from = c.req.query("from");
    const to = c.req.query("to");
    const range = from && to ? rangeFromDates(from, to) : undefined;
    const detail = await services.envelopes.getDetail(session.userId, id, currentPeriod(), range);
    if (!detail) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Envelope not found.", code: "not_found" };
      return c.json(err, 404);
    }
    return c.json(detail);
  });

  // Spend-over-time series for the envelope-detail chart (GAP-A, ISC-16).
  api.get("/envelopes/trend", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const id = c.req.query("id");
    if (!id) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Missing id.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    const bounds = monthBounds(currentPeriod());
    const from = c.req.query("from") ?? bounds.first;
    const to = c.req.query("to") ?? bounds.last;
    // Materialise the template into every month in the range (ISC-29 / ISC-76) so the
    // per-month budget buckets are populated even for months not yet opened on the grid.
    const range = rangeFromDates(from, to);
    for (const m of periodRange(range.from, range.to)) {
      await services.budget.ensureMonth(session.userId, m);
    }
    const trend = await services.envelopes.getTrend(session.userId, id, from, to);
    if (!trend) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Envelope not found.", code: "not_found" };
      return c.json(err, 404);
    }
    return c.json(trend);
  });

  api.post("/envelopes/move", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const req = (await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as MoveMoneyRequest;
    try {
      const res: MoveMoneyResponse = await services.budget.moveMoney(session.userId, currentPeriod(), req);
      return c.json(res);
    } catch (e) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Move failed.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
  });

  // Distribute surplus: a conserved, multi-leg reallocation (mirrors move). The
  // legs must net to exactly zero; a non-conserved set is rejected with a 400.
  api.post("/envelopes/distribute", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const req = (await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as DistributeRequest;
    try {
      const res: DistributeResponse = await services.budget.distribute(session.userId, currentPeriod(), req);
      return c.json(res);
    } catch (e) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Distribute failed.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
  });

  // Create a new envelope from the budget page, income or expense (ISC-87).
  api.post("/envelopes", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const req = (await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Partial<CreateEnvelopeRequest>;
    if (typeof req.name !== "string" || req.name.trim().length === 0 || (req.type !== "income" && req.type !== "expense")) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Name and type (income|expense) are required.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    const id = crypto.randomUUID();
    if (req.type === "income") {
      await container.store.upsertIncomeEnvelope(session.userId, {
        id,
        userId: session.userId,
        name: req.name.trim(),
        source: req.name.trim(),
        budgetedCents: req.budgetedCents ?? 0,
        actualCents: 0,
      });
    } else {
      await container.store.upsertEnvelope(session.userId, {
        id,
        parentId: req.parentId ?? null,
        name: req.name.trim(),
        group: "",
        // The runtime rollover vocabulary is "roll_carry" (see imported data); the
        // platform Store.Envelope type still carries the legacy enum. Cast around
        // that pre-existing divergence rather than fork the value here.
        rolloverRule: (req.rolloverRule ?? "roll_carry") as never,
        targetType: "no_target",
        targetAmountCents: 0,
      });
      // The schedule anchor (ISC-25..28): a new budget resets at its interval from
      // the chosen start date. Default to today when none is given. Carryover starts
      // at zero; setEnvelopeCarryover is the owned writer for the (carryover, start) pair.
      const rolloverStart =
        typeof req.rolloverStart === "string" && req.rolloverStart.length > 0
          ? req.rolloverStart
          : new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      await container.store.setEnvelopeCarryover(session.userId, id, 0, rolloverStart);
      if (typeof req.budgetedCents === "number" && req.budgetedCents !== 0) {
        await container.store.putTemplateLine(session.userId, {
          id: `bt-${id}`,
          userId: session.userId,
          envelopeId: id,
          amountCents: req.budgetedCents,
          period: req.period ?? "monthly",
        });
        await services.budget.ensureMonth(session.userId, currentPeriod());
      }
    }
    const res: CreateEnvelopeResponse = { id, type: req.type };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // Manually reset an envelope's carried starting balance; logged as a traceable event.
  api.post("/envelopes/carryover", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const req = (await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Partial<SetCarryoverRequest>;
    if (typeof req.envelopeId !== "string" || typeof req.carryoverCents !== "number") {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "envelopeId and carryoverCents are required.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    const res: SetCarryoverResponse = await services.envelopes.resetCarryover(
      session.userId,
      req.envelopeId,
      Math.round(req.carryoverCents),
    );
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // Archive or unarchive an envelope; logged as a traceable envelope.archive event.
  api.post("/envelopes/archive", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const req = (await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Partial<ArchiveEnvelopeRequest>;
    if (typeof req.envelopeId !== "string" || typeof req.archived !== "boolean") {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "envelopeId and archived are required.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    const result = await services.envelopes.archiveEnvelope(session.userId, req.envelopeId, req.archived);
    const res: ArchiveEnvelopeResponse = { envelopeId: req.envelopeId, archived: result.after };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // Set an envelope's rollover schedule: the anchor date and optional interval.
  // Recomputes the schedule (running balances + Left). Logged as a traceable event.
  api.post("/envelopes/rollover", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const req = (await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Partial<SetRolloverRequest>;
    const validPeriods: readonly BudgetPeriod[] = ["weekly", "fortnightly", "monthly", "annual"];
    if (
      typeof req.envelopeId !== "string" ||
      typeof req.rolloverStart !== "string" ||
      !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(req.rolloverStart) ||
      (req.period !== undefined && !validPeriods.includes(req.period))
    ) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "envelopeId and a valid rolloverStart (YYYY-MM-DD) are required.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    // Move the anchor (preserving carryover) and write the new period onto the
    // recurring template line when one exists; the template holds the budget period.
    await services.envelopes.setRolloverAnchor(session.userId, req.envelopeId, req.rolloverStart, req.period);
    const template = await container.store.listTemplate(session.userId);
    const line = template.find((t) => t.envelopeId === req.envelopeId);
    const resolvedPeriod: BudgetPeriod = req.period ?? line?.period ?? "monthly";
    if (req.period !== undefined && line !== undefined) {
      await container.store.putTemplateLine(session.userId, { ...line, period: req.period });
    }
    const res: SetRolloverResponse = {
      envelopeId: req.envelopeId,
      rolloverStart: req.rolloverStart,
      period: resolvedPeriod,
    };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // The archived envelopes, for the budget page's "Show archived" list.
  api.get("/envelopes/archived", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const res: ArchivedEnvelopesResponse = { envelopes: await services.envelopes.listArchived(session.userId) };
    return c.json(res);
  });

98	/**
99	 * A first-class income envelope on the grid (ISC-65, ISC-88, ISC-101). It carries
100	 * the same four figures as an expense row so the UI can render the two identically:
101	 *
102	 *   carryoverCents  starting carryover on the income envelope (signed)
103	 *   budgetedCents   the budget (the expected/target income) — column 2
104	 *   receivedCents   actual income that landed in the range, in place of "spent"
105	 *   leftCents       carryover + received - budget (the running income surplus/deficit)
106	 *
107	 * `actualCents` is retained as an alias of `receivedCents`, and `varianceCents`
108	 * (received - target) is retained for the legacy surplus/deficit view (ISC-99).
109	 * The old `capitalToExpenseCents` field was removed: the income budget is itself
110	 * the balancing figure (ISA Changelog 2026-06-27).
111	 */
112	export interface IncomeEnvelopeView {
113	  readonly id: string;
114	  readonly name: string;
115	  readonly source: string;
116	  /** The budget: expected/target income for the range (column 2). */
117	  readonly budgetedCents: number;

119	  readonly actualCents: number;
120	  /** Actual income received in the range, in place of "spent" (ISC-101). */
121	  readonly receivedCents: number;

123	  readonly targetCents: number;
124	  /** received - target. Positive = surplus, negative = deficit (ISC-99). */
125	  readonly varianceCents: number;
126	  /** Starting carryover on the income envelope, signed (column 1). */
127	  readonly carryoverCents: number;
128	  /** carryover + received - budget: the running income surplus/deficit (column 4, ISC-101). */
129	  readonly leftCents: number;
130	}

452	
453	/**
454	 * The master reconciliation (the whole point of envelope budgeting): the sum of
455	 * every envelope's "left" should equal the user's real liquid position — cash on
456	 * hand minus what is owed on credit cards. Account balances come live from
457	 * PocketSmith (the same fetch as GET /api/reconcile/balances); the left figure is
458	 * the sum of every LEAF envelope's leftCents plus the income envelopes' leftCents.
459	 */
460	export interface NetPositionResponse {
461	  /** False when PocketSmith could not be reached (no key, network/auth error). */
462	  readonly ok: boolean;
463	  /** Sum of non-card (bank/cash) account current balances, integer cents. */
464	  readonly cashOnHandCents: number;
465	  /** Magnitude of the summed credit-card balances, reported as a positive owed figure. */
466	  readonly cardOwedCents: number;
467	  /** Sum of leaf-envelope leftCents plus income leftCents (the budget's "left"). */
468	  readonly totalLeftCents: number;
469	  /**
470	   * The budget's "left" broken down by section. Income is the sum of the income
471	   * envelopes' leftCents; saving/expense/envelope/working are the per-type sums of
472	   * the leaf rows' leftCents. The five sum to totalLeftCents. Working envelopes are
473	   * outside the zero-based budget but still move real cash, so their balance is part
474	   * of the net-position reconciliation (it begins at 0 today and accrues forward).
475	   */
476	  readonly sectionLeftCents: {
477	    readonly income: number;
478	    readonly saving: number;
479	    readonly expense: number;
480	    readonly envelope: number;
481	    readonly working: number;
482	  };
483	  /** (cashOnHand − cardOwed) − totalLeft. Zero means the budget reconciles to reality. */
484	  readonly reconciledDeltaCents: number;
485	  readonly asOf: number;
486	  /** Present when ok is false: a safe, key-free reason. */
487	  readonly message?: string;

 * The typed API contract. This is the single source of truth for the wire shapes
 * exchanged between the SPA and the Hono handlers. Locking it here lets the UI and
 * the handler implementations be built in parallel against the same types.
 *
 * Conventions:
 *   - All money is integer cents (field names end in Cents).
 *   - Dates are ISO strings (YYYY-MM-DD); timestamps are epoch millis (asOf, ts).
 *   - Every response that reflects tenant state is implicitly scoped to the
 *     authenticated user_id resolved by the AuthProvider; user_id is never a
 *     request field (the session carries it).
 */

import type { BudgetPeriod, ChangeScope, EnvelopeType, RolloverRule, TargetType } from "../domain/types.ts";

/** Uniform error envelope. */
export interface ApiError {
  readonly error: string;
  readonly code: string;
}

// ── Auth ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface SignInRequest {
  /** PIN for local mode, email for cloud mode. */
  readonly kind: "pin" | "email";
  readonly pin?: string;
  readonly email?: string;
}

export interface SignInResponse {
  /** "authenticated" when a session was minted (local PIN); "link_sent" for cloud. */
  readonly status: "authenticated" | "link_sent";
  readonly userId: string | null;
}

export interface VerifyLinkRequest {
  readonly token: string;
}

export interface SessionResponse {
  readonly authenticated: boolean;
  readonly userId: string | null;
  readonly idleExpiresAt: number | null;
}

/**
 * Change the local PIN (ISC-52). Requires the current PIN to set a new one; the
 * server verifies the current PIN with the exact same scheme sign-in uses and
 * never weakens it. Only meaningful in local (PIN) mode; cloud mode rejects it.
 */
export interface ChangePinRequest {
  readonly currentPin: string;
  readonly newPin: string;
}

export interface ChangePinResponse {
  readonly ok: true;
}

// ── Envelopes grid (with rollups) ─────────────────────────────────────────────

/** One row in the Dave Ramsey grid, with the four figures and tree position. */
export interface EnvelopeRow {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly parentId: string | null;
  readonly name: string;
  readonly group: string;
  readonly rolloverRule: RolloverRule;
  readonly targetType: TargetType;
  readonly targetAmountCents: number;
  /** Envelope type (ISC-91): income, expense, saving, envelope, or working. */
  readonly type: EnvelopeType;
  /** Active flag (ISC-100). Inactive envelopes are excluded from the budget total. */
  readonly active: boolean;
  /** Archived flag. Archived envelopes are excluded entirely from the grid. */
  readonly archived: boolean;
  /** The period the budget is entered in (ISC-94): weekly, fortnightly, monthly, annual. */
  readonly period: BudgetPeriod;
  /**
   * The date the rollover schedule is anchored on (YYYY-MM-DD), or null when no
   * baseline has been set. Editable per budget; drives the per-transaction running
   * balance schedule and seeds the Edit Budget date input.
   */
  readonly rolloverStart: string | null;
  /** Starting carryover (may be negative). */
  readonly carryoverCents: number;
  /** This-period allocation. */
  readonly allocationCents: number;
  /** carryover + allocation. */
  readonly totalCents: number;
  /** total - spent. */
  readonly leftCents: number;
  /** Depth in the tree, 0 = top level. */
  readonly depth: number;
}

/**
 * A first-class income envelope on the grid (ISC-65, ISC-88, ISC-101). It carries
 * the same four figures as an expense row so the UI can render the two identically:
 *
 *   carryoverCents  starting carryover on the income envelope (signed)
 *   budgetedCents   the budget (the expected/target income) — column 2
 *   receivedCents   actual income that landed in the range, in place of "spent"
 *   leftCents       carryover + received - budget (the running income surplus/deficit)
 *
 * `actualCents` is retained as an alias of `receivedCents`, and `varianceCents`
 * (received - target) is retained for the legacy surplus/deficit view (ISC-99).
 * The old `capitalToExpenseCents` field was removed: the income budget is itself
 * the balancing figure (ISA Changelog 2026-06-27).
 */
export interface IncomeEnvelopeView {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly name: string;
  readonly source: string;
  /** The budget: expected/target income for the range (column 2). */
  readonly budgetedCents: number;
  /** Actual income received in the range; alias of receivedCents (column 3). */
  readonly actualCents: number;
  /** Actual income received in the range, in place of "spent" (ISC-101). */
  readonly receivedCents: number;
  /** Income target for the range (defaults to the budget). */
  readonly targetCents: number;
  /** received - target. Positive = surplus, negative = deficit (ISC-99). */
  readonly varianceCents: number;
  /** Starting carryover on the income envelope, signed (column 1). */
  readonly carryoverCents: number;
  /** carryover + received - budget: the running income surplus/deficit (column 4, ISC-101). */
  readonly leftCents: number;
}

/** A named period selection for the grid (ISC-103). Australian FY = 1 Jul to 30 Jun. */
export type NamedPeriod = "this-month" | "last-month" | "this-fy" | "last-fy";

/**
 * Period selection for GET /api/envelopes (ISC-103, ISC-104). Either a named
 * period (default this-month) OR an explicit from/to custom date range. When
 * both are present, the explicit from/to wins. Omitting everything is this-month.
 */
export interface EnvelopesQuery {
  readonly period?: NamedPeriod;
  /** Inclusive custom-range lower bound (YYYY-MM-DD). */
  readonly from?: string;
  /** Inclusive custom-range upper bound (YYYY-MM-DD). */
  readonly to?: string;
}

export interface GridResponse {
  /** ISO YYYY-MM for the rendered period (the range's final month). */
  readonly period: string;
  /** Inclusive ISO date bounds of the rendered range (ISC-104). */
  readonly from: string;
  readonly to: string;
  readonly rows: readonly EnvelopeRow[];
  /** First-class income envelopes with budgeted/actual/variance (ISC-65, ISC-88). */
  readonly income: readonly IncomeEnvelopeView[];
  /**
   * False when the tenant has zero envelopes: the UI shows the empty "not set up
   * yet" state instead of a misleading zeroed balance (ISC-88).
   */
  readonly isSetUp: boolean;
  /** Total budgeted income across income envelopes (the zero-based denominator). */
  readonly budgetedIncomeCents: number;
  /** Continuous zero-based check: positive = unallocated, negative = over-allocated. */
  readonly unallocatedCents: number;
  /** True when the budget is not zero-based; an alert, never a block (ISC-30). */
  readonly zeroBasedAlert: boolean;
  /**
   * Income capital provided = sum of income budgets over the range (ISC-92). The
   * income budget is itself the balancing figure; there is no capital sub-pool.
   */
  readonly capitalProvidedCents: number;
  /** Total budgeted out: sum of active expense+saving+envelope budgets over the range (ISC-98). */
  readonly budgetedOutCents: number;
  /** capitalProvided - budgetedOut. Zero when the zero-base balances (ISC-98). */
  readonly residualCents: number;
  /**
   * Count of transactions in the rendered period that resolve to NO envelope
   * (unmapped, ISC-20). These sit outside every budget; the UI surfaces them as a
   * single "to be categorised" summary line above the budget sections.
   */
  readonly uncategorisedCount: number;
  /** Signed-cents total of those same uncategorised transactions. */
  readonly uncategorisedTotalCents: number;
  readonly asOf: number;
}

/** The budget-balancing (zero-base) figures, ISC-98 / ISC-99. */
export interface BudgetBalanceResponse {
  /** Sum of income budgets over the range: the income capital provided (ISC-92). */
  readonly capitalProvidedCents: number;
  /** Sum of active expense+saving+envelope budgets over the range: the amount budgeted out. */
  readonly budgetedOutCents: number;
  /** capitalProvided - budgetedOut. Zero when balanced; the residual otherwise. */
  readonly residualCents: number;
}

/** Time-travel view: balances as at end-of-day T (ISC-36). */
export interface AsOfRequest {
  readonly date: string;
}

// ── Envelope detail ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface TransactionView {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly date: string;
  readonly amountCents: number;
  readonly payee: string;
  readonly isPending: boolean;
  readonly isTransfer: boolean;
}

export interface EnvelopeDetailResponse {
  readonly envelope: EnvelopeRow;
  readonly transactions: readonly TransactionView[];
  /**
   * Present only when the resolved envelope is an income envelope (id prefix
   * `inc-`). The four-figure `envelope` row above is synthesised from this view
   * (carryover, budget→allocation, carryover+received→total, left) so the detail
   * UI renders income identically; `income` carries the lossless income figures
   * (budgeted/received/target/variance) for richer rendering (ISC-65, ISC-101).
   */
  readonly income?: IncomeEnvelopeView;
}

// ── Envelope trend: spend-over-time series (GAP-A, ISC-16) ─────────────────────

/** Query for GET /api/envelopes/trend: one envelope, optional inclusive date window. */
export interface TrendQuery {
  readonly id: string;
  /** Inclusive lower date bound (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the current month start. */
  readonly from?: string;
  /** Inclusive upper date bound (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the current month end. */
  readonly to?: string;
}

/**
 * One day of the envelope spend-over-time series. All money is signed integer
 * cents (negative = outflow), consistent with the rest of the engine.
 */
export interface TrendPoint {
  readonly date: string;
  /** Net signed activity on this day (negative = outflow, positive = inflow). */
  readonly spentCents: number;
  /** Running net signed activity from `from` to this day inclusive. */
  readonly cumulativeSpentCents: number;
  /** The flat budget line: the envelope's allocation/budget for the window. */
  readonly budgetLineCents: number;
  /** The exposed ISC-16 daily snapshot balance for this day, or null if none was written. */
  readonly snapshotBalanceCents: number | null;
}

/**
 * One month of the envelope trend, the PocketSmith monthly "Trends" bucket. All
 * money is unsigned integer cents (magnitudes), consistent with the chart's own
 * above/below-zero framing.
 *
 * For an EXPENSE envelope `spentCents` is the month's net outflow magnitude; for
 * an INCOME envelope it carries the net received magnitude instead (the chart
 * plots received bars against the target line). The within/over/saved split and
 * the rolling `rolloverBalanceCents` cushion mirror how the grid folds carryover.
 */
export interface TrendMonth {
  /** The month key, YYYY-MM. */
  readonly month: string;
  /** Short axis label, e.g. "Mar". */
  readonly label: string;
  /** The envelope's monthly-equivalent budget (rolled up over descendants). */
  readonly budgetCents: number;
  /** Net outflow magnitude in the month (income: net received magnitude). */
  readonly spentCents: number;
  /** Sum of positive (refund/inflow) posted transactions in the month. */
  readonly refundedCents: number;
  /** Magnitude of pending outflow in the month (listed, never counted). */
  readonly pendingCents: number;
  /** min(spentCents, budgetCents): the part of spend covered by this month's budget. */
  readonly withinBudgetCents: number;
  /** max(0, spentCents - budgetCents): the "surplus used" portion. */
  readonly overCents: number;
  /** max(0, budgetCents - spentCents): the remainder saved. */
  readonly savedCents: number;
  /** The carried surplus/deficit balance ENTERING the month (the cushion band). */
  readonly rolloverBalanceCents: number;
}

/**
 * Envelope trend series for one envelope (GAP-A). Carries two views:
 *
 *   - `months`: the PocketSmith monthly Trends buckets — per-month budget vs
 *     spend, split into within-budget / surplus-used / saved, with refunds,
 *     pending, and a folded rollover cushion. This is what the detail chart draws.
 *   - `points`: the legacy per-day series (cumulative spend + the flat budget
 *     line + the ISC-16 daily snapshot) retained for any daily consumers.
 *
 * `budgetCents` is the envelope's monthly-equivalent budget; `averageSpentCents`
 * is the mean of the monthly `spentCents` across the window; `carryoverCents` is
 * the opening carryover entering the window (the first month's rollover balance).
 */
export interface TrendResponse {
  readonly envelopeId: string;
  readonly from: string;
  readonly to: string;
  /** The envelope's monthly-equivalent budget (the per-month budget/target line). */
  readonly budgetCents: number;
  /** Mean of the per-month `spentCents` across the window (the average line). */
  readonly averageSpentCents: number;

// ── Net position (master reconciliation, cash − card owed vs total left) ───────

/**
 * The master reconciliation (the whole point of envelope budgeting): the sum of

  /** False when PocketSmith could not be reached (no key, network/auth error). */
  readonly ok: boolean;

  readonly cashOnHandCents: number;
  /** Magnitude of the summed credit-card balances, reported as a positive owed figure. */
  readonly cardOwedCents: number;
  /** Sum of leaf-envelope leftCents plus income leftCents (the budget's "left"). */
  readonly totalLeftCents: number;
  /**
   * The budget's "left" broken down by section. Income is the sum of the income

   * outside the zero-based budget but still move real cash, so their balance is part
   * of the net-position reconciliation (it begins at 0 today and accrues forward).

    readonly income: number;
    readonly saving: number;
    readonly expense: number;
    readonly envelope: number;
    readonly working: number;

  readonly reconciledDeltaCents: number;
  readonly asOf: number;

  readonly message?: string;
}

 * Auth route handlers. Drives the active AuthProvider seam: local PIN sign-in
 * mints a session cookie immediately; cloud email sign-in sends a magic link and
 * the follow-up verify mints the cookie. Neither path leaks which user exists
 * (AuthError is surfaced as a flat 401). The session route reflects the resolved

import { Hono } from "hono";
import type { Container } from "../../composition.ts";
import { AuthError, type BeginSignInInput } from "../../platform/auth.ts";
import type { ApiError, ChangePinRequest, ChangePinResponse, SessionResponse, SignInRequest, SignInResponse, VerifyLinkRequest } from "../contract.ts";
import { clearCookie, resolveSession, sessionCookie, UNAUTHENTICATED } from "../http.ts";

export function registerAuth(api: Hono, container: Container): void {
  const secure = container.config.deployMode === "cloud";

  api.post("/auth/signin", async (c) => {
    const body = (await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Partial<SignInRequest>;

    let input: BeginSignInInput;
    if (body.kind === "pin" && typeof body.pin === "string") {
      input = { kind: "pin", pin: body.pin };
    } else if (body.kind === "email" && typeof body.email === "string") {
      input = { kind: "email", email: body.email };
    } else {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Bad sign-in request.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }

    try {
      const session = await container.auth.beginSignIn(input);
      if (session) {
        // Local PIN: a session was minted immediately. Set the cookie.
        const token = await container.auth.mintToken(session);
        c.header("Set-Cookie", sessionCookie(token, secure));
        const res: SignInResponse = { status: "authenticated", userId: session.userId };
        return c.json(res);
      }
      // Cloud email: link sent, second step (verify) required.
      const res: SignInResponse = { status: "link_sent", userId: null };
      return c.json(res);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof AuthError) {
        const err: ApiError = { error: "Sign-in failed.", code: "auth_failed" };
        return c.json(err, 401);
      }
      throw e;
    }
  });

  api.post("/auth/verify", async (c) => {
    const body = (await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Partial<VerifyLinkRequest>;
    if (typeof body.token !== "string") {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Missing token.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    try {
      const session = await container.auth.completeSignIn(body.token);
      const token = await container.auth.mintToken(session);
      c.header("Set-Cookie", sessionCookie(token, secure));
      const res: SessionResponse = {
        authenticated: true,
        userId: session.userId,
        idleExpiresAt: session.idleExpiresAt,
      };
      return c.json(res);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof AuthError) {
        const err: ApiError = { error: "Verification failed.", code: "auth_failed" };
        return c.json(err, 401);
      }
      throw e;
    }
  });

    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    const res: SessionResponse = session

  });

    if (session) await container.auth.signOut(session);
    c.header("Set-Cookie", clearCookie());
    return c.json({ ok: true } as const);
  });

  // it). The current PIN is re-verified by the AuthProvider with the same scheme
  // sign-in uses; a wrong current PIN or invalid new PIN returns 400 — NEVER 401,
  // which would trip the client idle-lock and sign the user out mid-change.
  api.post("/auth/change-pin", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const body = (await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Partial<ChangePinRequest>;
    if (typeof body.currentPin !== "string" || typeof body.newPin !== "string") {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "currentPin and newPin are required.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    try {
      await container.auth.changePin(body.currentPin, body.newPin);
      const res: ChangePinResponse = { ok: true };
      return c.json(res);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof AuthError) {
        // Never leak whether it was the current PIN or the new PIN policy at 401;
        // surface the specific-but-safe message at 400 so the app stays signed in.
        const err: ApiError = { error: e.message, code: "pin_change_failed" };
        return c.json(err, 400);
      }
      throw e;
    }
  });
}

  BeginSignInInput,
  Session,
  UserId,
} from "../auth.ts";
import { AuthError } from "../auth.ts";
import type { SecretStore } from "../secrets.ts";
import { HmacSessionCodec, readSessionToken, type SessionCodec } from "./session.ts";

/** The single local principal. Local seeds exactly one user over the multi-tenant schema. */
export const LOCAL_USER_ID: UserId = "local";

const IDLE_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000;

export class TailscalePinAuth implements AuthProvider {
  private readonly secrets: SecretStore;
  private readonly codec: SessionCodec;
  private readonly userId: UserId;

  constructor(secrets: SecretStore, codec: SessionCodec = new HmacSessionCodec(), userId: UserId = LOCAL_USER_ID) {
    this.secrets = secrets;
    this.codec = codec;
    this.userId = userId;
  }

    if (input.kind !== "pin") {

    const stored = await this.secrets.get(this.userId, "auth_pin");

    // Refresh an existing PIN session: verify, then slide the idle window.
    const existing = await this.codec.verify(token);
    if (!existing) throw new AuthError("Session invalid or expired.");
    return this.fresh(existing.userId);
  }

  async resolveSession(request: Request): Promise<Session | null> {
    const token = readSessionToken(request);
    if (!token) return null;
    const session = await this.codec.verify(token);
    if (session === null) return null;
    // Idle lock (ISC-39): resolveSession is the authority on idle expiry. A
    // session past its idleExpiresAt is rejected here regardless of whether the
    // injected codec also enforces it, so the server returns 401 and the UI lock
    // engages. Do not slide the window on resolve — only an explicit sign-in /
    // refresh (completeSignIn) mints a fresh deadline.
    if (Date.now() > session.idleExpiresAt) return null;

    // idle window bounds the residual validity. No server state to clear.
  }

   * the new PIN written to the SecretStore. A trivially weak new PIN (fewer than
   * four digits, non-numeric) is refused so the change cannot lower the bar.
   */

  mintToken(session: Session): Promise<string> {
    return this.codec.mint(session);

    const now = Date.now();
    return { userId, issuedAt: now, idleExpiresAt: now + IDLE_MS };

function constantTimeEqual(a: string, b: string): boolean {
  if (a.length !== b.length) return false;
  let diff = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) diff |= a.charCodeAt(i) ^ b.charCodeAt(i);

 * Settings route handlers: exposes deploy mode + per-user sync state, and accepts
 * the per-user PocketSmith developer key. The key is stored through the

 * (ISC-56); the GET only reports whether one is present.

import { Hono } from "hono";
import type { Container } from "../../composition.ts";
import type { ApiError, SetPocketSmithKeyRequest, SetPocketSmithKeyResponse, SettingsResponse } from "../contract.ts";
import { resolveSession, UNAUTHENTICATED } from "../http.ts";

export function registerSettings(api: Hono, container: Container): void {
  api.get("/settings", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const key = await container.secrets.get(session.userId, "pocketsmith_developer_key");
    const lastSyncAt = await container.store.getLastSyncAt(session.userId);
    const res: SettingsResponse = {
      deployMode: container.config.deployMode,
      hasPocketSmithKey: key !== null,
      lastSyncAt,
    };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  api.post("/settings/pocketsmith-key", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const req = (await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Partial<SetPocketSmithKeyRequest>;
    if (typeof req.developerKey !== "string" || req.developerKey.trim().length === 0) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Missing developer key.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    // Stored as per-user secret material; never logged, never echoed (ISC-56).
    await container.secrets.set(session.userId, "pocketsmith_developer_key", req.developerKey);
    const res: SetPocketSmithKeyResponse = { ok: true };
    return c.json(res);
  });
}

2	 * Reconcile route handler (ISC-37, ISC-43): confirms the Credit Card Holding
3	 * envelope matches the entered NAB statement balance as at the statement date,
4	 * and reports the drift (the named euphoric tripwire). Scoped to the user.

6	
7	import { Hono } from "hono";
8	import type { Container } from "../../composition.ts";
9	import type { Services } from "../services.ts";
10	import type {
11	  ApiError,
12	  LastReconcileResponse,
13	  NetPositionResponse,
14	  ReconcileBalanceLine,
15	  ReconcileBalancesResponse,
16	  ReconcileConfirmation,
17	  ReconcileConfirmRequest,

22	import type { ReconciliationRecord } from "../../budget/ports.ts";
23	import { currentPeriod, resolveSession, UNAUTHENTICATED } from "../http.ts";
24	import { PocketSmithClient } from "../../ingest/client.ts";
25	import { buildBalanceLines, type ReconcileAccount } from "../../reconcile/balances.ts";
26	
27	export function registerReconcile(api: Hono, container: Container, services: Services): void {
28	  api.post("/reconcile", async (c) => {
29	    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
30	    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
31	    const req = (await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as ReconcileRequest;
32	    const asOf = req.statementDate;
33	    const holdingCents = await services.envelopes.holdingBalance(
34	      session.userId,
35	      asOf || undefined,
36	    );
37	    const nabStatementCents = req.nabStatementCents ?? 0;
38	    const driftCents = holdingCents - nabStatementCents;
39	    const res: ReconcileResponse = {
40	      holdingCents,
41	      nabStatementCents,
42	      driftCents,
43	      matched: driftCents === 0,
44	    };
45	    return c.json(res);
46	  });
47	
48	  /**
49	   * Persist a reconciliation confirmation (Phase 4, ISC-37). The holding balance
50	   * and drift are recomputed server-side from the engine — the client-sent NAB
51	   * figure is the only input trusted — so a recorded confirmation reflects the
52	   * system's own numbers, never a fabricated or client-forged figure (ISC-83).
53	   */
54	  const toRecordResponse = (rec: ReconciliationRecord): ReconcileConfirmation => ({
55	    id: rec.id,
56	    confirmedAt: rec.ts,
57	    statementDate: rec.statementDate,
58	    holdingCents: rec.holdingCents,
59	    nabStatementCents: rec.nabStatementCents,
60	    driftCents: rec.driftCents,
61	    matched: rec.matched,
62	  });
63	
64	  api.post("/reconcile/confirm", async (c) => {
65	    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
66	    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
67	    const req = (await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Partial<ReconcileConfirmRequest>;
68	    if (typeof req.nabStatementCents !== "number" || typeof req.statementDate !== "string") {
69	      const err: ApiError = { error: "nabStatementCents and statementDate are required.", code: "bad_request" };
70	      return c.json(err, 400);
71	    }
72	    const holdingCents = await services.envelopes.holdingBalance(
73	      session.userId,
74	      req.statementDate || undefined,
75	    );
76	    const driftCents = holdingCents - req.nabStatementCents;
77	    const rec: ReconciliationRecord = {
78	      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
79	      ts: Date.now(),
80	      statementDate: req.statementDate,
81	      holdingCents,
82	      nabStatementCents: req.nabStatementCents,
83	      driftCents,
84	      matched: driftCents === 0,
85	    };
86	    await container.store.appendReconciliation(session.userId, rec);
87	    const res: ReconcileConfirmResponse = { ok: true, confirmation: toRecordResponse(rec) };
88	    return c.json(res);
89	  });
90	
91	  api.get("/reconcile/last", async (c) => {
92	    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
93	    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
94	    const latest = await container.store.getLatestReconciliation(session.userId);
95	    const res: LastReconcileResponse = { confirmation: latest ? toRecordResponse(latest) : null };
96	    return c.json(res);
97	  });
98	
99	  /**
100	   * Penny vs PocketSmith balance reconciliation (P0 trust surface). Pulls the
101	   * tenant's PocketSmith account balances live and compares each to Penny's
102	   * computed per-account figure, anchored on the Credit Card Holding vs card
103	   * tripwire (ISC-37, ISC-43) and generalised across every tracked account. On
104	   * any failure (no key, network/auth) it returns ok:false with a key-free reason
105	   * so the screen degrades to a clear "could not reach PocketSmith" state rather
106	   * than erroring. The developer key is resolved through the SecretStore inside
107	   * forUser and never reaches the response (ISC-56).
108	   */
109	  api.get("/reconcile/balances", async (c) => {
110	    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
111	    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
112	
113	    const fail = (message: string): ReconcileBalancesResponse => ({
114	      ok: false,
115	      lines: [],
116	      cardDriftCents: 0,
117	      asOf: Date.now(),
118	      message,
119	    });
120	
121	    try {
122	      const client = await PocketSmithClient.forUser(container.secrets, session.userId);
123	      const user = await client.getAuthenticatedUser();
124	      if (user.id === undefined || user.id === null) {
125	        return c.json(fail("PocketSmith did not return an account id."));
126	      }
127	      const [accounts, txs] = await Promise.all([
128	        client.listTransactionAccounts(user.id),
129	        container.store.listTransactions(session.userId),
130	      ]);
131	      const accIn: ReconcileAccount[] = accounts.map((a) => ({
132	        id: String(a.id),
133	        title: a.name ?? `Account ${a.id}`,
134	        type: a.type ?? "",
135	        currentBalance: a.current_balance,
136	      }));
137	      const lines: ReconcileBalanceLine[] = buildBalanceLines(
138	        accIn,
139	        txs.map((t) => ({ accountId: t.accountId, amountCents: t.amountCents, isPending: t.isPending })),
140	        services.engineConfig.nabCardAccountIds,
141	      );
142	      const cardDriftCents = lines
143	        .filter((l) => l.kind === "card")
144	        .reduce((s, l) => s + l.driftCents, 0);
145	      const res: ReconcileBalancesResponse = { ok: true, lines, cardDriftCents, asOf: Date.now() };
146	      return c.json(res);
147	    } catch {
148	      // Never surface the underlying error verbatim: it could narrow the key.
149	      return c.json(fail("Could not reach PocketSmith. Check the developer key in Settings."));
150	    }
151	  });
152	
153	  /**
154	   * Net-position master reconciliation (the whole point of envelope budgeting).
155	   * Pulls the tenant's live PocketSmith account balances and reconciles the real
156	   * liquid position (cash on hand minus what is owed on credit cards) against the
157	   * budget's total "left" (sum of leaf-envelope leftCents plus income leftCents).
158	   *
159	   * Account classification mirrors the balances surface but is coarser by design:
160	   * any account whose type contains "credit" is a card (its balance is negative,
161	   * so we report the owed amount as a positive magnitude); everything else
162	   * (bank, cash) is cash on hand. Only LEAF envelopes are summed so the rolled-up
163	   * parent rows are not double-counted.
164	   *
165	   * On any PocketSmith failure it returns ok:false with a key-free reason (ISC-56),
166	   * mirroring the balances handler, so the widget degrades cleanly.
167	   */
168	  api.get("/net-position", async (c) => {
169	    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
170	    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
171	
172	    const fail = (message: string): NetPositionResponse => ({
173	      ok: false,
174	      cashOnHandCents: 0,
175	      cardOwedCents: 0,
176	      totalLeftCents: 0,
177	      sectionLeftCents: { income: 0, saving: 0, expense: 0, envelope: 0, working: 0 },
178	      reconciledDeltaCents: 0,
179	      asOf: Date.now(),
180	      message,
181	    });
182	
183	    // Decimal-dollar PocketSmith balance to integer cents, rounding float dust.
184	    const toCents = (amount: number | undefined | null): number =>
185	      amount === undefined || amount === null || Number.isNaN(amount) ? 0 : Math.round(amount * 100);
186	
187	    try {
188	      const client = await PocketSmithClient.forUser(container.secrets, session.userId);
189	      const user = await client.getAuthenticatedUser();
190	      if (user.id === undefined || user.id === null) {
191	        return c.json(fail("PocketSmith did not return an account id."));
192	      }
193	      const accounts = await client.listTransactionAccounts(user.id);
194	
195	      let cashOnHandCents = 0;

 * Reconcile route handler (ISC-37, ISC-43): confirms the Credit Card Holding
 * envelope matches the entered NAB statement balance as at the statement date,
 * and reports the drift (the named euphoric tripwire). Scoped to the user.
 */

import { Hono } from "hono";
import type { Container } from "../../composition.ts";
import type { Services } from "../services.ts";
import type {
  ApiError,
  LastReconcileResponse,
  NetPositionResponse,
  ReconcileBalanceLine,
  ReconcileBalancesResponse,
  ReconcileConfirmation,
  ReconcileConfirmRequest,
  ReconcileConfirmResponse,
  ReconcileRequest,
  ReconcileResponse,
} from "../contract.ts";
import type { ReconciliationRecord } from "../../budget/ports.ts";
import { currentPeriod, resolveSession, UNAUTHENTICATED } from "../http.ts";
import { PocketSmithClient } from "../../ingest/client.ts";
import { buildBalanceLines, type ReconcileAccount } from "../../reconcile/balances.ts";

export function registerReconcile(api: Hono, container: Container, services: Services): void {
  api.post("/reconcile", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const req = (await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as ReconcileRequest;
    const asOf = req.statementDate;
    const holdingCents = await services.envelopes.holdingBalance(
      session.userId,
      asOf || undefined,
    );
    const nabStatementCents = req.nabStatementCents ?? 0;
    const driftCents = holdingCents - nabStatementCents;
    const res: ReconcileResponse = {
      holdingCents,
      nabStatementCents,
      driftCents,
      matched: driftCents === 0,
    };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  /**
   * Persist a reconciliation confirmation (Phase 4, ISC-37). The holding balance
   * and drift are recomputed server-side from the engine — the client-sent NAB
   * figure is the only input trusted — so a recorded confirmation reflects the
   * system's own numbers, never a fabricated or client-forged figure (ISC-83).
   */
  const toRecordResponse = (rec: ReconciliationRecord): ReconcileConfirmation => ({
    id: rec.id,
    confirmedAt: rec.ts,
    statementDate: rec.statementDate,
    holdingCents: rec.holdingCents,
    nabStatementCents: rec.nabStatementCents,
    driftCents: rec.driftCents,
    matched: rec.matched,
  });

  api.post("/reconcile/confirm", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const req = (await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Partial<ReconcileConfirmRequest>;
    if (typeof req.nabStatementCents !== "number" || typeof req.statementDate !== "string") {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "nabStatementCents and statementDate are required.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    const holdingCents = await services.envelopes.holdingBalance(
      session.userId,
      req.statementDate || undefined,
    );
    const driftCents = holdingCents - req.nabStatementCents;
    const rec: ReconciliationRecord = {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      ts: Date.now(),
      statementDate: req.statementDate,
      holdingCents,
      nabStatementCents: req.nabStatementCents,
      driftCents,
      matched: driftCents === 0,
    };
    await container.store.appendReconciliation(session.userId, rec);
    const res: ReconcileConfirmResponse = { ok: true, confirmation: toRecordResponse(rec) };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  api.get("/reconcile/last", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const latest = await container.store.getLatestReconciliation(session.userId);
    const res: LastReconcileResponse = { confirmation: latest ? toRecordResponse(latest) : null };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  /**
   * Penny vs PocketSmith balance reconciliation (P0 trust surface). Pulls the
   * tenant's PocketSmith account balances live and compares each to Penny's
   * computed per-account figure, anchored on the Credit Card Holding vs card
   * tripwire (ISC-37, ISC-43) and generalised across every tracked account. On
   * any failure (no key, network/auth) it returns ok:false with a key-free reason
   * so the screen degrades to a clear "could not reach PocketSmith" state rather
   * than erroring. The developer key is resolved through the SecretStore inside
   * forUser and never reaches the response (ISC-56).
   */
  api.get("/reconcile/balances", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);

    const fail = (message: string): ReconcileBalancesResponse => ({
      ok: false,
      lines: [],
      cardDriftCents: 0,
      asOf: Date.now(),
      message,
    });

    try {
      const client = await PocketSmithClient.forUser(container.secrets, session.userId);
      const user = await client.getAuthenticatedUser();
      if (user.id === undefined || user.id === null) {
        return c.json(fail("PocketSmith did not return an account id."));
      }
      const [accounts, txs] = await Promise.all([
        client.listTransactionAccounts(user.id),
        container.store.listTransactions(session.userId),
      ]);
      const accIn: ReconcileAccount[] = accounts.map((a) => ({
        id: String(a.id),
        title: a.name ?? `Account ${a.id}`,
        type: a.type ?? "",
        currentBalance: a.current_balance,
      }));
      const lines: ReconcileBalanceLine[] = buildBalanceLines(
        accIn,
        txs.map((t) => ({ accountId: t.accountId, amountCents: t.amountCents, isPending: t.isPending })),
        services.engineConfig.nabCardAccountIds,
      );
      const cardDriftCents = lines
        .filter((l) => l.kind === "card")
        .reduce((s, l) => s + l.driftCents, 0);
      const res: ReconcileBalancesResponse = { ok: true, lines, cardDriftCents, asOf: Date.now() };
      return c.json(res);
    } catch {
      // Never surface the underlying error verbatim: it could narrow the key.
      return c.json(fail("Could not reach PocketSmith. Check the developer key in Settings."));
    }
  });

  /**
   * Net-position master reconciliation (the whole point of envelope budgeting).
   * Pulls the tenant's live PocketSmith account balances and reconciles the real
   * liquid position (cash on hand minus what is owed on credit cards) against the
   * budget's total "left" (sum of leaf-envelope leftCents plus income leftCents).
   *
   * Account classification mirrors the balances surface but is coarser by design:
   * any account whose type contains "credit" is a card (its balance is negative,
   * so we report the owed amount as a positive magnitude); everything else
   * (bank, cash) is cash on hand. Only LEAF envelopes are summed so the rolled-up
   * parent rows are not double-counted.
   *
   * On any PocketSmith failure it returns ok:false with a key-free reason (ISC-56),
   * mirroring the balances handler, so the widget degrades cleanly.
   */
  api.get("/net-position", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);

    const fail = (message: string): NetPositionResponse => ({
      ok: false,
      cashOnHandCents: 0,
      cardOwedCents: 0,
      totalLeftCents: 0,
      sectionLeftCents: { income: 0, saving: 0, expense: 0, envelope: 0, working: 0 },
      reconciledDeltaCents: 0,
      asOf: Date.now(),
      message,
    });

    // Decimal-dollar PocketSmith balance to integer cents, rounding float dust.
    const toCents = (amount: number | undefined | null): number =>
      amount === undefined || amount === null || Number.isNaN(amount) ? 0 : Math.round(amount * 100);

    try {
      const client = await PocketSmithClient.forUser(container.secrets, session.userId);
      const user = await client.getAuthenticatedUser();
      if (user.id === undefined || user.id === null) {
        return c.json(fail("PocketSmith did not return an account id."));
      }
      const accounts = await client.listTransactionAccounts(user.id);

      let cashOnHandCents = 0;
      let cardBalanceCents = 0; // signed; cards report a negative balance.
      for (const a of accounts) {
        const isCard = (a.type ?? "").toLowerCase().includes("credit");
        const cents = toCents(a.current_balance);
        if (isCard) cardBalanceCents += cents;
        else cashOnHandCents += cents;
      }
      // Card balances are negative; owed is the magnitude reported positive.
      const cardOwedCents = Math.abs(cardBalanceCents);

      // Total "left": sum of LEAF expense/saving/envelope rows (a leaf is a row no
      // other row names as its parentId) plus the income envelopes' contribution.
      const grid = await services.envelopes.getGrid(session.userId, currentPeriod());
      const parentIds = new Set(
        grid.rows.map((r) => r.parentId).filter((p): p is string => p !== null),
      );
      // Working envelopes sit outside the ZERO-BASE budget but still move real cash,
      // so they ARE part of the net-position reconciliation as their own section line
      // (their balance begins at 0 today and accrues forward).
      const leaves = grid.rows.filter((r) => !parentIds.has(r.id));
      const leafLeftCents = leaves.reduce((s, r) => s + r.leftCents, 0);
      // Income contributes carryover + surplus/deficit (variance), NOT carryover +
      // received. The budgeted income is already represented in the expense envelopes'
      // allocations (zero-base), so including the full received here would double-count
      // the budget. carry + (received - budget) makes the budgets cancel and the sum
      // reconcile to cash - card. The income row's own "left" stays carry + received.
      const incomeLeftCents = grid.income.reduce((s, i) => s + i.carryoverCents + i.varianceCents, 0);
      const totalLeftCents = leafLeftCents + incomeLeftCents;

      // Per-section "left": income from the income envelopes, and each spending
      // type from its leaf rows, so the four figures sum to totalLeftCents.
      const leftByType = (type: string): number =>
        leaves.filter((r) => r.type === type).reduce((s, r) => s + r.leftCents, 0);
      const sectionLeftCents = {
        income: incomeLeftCents,
        saving: leftByType("saving"),
        expense: leftByType("expense"),
        envelope: leftByType("envelope"),
        working: leftByType("working"),
      };

      const reconciledDeltaCents = cashOnHandCents - cardOwedCents - totalLeftCents;
      const res: NetPositionResponse = {
        ok: true,
        cashOnHandCents,
        cardOwedCents,
        totalLeftCents,
        sectionLeftCents,
        reconciledDeltaCents,
        asOf: Date.now(),
      };
      return c.json(res);
    } catch {
      // Never surface the underlying error verbatim: it could narrow the key.
      return c.json(fail("Could not reach PocketSmith. Check the developer key in Settings."));
    }
  });
}

import { Hono } from "hono";
import type { Container } from "../../composition.ts";

import { PocketSmithClient } from "../../ingest/client.ts";

export function registerSync(api: Hono, container: Container): void {

 * Service composition for the route layer. Builds the envelope engine, the
 * budget engine, and the Pulse source from the container's resolved store, and
 * resolves the engine wiring constants (Holding envelope id, NAB card accounts)
 * from configuration.
 *
 * The engine config is read from environment here, NOT from DEPLOY_MODE — these
 * are per-deployment data ids, not deployment-mode behaviour, so reading them
 * outside the composition root does not violate ISC-51. The store is already
 * typed BudgetStore on the container, so the engines are constructed without an
 * unsafe cast.
 */

import type { Container } from "../composition.ts";
import type { EngineConfig } from "../envelope/ports.ts";
import { EnvelopeService } from "../envelope/service.ts";
import { BudgetService } from "../budget/service.ts";
import { StorePulseSource } from "../pulse/source.ts";

export interface Services {
  readonly envelopes: EnvelopeService;
  readonly budget: BudgetService;
  readonly pulse: StorePulseSource;
  readonly engineConfig: EngineConfig;
}

/** Resolve the engine wiring constants from env, with local-sensible defaults. */
export function resolveEngineConfig(
  env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env,
): EngineConfig {
  const nab = (env.PENNY_NAB_ACCOUNT_IDS ?? env.PENNY_NAB_ACCOUNT_ID ?? "acc-nab")
    .split(",")
    .map((s) => s.trim())
    .filter((s) => s.length > 0);
  const holding = env.PENNY_HOLDING_ENVELOPE_ID?.trim();
  return {
    holdingEnvelopeId: holding && holding.length > 0 ? holding : null,
    nabCardAccountIds: nab,
  };
}

/** Construct the per-request-stateless services once from the container. */
export function buildServices(container: Container): Services {
  const engineConfig = resolveEngineConfig();
  const envelopes = new EnvelopeService(container.store, engineConfig);
  const budget = new BudgetService(container.store, envelopes);

  const sourceOpts: { nabAccountId?: string; holdingMatch?: string } = {};
  const nab = process.env.PENNY_NAB_ACCOUNT_ID?.trim();
  const holdingMatch = process.env.PENNY_HOLDING_MATCH?.trim();
  if (nab) sourceOpts.nabAccountId = nab;
  if (holdingMatch) sourceOpts.holdingMatch = holdingMatch;
  const pulse = new StorePulseSource(container.store, sourceOpts);

  return { envelopes, budget, pulse, engineConfig };
}

 * Secret hygiene (ISC-56).
 *
 * A PocketSmith developer key must never appear as plaintext at rest, in env
 * files, in git, or in logs. The SecretStore handles at-rest encryption; this
 * module handles the other half — making sure a key value never lands in a log
 * line or an error message even by accident.

 *   - `installLogRedaction(getSecrets)` wraps console.* so anything printed is
 *     scrubbed of registered secret values first.
 *   - `containsPlaintext(text, secret)` is the assertion used by the hygiene
 *     test to prove a value is absent.
 *
 * Nothing here ever prints a secret; the redactor only ever removes them.
 */

const REDACTED = "[REDACTED]";

/** Escape a string for safe use inside a RegExp. */
function escapeRegExp(s: string): string {
  return s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
}

/**
 * Mask every non-trivial secret value found in `text`. Secrets shorter than 8
 * chars are ignored to avoid masking incidental substrings; real PocketSmith
 * developer keys are long opaque tokens.
 */
export function redact(text: string, secrets: readonly (string | null | undefined)[]): string {
  let out = text;
  for (const secret of secrets) {
    if (!secret || secret.length < 8) continue;
    out = out.replace(new RegExp(escapeRegExp(secret), "g"), REDACTED);
  }
  return out;
}

/** True if `secret` appears verbatim in `text`. Used by the hygiene assertions. */
export function containsPlaintext(text: string, secret: string): boolean {
  if (!secret) return false;
  return text.includes(secret);
}

/**
 * Wrap console.log/info/warn/error/debug so every argument is redacted of any
 * currently-registered secret before it is written. `getSecrets` is called per
 * log so freshly-loaded keys are covered. Returns a disposer restoring the
 * original methods.
 */
export function installLogRedaction(getSecrets: () => readonly (string | null | undefined)[]): () => void {
  const methods = ["log", "info", "warn", "error", "debug"] as const;
  const originals = new Map<(typeof methods)[number], (...args: unknown[]) => void>();

  for (const m of methods) {
    const original = console[m].bind(console) as (...args: unknown[]) => void;
    originals.set(m, original);
    console[m] = ((...args: unknown[]) => {
      const secrets = getSecrets();
      const scrubbed = args.map((a) =>
        typeof a === "string" ? redact(a, secrets) : redactDeep(a, secrets),
      );
      original(...scrubbed);
    }) as typeof console.log;
  }

  return () => {
    for (const m of methods) {
      const original = originals.get(m);
      if (original) console[m] = original as typeof console.log;
    }
  };
}

/** Best-effort redaction of non-string log arguments via JSON round-trip. */
function redactDeep(value: unknown, secrets: readonly (string | null | undefined)[]): unknown {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return value;
  if (typeof value === "object") {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(redact(JSON.stringify(value), secrets));
    } catch {
      return value;
    }
  }
  return value;
}

import { loadConfig, type AppConfig } from "./platform/config.ts";
import type { AuthProvider } from "./platform/auth.ts";
import type { SecretStore } from "./platform/secrets.ts";
import type { BudgetStore } from "./budget/ports.ts";

export interface Container {
  readonly config: AppConfig;
  /**
   * The persistence adapter, typed at the richest business surface (BudgetStore =
   * Store + the envelope and budget extras). Both concrete adapters implement it,
   * so handlers can construct the engines without an unsafe cast. The composition

  readonly store: BudgetStore;
  readonly secrets: SecretStore;
  readonly auth: AuthProvider;
}

export async function buildContainer(): Promise<Container> {
  const config = loadConfig();

  // --- Store adapter ---
  const store: BudgetStore =

      ? new (await import("./store/postgres.ts")).PostgresStore(config.postgresUrl!)
      : new (await import("./store/sqlite.ts")).SqliteStore(config.sqlitePath);
  await store.migrate();

  // --- SecretStore adapter ---
  const secrets: SecretStore =
    config.deployMode === "cloud"
      ? new (await import("./platform/secrets/cloud.ts")).KmsSecretStore(store)
      : new (await import("./platform/secrets/local.ts")).LocalSecretStore();

  // --- AuthProvider adapter ---
  const auth: AuthProvider =
    config.deployMode === "cloud"
      ? new (await import("./platform/auth/cloud.ts")).MagicLinkAuth(store, secrets)
      : new (await import("./platform/auth/local.ts")).TailscalePinAuth(secrets);

  return { config, store, secrets, auth };
}

import type { UserId } from "./auth.ts";

/** Named secrets a tenant can hold. Extend as needed; PocketSmith dev key is the first. */
export type SecretName = "pocketsmith_developer_key" | "auth_pin";

export interface SecretStore {
  /** Fetch a secret for a tenant. Returns null if unset. Never logs the value. */
  get(userId: UserId, name: SecretName): Promise<string | null>;

  set(userId: UserId, name: SecretName, value: string): Promise<void>;

  /** Remove a secret for a tenant (offboarding). */
  delete(userId: UserId, name: SecretName): Promise<void>;
}

/** Convenience: resolve the PocketSmith X-Developer-Key for a tenant, or throw if missing. */
export async function requirePocketSmithKey(store: SecretStore, userId: UserId): Promise<string> {
  const key = await store.get(userId, "pocketsmith_developer_key");
  if (!key) throw new Error(`No PocketSmith developer key configured for user ${userId}`);
  return key;

    const realLog = console.log;
    console.log = ((...args: unknown[]) => captured.push(args.join(" "))) as typeof console.log;

    expect(containsPlaintext(captured[0] ?? "", SAMPLE_KEY)).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("LocalSecretStore writes ciphertext, never plaintext (ISC-56)", () => {
  const vault = join(tmpdir(), `penny-vault-${process.pid}.enc`);
  const keyFile = join(tmpdir(), `penny-vault-${process.pid}.key`);

  afterAll(async () => {
    await rm(vault, { force: true });
    await rm(keyFile, { force: true });
  });

  test("the key round-trips but is absent from the on-disk vault", async () => {
    const store = new LocalSecretStore(vault, keyFile);
    await store.set("nick", "pocketsmith_developer_key", SAMPLE_KEY);
    expect(await store.get("nick", "pocketsmith_developer_key")).toBe(SAMPLE_KEY);

    const onDisk = await Bun.file(vault).text();
    expect(containsPlaintext(onDisk, SAMPLE_KEY)).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("no committed secret material (ISC-56)", () => {
  test("no high-entropy secret literal on a key/secret line in src/scripts", async () => {
    // A leaked developer key looks like a quoted run of >= 32 token chars sitting
    // on a line that also names a secret. Requiring the secret context avoids
    // flagging legitimate high-entropy constants like the pinned OpenAPI git SHA.
    const tokenLiteral = /['"`][A-Za-z0-9+/_-]{32,}['"`]/;
    const secretContext = /\b(secret|developer.?key|api.?key|password|credential|token|x-developer-key)\b/i;
    const glob = new Glob("{src,scripts}/**/*.ts");
    const offenders: string[] = [];
    for await (const rel of glob.scan({ cwd: REPO_ROOT })) {
      const text = await Bun.file(join(REPO_ROOT, rel)).text();
      for (const line of text.split("\n")) {
        if (tokenLiteral.test(line) && secretContext.test(line)) {
          offenders.push(`${rel}: ${line.trim().slice(0, 80)}`);
        }
      }
    }
    expect(offenders).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("no committed .env file carries a developer key", async () => {
    const glob = new Glob("**/.env*");
    const offenders: string[] = [];
    for await (const rel of glob.scan({ cwd: REPO_ROOT, dot: true })) {
      if (rel.includes("node_modules")) continue;
      const text = await Bun.file(join(REPO_ROOT, rel)).text();
      if (/developer.?key/i.test(text)) offenders.push(rel);
    }
    expect(offenders).toEqual([]);
  });
});

 *   bun run sync

 * just pulls everything changed since the last successful run (ISC-5).

 * (ISC-50/51).

import { buildContainer } from "../src/composition.ts";
import { PocketSmithClient } from "../src/ingest/client.ts";
import { syncWithFailureTracking } from "../src/ingest/sync.ts";
import { FileFailureTracker, PulseTelegramAlerter } from "../src/ingest/alert.ts";

const userId = process.env.PENNY_USER_ID ?? "local";

const container = await buildContainer();

  ensureUser?: (id: string, email?: string) => Promise<void>;
};

}

const client = await PocketSmithClient.forUser(container.secrets, userId);

console.log(`[sync] user=${userId} starting incremental sync`);
const outcome = await syncWithFailureTracking(
  { store: container.store, client, userId },
  { failures: new FileFailureTracker(), alerter: new PulseTelegramAlerter() },
);

await container.store.close();

if (outcome.ok && outcome.result) {
  const r = outcome.result;
  console.log(
    `[sync] done: ${r.transactions} transactions across ${r.pages} pages, ` +
      `updated_since=${r.updatedSince ?? "(first run)"}, completed ${r.completedAt}`,
  );
  process.exit(0);
}

console.error(
  `[sync] FAILED (${outcome.consecutiveFailures} in a row` +
    `${outcome.alerted ? ", alert raised" : ""}): ${describe(outcome.error)}`,
);
process.exit(1);

function describe(error: unknown): string {
  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
}

export class EnvelopeService {
  constructor(
    private readonly store: EnvelopeStore,
    private readonly config: EngineConfig,
  ) {}

  private async event(
    userId: UserId,
    kind: string,
    payload: unknown,
    correlationId = uuid(),
  ): Promise<void> {
    await this.store.appendEvent(userId, {
      id: uuid(),
      ts: Date.now(),
      actor: "ui",
      correlationId,
      kind,
      payloadJson: JSON.stringify(payload),
    });
  }

  /** Create or replace an envelope, persisting the full tree row (ISC-18, ISC-73). */
  async upsertEnvelope(userId: UserId, input: EnvelopeInput): Promise<void> {
    await this.store.upsertEnvelope(userId, toStoreEnvelope(input));
    await this.event(userId, "envelope.upsert", input);
  }

  /**
   * Manually reset an envelope's carried starting balance to a chosen value, e.g.
   * to reconcile against the bank. Works for income and expense/saving/envelope
   * envelopes alike. The change is appended to the audit log as a traceable
   * "carryover.reset" event with the before/after values (ISC-15), and today
   * becomes the new rollover-start.
   */
  async resetCarryover(
    userId: UserId,
    envelopeId: string,
    newCarryoverCents: number,
  ): Promise<{ beforeCents: number; afterCents: number }> {
    const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const incomes = await this.store.listIncomeEnvelopes(userId);
    const isIncome = incomes.some((i) => i.id === envelopeId);
    let beforeCents = 0;
    if (isIncome) {
      const carrys = await this.store.listIncomeCarryover(userId);
      beforeCents = carrys.find((c) => c.incomeEnvelopeId === envelopeId)?.carryoverCents ?? 0;
      await this.store.setIncomeCarryover(userId, envelopeId, newCarryoverCents, today);
    } else {
      const carrys = await this.store.listEnvelopeCarryover(userId);
      beforeCents = carrys.find((c) => c.envelopeId === envelopeId)?.carryoverCents ?? 0;
      await this.store.setEnvelopeCarryover(userId, envelopeId, newCarryoverCents, today);
    }
    await this.event(userId, "carryover.reset", { envelopeId, beforeCents, afterCents: newCarryoverCents, on: today });
    return { beforeCents, afterCents: newCarryoverCents };
  }

/**
 * One persisted reconciliation confirmation (Phase 4). Append-only: the user has

 * holding balance and drift are computed server-side at write time, never taken
 * from the client, so a stored record reflects the engine's own figure.
 */
export interface ReconciliationRecord {
  readonly id: string;
  /** Epoch millis the confirmation was recorded. */
  readonly ts: number;
  readonly statementDate: string;
  readonly holdingCents: number;
  readonly nabStatementCents: number;
  readonly driftCents: number;
  readonly matched: boolean;
}

/** Reads/writes the budget engine needs beyond the envelope store. */

  listTemplate(userId: UserId): Promise<BudgetTemplate[]>;

  appendBudgetHistory(userId: UserId, change: BudgetChange): Promise<void>;

  appendMovement(userId: UserId, movement: MoneyMovement): Promise<void>;

}

 * Change-PIN unit tests (Phase 4, ISC-52).
 *
 * Proves the change-PIN path reuses the exact sign-in verification (no weaker
 * scheme), rejects a wrong current PIN without mutating the stored PIN, accepts
 * a valid change, refuses a trivially weak new PIN, and is refused in cloud mode.
 */

import { describe, test, expect } from "bun:test";
import type { Store } from "../src/platform/store.ts";
import { TailscalePinAuth, LOCAL_USER_ID } from "../src/platform/auth/local.ts";
import { MagicLinkAuth } from "../src/platform/auth/cloud.ts";
import { HmacSessionCodec } from "../src/platform/auth/session.ts";
import { AuthError } from "../src/platform/auth.ts";
import { MemorySecretStore, FIXED_SESSION_KEY } from "./helpers.ts";

async function makeLocal() {
  const secrets = new MemorySecretStore();
  await secrets.set(LOCAL_USER_ID, "auth_pin", "8421");
  const auth = new TailscalePinAuth(secrets, new HmacSessionCodec(FIXED_SESSION_KEY));
  return { auth, secrets };
}

describe("TailscalePinAuth.changePin (local)", () => {
  test("a correct current PIN changes to the new PIN", async () => {
    const { auth, secrets } = await makeLocal();
    await auth.changePin("8421", "1357");
    // Stored PIN is the new one, verified through the same beginSignIn scheme.
    expect(await secrets.get(LOCAL_USER_ID, "auth_pin")).toBe("1357");
    const session = await auth.beginSignIn({ kind: "pin", pin: "1357" });
    expect(session?.userId).toBe(LOCAL_USER_ID);
    await expect(auth.beginSignIn({ kind: "pin", pin: "8421" })).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(AuthError);
  });

  test("a wrong current PIN is rejected and the stored PIN is unchanged", async () => {
    const { auth, secrets } = await makeLocal();
    await expect(auth.changePin("0000", "1357")).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(AuthError);
    // The stored PIN must NOT have changed.
    expect(await secrets.get(LOCAL_USER_ID, "auth_pin")).toBe("8421");
    const session = await auth.beginSignIn({ kind: "pin", pin: "8421" });
    expect(session?.userId).toBe(LOCAL_USER_ID);
  });

  test("a trivially weak new PIN is refused (cannot lower the bar)", async () => {
    const { auth, secrets } = await makeLocal();
    await expect(auth.changePin("8421", "12")).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(AuthError);
    await expect(auth.changePin("8421", "abcd")).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(AuthError);
    // Wrong-length/format new PIN leaves the current one in place.
    expect(await secrets.get(LOCAL_USER_ID, "auth_pin")).toBe("8421");
  });
});

describe("MagicLinkAuth.changePin (cloud)", () => {
  test("PIN change is refused in cloud (email) mode", async () => {
    const auth = new MagicLinkAuth({ ensureUser: async () => {} } as unknown as Store, new MemorySecretStore(), {
      codec: new HmacSessionCodec(FIXED_SESSION_KEY),
    });
    await expect(auth.changePin("8421", "1357")).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(AuthError);
  });
});

{"parentUuid":"518ce991-3ce7-49aa-ac6d-1e8086870af4","isSidechain":true,"agentId":"a02ab3a7b4621aa3c","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CcyW2ZYfMpcMhA1pRDLfg","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_011SoTmCSt1HCZkzaQ7Mj8SZ","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/nicholas-wood/Documents/workspace/projects/envelope-os/src/platform/time.ts","content":"/**
 * Timezone-correct "now" derivations. Penny's budget periods are calendar
 * months in the USER'S timezone (Australia/Melbourne by default), not UTC:
 * late on the last evening of a Melbourne month, UTC is still the old month,
 * and deriving the period from getUTC* books transactions and allocations

 * Both helpers take the IANA timezone explicitly (from AppConfig.timezone) so
 * this module reads no environment and stays trivially testable: pass any tz
 * and any instant and assert the local date that falls out.

import type { Period } from "../domain/types.ts";

/**
 * The date (YYYY-MM-DD) at `now` in the given IANA timezone. en-CA formats
 * dates as YYYY-MM-DD natively, so this needs no manual part reassembly.
 */
export function todayISO(tz: string, now: Date = new Date()): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", {
    timeZone: tz,
    year: "numeric",
    month: "2-digit",
    day: "2-digit",
  }).format(now);
}

/** The current calendar-month period at `now` in the given IANA timezone. */
export function currentPeriod(tz: string, now: Date = new Date()): Period {
  const iso = todayISO(tz, now);
  return { year: Number(iso.slice(0, 4)), month: Number(iso.slice(5, 7)) };
}
