export function sessionCookie(token: string, secure: boolean): string {
  const attrs = [
    `${SESSION_COOKIE}=${token}`,
    "Path=/",
    "HttpOnly",
    "SameSite=Strict",
    `Max-Age=${IDLE_MAX_AGE_S}`,
  ];
  if (secure) attrs.push("Secure");
  return attrs.join("; ");
}

/** Build the Set-Cookie value that clears the session cookie on sign-out. */
export function clearCookie(): string {
  return `${SESSION_COOKIE}=; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=0`;
}

 * ISC-76) so a freshly opened month is never blank without any manual step.

import { Hono } from "hono";
import type { Context } from "hono";
import type { Container } from "../../composition.ts";
import type { Services } from "../services.ts";
import type { ApiError, MoveMoneyResponse, DistributeResponse, CreateEnvelopeResponse, SetCarryoverResponse, ArchiveEnvelopeResponse, ArchivedEnvelopesResponse, SetRolloverResponse, EditEnvelopeResponse, MovementsResponse, MovementView } from "../contract.ts";
import type { BudgetPeriod } from "../../domain/types.ts";
import { currentPeriod, resolveSession, UNAUTHENTICATED } from "../http.ts";
import { todayISO } from "../../platform/time.ts";
import { monthBounds, periodRange, resolveNamedPeriod, rangeFromDates, type NamedPeriod } from "../../envelope/period.ts";
import {
  parseBody,
  moveMoneySchema,
  distributeSchema,
  createEnvelopeSchema,
  editEnvelopeSchema,
  setCarryoverSchema,
  archiveEnvelopeSchema,
  setRolloverSchema,
} from "../validate.ts";

export function registerEnvelopes(api: Hono, container: Container, services: Services): void {
  const tz = container.config.timezone;

  api.get("/envelopes", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const now = currentPeriod(tz);
    // Period selection (ISC-103/104): an explicit from/to custom range wins, else a
    // named period (this/last month, this/last FY), else this month. The grid
    // recomputes over the whole selected range.
    const from = c.req.query("from");
    const to = c.req.query("to");
    const name = c.req.query("period") as NamedPeriod | undefined;
    const named = name === "this-month" || name === "last-month" || name === "this-fy" || name === "last-fy";
    const range = from && to ? rangeFromDates(from, to) : named ? resolveNamedPeriod(name!, now) : { from: now, to: now };
    // ISC-29 / ISC-76: auto-roll the template into every month in the range.
    for (const m of periodRange(range.from, range.to)) {
      await services.budget.ensureMonth(session.userId, m);
    }
    const grid = await services.envelopes.getGridRange(session.userId, range);
    return c.json(grid);
  });

  api.get("/envelopes/as-of", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const date = c.req.query("date");
    if (!date) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Missing date.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    const grid = await services.envelopes.getGridAsOf(session.userId, date);
    return c.json(grid);
  });

  api.get("/envelopes/detail", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const id = c.req.query("id");
    if (!id) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Missing id.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    // An explicit from/to (YYYY-MM-DD) scopes the row + transactions to a period
    // range, so the detail page reads one row for the selected period rather than
    // pulling the whole grid. Omitting both is the current month.
    const from = c.req.query("from");
    const to = c.req.query("to");
    const range = from && to ? rangeFromDates(from, to) : undefined;
    const detail = await services.envelopes.getDetail(session.userId, id, currentPeriod(tz), range);
    if (!detail) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Envelope not found.", code: "not_found" };
      return c.json(err, 404);
    }
    return c.json(detail);
  });

  // Spend-over-time series for the envelope-detail chart (GAP-A, ISC-16).
  api.get("/envelopes/trend", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const id = c.req.query("id");
    if (!id) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Missing id.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    const bounds = monthBounds(currentPeriod(tz));
    const from = c.req.query("from") ?? bounds.first;
    const to = c.req.query("to") ?? bounds.last;
    // Materialise the template into every month in the range (ISC-29 / ISC-76) so the
    // per-month budget buckets are populated even for months not yet opened on the grid.
    const range = rangeFromDates(from, to);
    for (const m of periodRange(range.from, range.to)) {
      await services.budget.ensureMonth(session.userId, m);
    }
    const trend = await services.envelopes.getTrend(session.userId, id, from, to);
    if (!trend) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Envelope not found.", code: "not_found" };
      return c.json(err, 404);
    }
    return c.json(trend);
  });

  // Conserved move-money. Registered at BOTH contract paths: the UI's
  // MoveMoneyModal posts /api/move, the original registration was
  // /api/envelopes/move — one handler, two routes, zero drift.
  const moveHandler = async (c: Context) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, moveMoneySchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    try {
      const res: MoveMoneyResponse = await services.budget.moveMoney(session.userId, currentPeriod(tz), parsed.value);
      return c.json(res);
    } catch (e) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Move failed.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
  };
  api.post("/envelopes/move", moveHandler);
  api.post("/move", moveHandler);

  // Distribute surplus: a conserved, multi-leg reallocation (mirrors move). The
  // legs must net to exactly zero; a non-conserved set is rejected with a 400.
  api.post("/envelopes/distribute", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, distributeSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    try {
      const res: DistributeResponse = await services.budget.distribute(session.userId, currentPeriod(tz), parsed.value);
      return c.json(res);
    } catch (e) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Distribute failed.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
  });

  // Create a new envelope from the budget page, income or expense (ISC-87).
  api.post("/envelopes", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, createEnvelopeSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    const req = parsed.value;
    const id = crypto.randomUUID();
    if (req.type === "income") {
      await container.store.upsertIncomeEnvelope(session.userId, {
        id,
        userId: session.userId,
        name: req.name,
        source: req.name,
        budgetedCents: req.budgetedCents ?? 0,
        actualCents: 0,
      });
    } else {
      await container.store.upsertEnvelope(session.userId, {
        id,
        parentId: req.parentId ?? null,
        name: req.name,
        group: "",
        // The runtime rollover vocabulary is "roll_carry" (see imported data); the
        // platform Store.Envelope type still carries the legacy enum. Cast around
        // that pre-existing divergence rather than fork the value here.
        rolloverRule: (req.rolloverRule ?? "roll_carry") as never,
        targetType: "no_target",
        targetAmountCents: 0,
        type: req.type,
        ...(req.active !== undefined ? { active: req.active } : {}),
      });
      // The schedule anchor (ISC-25..28): a new budget resets at its interval from
      // the chosen start date. Default to today when none is given. Carryover starts
      // at zero; setEnvelopeCarryover is the owned writer for the (carryover, start) pair.
      const rolloverStart = req.rolloverStart ?? todayISO(tz);
      await container.store.setEnvelopeCarryover(session.userId, id, 0, rolloverStart);
      if (typeof req.budgetedCents === "number" && req.budgetedCents !== 0) {
        await container.store.putTemplateLine(session.userId, {
          id: `bt-${id}`,
          userId: session.userId,
          envelopeId: id,
          amountCents: req.budgetedCents,
          period: req.period ?? "monthly",
        });
        await services.budget.ensureMonth(session.userId, currentPeriod(tz));
      }
    }
    const res: CreateEnvelopeResponse = { id, type: req.type };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // Edit an existing envelope's name/type/parent/active/budget fields (ISC-91,
  // ISC-94, ISC-100). Income envelopes update their target/budget in place;
  // expense-family envelopes update the tree row, and a budget change routes
  // through the budget engine so history and the current period stay true.
  api.post("/envelopes/edit", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, editEnvelopeSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    const req = parsed.value;

    // Income envelope: the budget IS the target (ISC-92); preserve actuals/source.
    const incomes = await container.store.listIncomeEnvelopes(session.userId);
    const income = incomes.find((i) => i.id === req.id);
    if (income) {
      await container.store.upsertIncomeEnvelope(session.userId, {
        ...income,
        name: req.name ?? income.name,
        source: req.name ?? income.source,
        budgetedCents: req.budgetedCents ?? req.targetCents ?? income.budgetedCents,
        targetCents: req.targetCents ?? income.targetCents ?? 0,
      });
      const res: EditEnvelopeResponse = { id: req.id, ok: true };
      return c.json(res);
    }

    const envelopes = await container.store.listEnvelopes(session.userId);
    const existing = envelopes.find((e) => e.id === req.id);
    if (!existing) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Envelope not found.", code: "not_found" };
      return c.json(err, 404);
    }
    if (req.type === "income") {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "An expense envelope cannot be converted to income.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }

    await container.store.upsertEnvelope(session.userId, {
      ...existing,
      name: req.name ?? existing.name,
      parentId: req.parentId !== undefined ? req.parentId : existing.parentId,
      type: req.type ?? existing.type ?? "expense",
      active: req.active ?? existing.active ?? true,
    });

    // Budget amount changes go through the budget engine (template + current
    // period + history, scope ongoing), matching the Edit Budget wizard's path.
    if (req.budgetedCents !== undefined) {
      await services.budget.editBudget(session.userId, currentPeriod(tz), {
        lines: [
          {
            envelopeId: req.id,
            amountCents: req.budgetedCents,
            ...(req.period !== undefined ? { period: req.period } : {}),
          },
        ],
        scope: "ongoing",
      });
    }
    // A period relabel with an unchanged amount is skipped by editBudget (no
    // amount delta), so write the label onto the template line directly.
    if (req.period !== undefined) {
      const template = await container.store.listTemplate(session.userId);
      const line = template.find((t) => t.envelopeId === req.id);
      if (line && line.period !== req.period) {
        await container.store.putTemplateLine(session.userId, { ...line, period: req.period });
      }
    }

    const res: EditEnvelopeResponse = { id: req.id, ok: true };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // Manually reset an envelope's carried starting balance; logged as a traceable event.
  api.post("/envelopes/carryover", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, setCarryoverSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    const res: SetCarryoverResponse = await services.envelopes.resetCarryover(
      session.userId,
      parsed.value.envelopeId,
      parsed.value.carryoverCents,
    );
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // Archive or unarchive an envelope; logged as a traceable envelope.archive event.
  api.post("/envelopes/archive", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, archiveEnvelopeSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    const result = await services.envelopes.archiveEnvelope(session.userId, parsed.value.envelopeId, parsed.value.archived);
    const res: ArchiveEnvelopeResponse = { envelopeId: parsed.value.envelopeId, archived: result.after };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // Set an envelope's rollover schedule: the anchor date and optional interval.
  // Recomputes the schedule (running balances + Left). Logged as a traceable event.
  api.post("/envelopes/rollover", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, setRolloverSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    const req = parsed.value;
    // Move the anchor (preserving carryover) and write the new period onto the
    // recurring template line when one exists; the template holds the budget period.
    await services.envelopes.setRolloverAnchor(session.userId, req.envelopeId, req.rolloverStart, req.period);
    const template = await container.store.listTemplate(session.userId);
    const line = template.find((t) => t.envelopeId === req.envelopeId);
    const resolvedPeriod: BudgetPeriod = req.period ?? line?.period ?? "monthly";
    if (req.period !== undefined && line !== undefined) {
      await container.store.putTemplateLine(session.userId, { ...line, period: req.period });
    }
    const res: SetRolloverResponse = {
      envelopeId: req.envelopeId,
      rolloverStart: req.rolloverStart,
      period: resolvedPeriod,
    };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // The archived envelopes, for the budget page's "Show archived" list.
  api.get("/envelopes/archived", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const res: ArchivedEnvelopesResponse = { envelopes: await services.envelopes.listArchived(session.userId) };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // Traceable money-movements history (ISC-89, ISC-90), newest-first, with the
  // envelope names resolved for display (null when an envelope no longer exists).
  api.get("/movements", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const [movements, envelopes, incomes] = await Promise.all([
      container.store.listMovements(session.userId),
      container.store.listEnvelopes(session.userId),
      container.store.listIncomeEnvelopes(session.userId),
    ]);
    const names = new Map<string, string>();
    for (const e of envelopes) names.set(e.id, e.name);
    for (const i of incomes) names.set(i.id, i.name);
    const views: MovementView[] = movements.map((m) => ({
      id: m.id,
      ts: m.ts,
      fromEnvelopeId: m.fromEnvelopeId,
      fromEnvelopeName: names.get(m.fromEnvelopeId) ?? null,
      toEnvelopeId: m.toEnvelopeId,
      toEnvelopeName: names.get(m.toEnvelopeId) ?? null,
      amountCents: m.amountCents,
      scope: m.scope,
      actor: m.actor,
      correlationId: m.correlationId,
    }));
    const res: MovementsResponse = { movements: views };
    return c.json(res);
  });
}

    const range = from && to ? rangeFromDates(from, to) : named ? resolveNamedPeriod(name!, now) : { from: now, to: now };
    // ISC-29 / ISC-76: auto-roll the template into every month in the range.
    for (const m of periodRange(range.from, range.to)) {
      await services.budget.ensureMonth(session.userId, m);
    }
    const grid = await services.envelopes.getGridRange(session.userId, range);
    return c.json(grid);
  });

  api.get("/envelopes/as-of", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const date = c.req.query("date");
    if (!date) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Missing date.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    const grid = await services.envelopes.getGridAsOf(session.userId, date);
    return c.json(grid);
  });

  api.get("/envelopes/detail", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const id = c.req.query("id");
    if (!id) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Missing id.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    // An explicit from/to (YYYY-MM-DD) scopes the row + transactions to a period
    // range, so the detail page reads one row for the selected period rather than
    // pulling the whole grid. Omitting both is the current month.
    const from = c.req.query("from");
    const to = c.req.query("to");
    const range = from && to ? rangeFromDates(from, to) : undefined;
    const detail = await services.envelopes.getDetail(session.userId, id, currentPeriod(tz), range);
    if (!detail) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Envelope not found.", code: "not_found" };
      return c.json(err, 404);
    }
    return c.json(detail);
  });

  // Spend-over-time series for the envelope-detail chart (GAP-A, ISC-16).
  api.get("/envelopes/trend", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const id = c.req.query("id");
    if (!id) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Missing id.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    const bounds = monthBounds(currentPeriod(tz));
    const from = c.req.query("from") ?? bounds.first;
    const to = c.req.query("to") ?? bounds.last;
    // Materialise the template into every month in the range (ISC-29 / ISC-76) so the
    // per-month budget buckets are populated even for months not yet opened on the grid.
    const range = rangeFromDates(from, to);
    for (const m of periodRange(range.from, range.to)) {
      await services.budget.ensureMonth(session.userId, m);
    }
    const trend = await services.envelopes.getTrend(session.userId, id, from, to);
    if (!trend) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Envelope not found.", code: "not_found" };
      return c.json(err, 404);
    }
    return c.json(trend);
  });

  // Conserved move-money. Registered at BOTH contract paths: the UI's
  // MoveMoneyModal posts /api/move, the original registration was
  // /api/envelopes/move — one handler, two routes, zero drift.
  const moveHandler = async (c: Context) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, moveMoneySchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    try {
      const res: MoveMoneyResponse = await services.budget.moveMoney(session.userId, currentPeriod(tz), parsed.value);
      return c.json(res);
    } catch (e) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Move failed.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
  };
  api.post("/envelopes/move", moveHandler);
  api.post("/move", moveHandler);

  // Distribute surplus: a conserved, multi-leg reallocation (mirrors move). The
  // legs must net to exactly zero; a non-conserved set is rejected with a 400.
  api.post("/envelopes/distribute", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, distributeSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    try {
      const res: DistributeResponse = await services.budget.distribute(session.userId, currentPeriod(tz), parsed.value);
      return c.json(res);
    } catch (e) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Distribute failed.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
  });

  // Create a new envelope from the budget page, income or expense (ISC-87).
  api.post("/envelopes", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, createEnvelopeSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    const req = parsed.value;
    const id = crypto.randomUUID();
    if (req.type === "income") {
      await container.store.upsertIncomeEnvelope(session.userId, {
        id,
        userId: session.userId,
        name: req.name,
        source: req.name,
        budgetedCents: req.budgetedCents ?? 0,
        actualCents: 0,
      });
    } else {
      await container.store.upsertEnvelope(session.userId, {
        id,
        parentId: req.parentId ?? null,
        name: req.name,
        group: "",
        // The runtime rollover vocabulary is "roll_carry" (see imported data); the
        // platform Store.Envelope type still carries the legacy enum. Cast around
        // that pre-existing divergence rather than fork the value here.
        rolloverRule: (req.rolloverRule ?? "roll_carry") as never,
        targetType: "no_target",
        targetAmountCents: 0,
        type: req.type,
        ...(req.active !== undefined ? { active: req.active } : {}),
      });
      // The schedule anchor (ISC-25..28): a new budget resets at its interval from
      // the chosen start date. Default to today when none is given. Carryover starts
      // at zero; setEnvelopeCarryover is the owned writer for the (carryover, start) pair.
      const rolloverStart = req.rolloverStart ?? todayISO(tz);
      await container.store.setEnvelopeCarryover(session.userId, id, 0, rolloverStart);
      if (typeof req.budgetedCents === "number" && req.budgetedCents !== 0) {
        await container.store.putTemplateLine(session.userId, {
          id: `bt-${id}`,
          userId: session.userId,
          envelopeId: id,
          amountCents: req.budgetedCents,
          period: req.period ?? "monthly",
        });
        await services.budget.ensureMonth(session.userId, currentPeriod(tz));
      }
    }
    const res: CreateEnvelopeResponse = { id, type: req.type };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // Edit an existing envelope's name/type/parent/active/budget fields (ISC-91,
  // ISC-94, ISC-100). Income envelopes update their target/budget in place;
  // expense-family envelopes update the tree row, and a budget change routes
  // through the budget engine so history and the current period stay true.
  api.post("/envelopes/edit", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, editEnvelopeSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    const req = parsed.value;

    // Income envelope: the budget IS the target (ISC-92); preserve actuals/source.
    const incomes = await container.store.listIncomeEnvelopes(session.userId);
    const income = incomes.find((i) => i.id === req.id);
    if (income) {
      await container.store.upsertIncomeEnvelope(session.userId, {
        ...income,
        name: req.name ?? income.name,
        source: req.name ?? income.source,
        budgetedCents: req.budgetedCents ?? req.targetCents ?? income.budgetedCents,
        targetCents: req.targetCents ?? income.targetCents ?? 0,
      });
      const res: EditEnvelopeResponse = { id: req.id, ok: true };
      return c.json(res);
    }

    const envelopes = await container.store.listEnvelopes(session.userId);
    const existing = envelopes.find((e) => e.id === req.id);
    if (!existing) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Envelope not found.", code: "not_found" };
      return c.json(err, 404);
    }
    if (req.type === "income") {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "An expense envelope cannot be converted to income.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }

    await container.store.upsertEnvelope(session.userId, {
      ...existing,
      name: req.name ?? existing.name,
      parentId: req.parentId !== undefined ? req.parentId : existing.parentId,
      type: req.type ?? existing.type ?? "expense",
      active: req.active ?? existing.active ?? true,
    });

    // Budget amount changes go through the budget engine (template + current
    // period + history, scope ongoing), matching the Edit Budget wizard's path.
    if (req.budgetedCents !== undefined) {
      await services.budget.editBudget(session.userId, currentPeriod(tz), {
        lines: [
          {
            envelopeId: req.id,
            amountCents: req.budgetedCents,
            ...(req.period !== undefined ? { period: req.period } : {}),
          },
        ],
        scope: "ongoing",
      });
    }
    // A period relabel with an unchanged amount is skipped by editBudget (no
    // amount delta), so write the label onto the template line directly.
    if (req.period !== undefined) {
      const template = await container.store.listTemplate(session.userId);
      const line = template.find((t) => t.envelopeId === req.id);
      if (line && line.period !== req.period) {
        await container.store.putTemplateLine(session.userId, { ...line, period: req.period });
      }
    }

    const res: EditEnvelopeResponse = { id: req.id, ok: true };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // Manually reset an envelope's carried starting balance; logged as a traceable event.
  api.post("/envelopes/carryover", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, setCarryoverSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    const res: SetCarryoverResponse = await services.envelopes.resetCarryover(
      session.userId,
      parsed.value.envelopeId,
      parsed.value.carryoverCents,
    );
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // Archive or unarchive an envelope; logged as a traceable envelope.archive event.
  api.post("/envelopes/archive", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, archiveEnvelopeSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    const result = await services.envelopes.archiveEnvelope(session.userId, parsed.value.envelopeId, parsed.value.archived);
    const res: ArchiveEnvelopeResponse = { envelopeId: parsed.value.envelopeId, archived: result.after };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // Set an envelope's rollover schedule: the anchor date and optional interval.
  // Recomputes the schedule (running balances + Left). Logged as a traceable event.
  api.post("/envelopes/rollover", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, setRolloverSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    const req = parsed.value;
    // Move the anchor (preserving carryover) and write the new period onto the
    // recurring template line when one exists; the template holds the budget period.
    await services.envelopes.setRolloverAnchor(session.userId, req.envelopeId, req.rolloverStart, req.period);
    const template = await container.store.listTemplate(session.userId);
    const line = template.find((t) => t.envelopeId === req.envelopeId);
    const resolvedPeriod: BudgetPeriod = req.period ?? line?.period ?? "monthly";
    if (req.period !== undefined && line !== undefined) {
      await container.store.putTemplateLine(session.userId, { ...line, period: req.period });
    }
    const res: SetRolloverResponse = {
      envelopeId: req.envelopeId,
      rolloverStart: req.rolloverStart,
      period: resolvedPeriod,
    };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // The archived envelopes, for the budget page's "Show archived" list.
  api.get("/envelopes/archived", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const res: ArchivedEnvelopesResponse = { envelopes: await services.envelopes.listArchived(session.userId) };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  // Traceable money-movements history (ISC-89, ISC-90), newest-first, with the
  // envelope names resolved for display (null when an envelope no longer exists).
  api.get("/movements", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const [movements, envelopes, incomes] = await Promise.all([
      container.store.listMovements(session.userId),
      container.store.listEnvelopes(session.userId),
      container.store.listIncomeEnvelopes(session.userId),
    ]);
    const names = new Map<string, string>();
    for (const e of envelopes) names.set(e.id, e.name);
    for (const i of incomes) names.set(i.id, i.name);
    const views: MovementView[] = movements.map((m) => ({
      id: m.id,
      ts: m.ts,
      fromEnvelopeId: m.fromEnvelopeId,
      fromEnvelopeName: names.get(m.fromEnvelopeId) ?? null,
      toEnvelopeId: m.toEnvelopeId,
      toEnvelopeName: names.get(m.toEnvelopeId) ?? null,
      amountCents: m.amountCents,
      scope: m.scope,
      actor: m.actor,
      correlationId: m.correlationId,
    }));
    const res: MovementsResponse = { movements: views };
    return c.json(res);
  });
}

import { parseBody, setPocketSmithKeySchema } from "../validate.ts";","originalFile":"/**
 * Settings route handlers: exposes deploy mode + per-user sync state, and accepts
 * the per-user PocketSmith developer key. The key is stored through the
 * SecretStore for the authenticated user (ISC-3) and is never echoed back
 * (ISC-56); the GET only reports whether one is present.
 */

import { Hono } from "hono";
import type { Container } from "../../composition.ts";
import type { ApiError, SetPocketSmithKeyRequest, SetPocketSmithKeyResponse, SettingsResponse } from "../contract.ts";
import { resolveSession, UNAUTHENTICATED } from "../http.ts";

export function registerSettings(api: Hono, container: Container): void {
  api.get("/settings", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const key = await container.secrets.get(session.userId, "pocketsmith_developer_key");
    const lastSyncAt = await container.store.getLastSyncAt(session.userId);
    const res: SettingsResponse = {
      deployMode: container.config.deployMode,
      hasPocketSmithKey: key !== null,
      lastSyncAt,
    };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  api.post("/settings/pocketsmith-key", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const req = (await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Partial<SetPocketSmithKeyRequest>;
    if (typeof req.developerKey !== "string" || req.developerKey.trim().length === 0) {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Missing developer key.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    // Stored as per-user secret material; never logged, never echoed (ISC-56).
    await container.secrets.set(session.userId, "pocketsmith_developer_key", req.developerKey);
    const res: SetPocketSmithKeyResponse = { ok: true };
    return c.json(res);
  });
}

 * Auth route handlers. Drives the active AuthProvider seam: local PIN sign-in
 * mints a session cookie immediately; cloud email sign-in sends a magic link and
 * the follow-up verify mints the cookie. Neither path leaks which user exists
 * (AuthError is surfaced as a flat 401). The session route reflects the resolved
 * session; signout clears the cookie.
 */

import { Hono } from "hono";
import type { Container } from "../../composition.ts";
import { AuthError, type BeginSignInInput } from "../../platform/auth.ts";
import type { ApiError, ChangePinRequest, ChangePinResponse, SessionResponse, SignInRequest, SignInResponse, VerifyLinkRequest } from "../contract.ts";
import { clearCookie, resolveSession, sessionCookie, UNAUTHENTICATED } from "../http.ts";

export function registerAuth(api: Hono, container: Container): void {
  const secure = container.config.deployMode === "cloud";

  api.post("/auth/signin", async (c) => {
    const body = (await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Partial<SignInRequest>;

    let input: BeginSignInInput;
    if (body.kind === "pin" && typeof body.pin === "string") {
      input = { kind: "pin", pin: body.pin };
    } else if (body.kind === "email" && typeof body.email === "string") {
      input = { kind: "email", email: body.email };
    } else {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Bad sign-in request.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }

    try {
      const session = await container.auth.beginSignIn(input);
      if (session) {
        // Local PIN: a session was minted immediately. Set the cookie.
        const token = await container.auth.mintToken(session);
        c.header("Set-Cookie", sessionCookie(token, secure));
        const res: SignInResponse = { status: "authenticated", userId: session.userId };
        return c.json(res);
      }
      // Cloud email: link sent, second step (verify) required.
      const res: SignInResponse = { status: "link_sent", userId: null };
      return c.json(res);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof AuthError) {
        const err: ApiError = { error: "Sign-in failed.", code: "auth_failed" };
        return c.json(err, 401);
      }
      throw e;
    }
  });

  api.post("/auth/verify", async (c) => {
    const body = (await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Partial<VerifyLinkRequest>;
    if (typeof body.token !== "string") {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Missing token.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    try {
      const session = await container.auth.completeSignIn(body.token);
      const token = await container.auth.mintToken(session);
      c.header("Set-Cookie", sessionCookie(token, secure));
      const res: SessionResponse = {
        authenticated: true,
        userId: session.userId,
        idleExpiresAt: session.idleExpiresAt,
      };
      return c.json(res);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof AuthError) {
        const err: ApiError = { error: "Verification failed.", code: "auth_failed" };
        return c.json(err, 401);
      }
      throw e;
    }
  });

  api.get("/auth/session", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    const res: SessionResponse = session
      ? { authenticated: true, userId: session.userId, idleExpiresAt: session.idleExpiresAt }
      : { authenticated: false, userId: null, idleExpiresAt: null };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  api.post("/auth/signout", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (session) await container.auth.signOut(session);
    c.header("Set-Cookie", clearCookie());
    return c.json({ ok: true } as const);
  });

  // Change the local PIN. Must be authenticated (the session gates who can change
  // it). The current PIN is re-verified by the AuthProvider with the same scheme
  // sign-in uses; a wrong current PIN or invalid new PIN returns 400 — NEVER 401,
  // which would trip the client idle-lock and sign the user out mid-change.
  api.post("/auth/change-pin", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const body = (await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Partial<ChangePinRequest>;
    if (typeof body.currentPin !== "string" || typeof body.newPin !== "string") {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "currentPin and newPin are required.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    try {
      await container.auth.changePin(body.currentPin, body.newPin);
      const res: ChangePinResponse = { ok: true };
      return c.json(res);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof AuthError) {
        // Never leak whether it was the current PIN or the new PIN policy at 401;
        // surface the specific-but-safe message at 400 so the app stays signed in.
        const err: ApiError = { error: e.message, code: "pin_change_failed" };
        return c.json(err, 400);
      }
      throw e;
    }
  });
}

import type { AttemptTracker } from "../../platform/auth/attempts.ts";

/** Uniform 429 body. Names the wait, never the remaining attempts. */
function tooManyAttempts(c: Parameters<typeof rateLimited>[0], retryAfterMs: number) {
  return rateLimited(c, retryAfterMs);
}

function rateLimited(c: { json: (o: ApiError, s: 429) => Response; header: (k: string, v: string) => void }, retryAfterMs: number): Response {
  const seconds = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(retryAfterMs / 1000));
  c.header("Retry-After", String(seconds));
  const err: ApiError = {
    error: `Too many attempts. Try again in ${seconds}s.`,
    code: "rate_limited",

  return c.json(err, 429);

export function registerAuth(api: Hono, container: Container, attempts: AttemptTracker): void {

    const parsed = await parseBody(c, signInSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    const body = parsed.value;

    const input: BeginSignInInput =
      body.kind === "pin" ? { kind: "pin", pin: body.pin } : { kind: "email", email: body.email };

    // sign-in throttles per address so one address cannot exhaust another's window.
    const key = body.kind === "pin" ? "signin:pin" : `signin:email:${body.email.toLowerCase()}`;

    const gate = await attempts.check(key);
    if (gate.blocked) return tooManyAttempts(c, gate.retryAfterMs);

      const session = await container.auth.beginSignIn(input);
      await attempts.recordSuccess(key);
      if (session) {
        // Local PIN: a session was minted immediately. Set the cookie.
        const token = await container.auth.mintToken(session);
        c.header("Set-Cookie", sessionCookie(token, secure));
        const res: SignInResponse = { status: "authenticated", userId: session.userId };
        return c.json(res);
      }
      // Cloud email: link sent, second step (verify) required.
      const res: SignInResponse = { status: "link_sent", userId: null };
      return c.json(res);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof AuthError) {
        await attempts.recordFailure(key);
        const err: ApiError = { error: "Sign-in failed.", code: "auth_failed" };
        return c.json(err, 401);
      }
      throw e;
    }
  });

    const parsed = await parseBody(c, verifyLinkSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;

      const session = await container.auth.completeSignIn(parsed.value.token);
      const token = await container.auth.mintToken(session);
      c.header("Set-Cookie", sessionCookie(token, secure));
      const res: SessionResponse = {
        authenticated: true,
        userId: session.userId,
        idleExpiresAt: session.idleExpiresAt,
      };
      return c.json(res);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof AuthError) {
        const err: ApiError = { error: "Verification failed.", code: "auth_failed" };
        return c.json(err, 401);
      }
      throw e;
    }
  });

    if (session) await container.auth.signOut(session);
    c.header("Set-Cookie", clearCookie());
    return c.json({ ok: true } as const);
  });

  // sign-in uses; a wrong current PIN or invalid new PIN returns 400 — NEVER 401,
  // which would trip the client idle-lock and sign the user out mid-change.
  api.post("/auth/change-pin", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, changePinSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    const body = parsed.value;

    // new PIN (which says nothing about whether the caller knows the current
    // PIN) is never counted as a brute-force failure. Mirrors the provider's
    // own policy in src/platform/auth/local.ts.

      await container.auth.changePin(body.currentPin, body.newPin);
      await attempts.recordSuccess(key);
      const res: ChangePinResponse = { ok: true };
      return c.json(res);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof AuthError) {
        // With the new-PIN policy pre-checked above, an AuthError here means the
        // current-PIN verification failed — a throttled guess.
        await attempts.recordFailure(key);
        // Never leak whether it was the current PIN or the new PIN policy at 401;
        // surface the specific-but-safe message at 400 so the app stays signed in.
        const err: ApiError = { error: e.message, code: "pin_change_failed" };
        return c.json(err, 400);
      }
      throw e;
    }
  });
}

 * Auth route handlers. Drives the active AuthProvider seam: local PIN sign-in
 * mints a session cookie immediately; cloud email sign-in sends a magic link and

 * (AuthError is surfaced as a flat 401). The session route reflects the resolved
 * session; signout clears the cookie.
 *
 * Brute-force throttling: both sign-in and the current-PIN check inside
 * change-pin run through an AttemptTracker. Five consecutive failures start an

 * BEFORE any PIN comparison, even for a correct PIN. Success resets the key.
 * The response never reveals a remaining-attempt count.

import { Hono } from "hono";
import type { Context } from "hono";
import type { Container } from "../../composition.ts";
import { AuthError, type BeginSignInInput } from "../../platform/auth.ts";
import type { AttemptTracker } from "../../platform/auth/attempts.ts";
import type { ApiError, ChangePinResponse, SessionResponse, SignInResponse } from "../contract.ts";
import { clearCookie, resolveSession, sessionCookie, UNAUTHENTICATED } from "../http.ts";
import { parseBody, signInSchema, verifyLinkSchema, changePinSchema } from "../validate.ts";

/** Uniform 429 body. Names the wait, never the remaining attempts. */
function tooManyAttempts(c: Parameters<typeof rateLimited>[0], retryAfterMs: number) {
  return rateLimited(c, retryAfterMs);
}

function rateLimited(c: { json: (o: ApiError, s: 429) => Response; header: (k: string, v: string) => void }, retryAfterMs: number): Response {
  const seconds = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(retryAfterMs / 1000));
  c.header("Retry-After", String(seconds));
  const err: ApiError = {
    error: `Too many attempts. Try again in ${seconds}s.`,
    code: "rate_limited",
  };
  return c.json(err, 429);

export function registerAuth(api: Hono, container: Container, attempts: AttemptTracker): void {
  const secure = container.config.deployMode === "cloud";

  api.post("/auth/signin", async (c) => {
    const parsed = await parseBody(c, signInSchema);
    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;
    const body = parsed.value;

    const input: BeginSignInInput =
      body.kind === "pin" ? { kind: "pin", pin: body.pin } : { kind: "email", email: body.email };

    // sign-in throttles per address so one address cannot exhaust another's window.
    const key = body.kind === "pin" ? "signin:pin" : `signin:email:${body.email.toLowerCase()}`;

    if (gate.blocked) return tooManyAttempts(c, gate.retryAfterMs);

      await attempts.recordSuccess(key);

        const token = await container.auth.mintToken(session);
        c.header("Set-Cookie", sessionCookie(token, secure));
        const res: SignInResponse = { status: "authenticated", userId: session.userId };
        return c.json(res);
      }
      // Cloud email: link sent, second step (verify) required.
      const res: SignInResponse = { status: "link_sent", userId: null };
      return c.json(res);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof AuthError) {
        await attempts.recordFailure(key);
        const err: ApiError = { error: "Sign-in failed.", code: "auth_failed" };
        return c.json(err, 401);
      }
      throw e;
    }
  });

    if (!parsed.ok) return parsed.response;

        userId: session.userId,
        idleExpiresAt: session.idleExpiresAt,
      };
      return c.json(res);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof AuthError) {
        const err: ApiError = { error: "Verification failed.", code: "auth_failed" };
        return c.json(err, 401);
      }
      throw e;
    }
  });

  api.get("/auth/session", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    const res: SessionResponse = session
      ? { authenticated: true, userId: session.userId, idleExpiresAt: session.idleExpiresAt }
      : { authenticated: false, userId: null, idleExpiresAt: null };

  });

  api.post("/auth/signout", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (session) await container.auth.signOut(session);
    c.header("Set-Cookie", clearCookie());
    return c.json({ ok: true } as const);
  });

  // Change the local PIN. Must be authenticated (the session gates who can change
  // it). The current PIN is re-verified by the AuthProvider with the same scheme
  // sign-in uses; a wrong current PIN or invalid new PIN returns 400 — NEVER 401,
  // which would trip the client idle-lock and sign the user out mid-change.

        await attempts.recordFailure(key);

        // surface the specific-but-safe message at 400 so the app stays signed in.
        const err: ApiError = { error: e.message, code: "pin_change_failed" };
        return c.json(err, 400);
      }
      throw e;
    }
  });
}

import * as React from "react";
import { call, setUnauthorizedHandler } from "@/lib/api";
import type { SessionResponse } from "@contract";

export const IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000;

interface SessionState {
  authenticated: boolean;
  userId: string | null;
  loading: boolean;
  idleExpiresAt: number | null;
  signIn: (pin: string) => Promise<{ ok: boolean; error?: string }>;
  signOut: (reason?: "manual" | "idle") => Promise<void>;
  lastSignOutReason: "manual" | "idle" | null;
}

const SessionContext = React.createContext<SessionState | null>(null);

export function SessionProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [authenticated, setAuthenticated] = React.useState(false);
  const [userId, setUserId] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [idleExpiresAt, setIdleExpiresAt] = React.useState<number | null>(null);
  const [lastSignOutReason, setLastSignOutReason] = React.useState<"manual" | "idle" | null>(null);
  const timer = React.useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const signOut = React.useCallback(async (reason: "manual" | "idle" = "manual") => {
    await call("POST /api/auth/signout").catch(() => undefined);
    setAuthenticated(false);
    setUserId(null);
    setIdleExpiresAt(null);
    setLastSignOutReason(reason);
    if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current);
  }, []);

  const armIdleTimer = React.useCallback(() => {
    if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current);
    const expires = Date.now() + IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS;
    setIdleExpiresAt(expires);
    timer.current = setTimeout(() => void signOut("idle"), IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS);
  }, [signOut]);

  /**
   * Drop to the locked state without round-tripping signout (the server already
   * rejected us). Fired by the global 401 handler so any expired request locks
   * the app and routes back to sign-in (ISC-39).
   */
  const lock = React.useCallback(() => {
    setAuthenticated(false);
    setUserId(null);
    setIdleExpiresAt(null);
    setLastSignOutReason("idle");
    if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current);
  }, []);

  // Register the 401 handler for the lifetime of the provider.
  React.useEffect(() => {
    setUnauthorizedHandler(lock);
    return () => setUnauthorizedHandler(null);
  }, [lock]);

  // Resolve the existing session on first load.
  React.useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      const fallback: SessionResponse = { authenticated: false, userId: null, idleExpiresAt: null };
      const res = await call("GET /api/auth/session").catch(() => fallback);
      if (cancelled) return;
      setAuthenticated(res.authenticated);
      setUserId(res.userId);
      setLoading(false);
      if (res.authenticated) armIdleTimer();
    })();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [armIdleTimer]);

  // Refresh the idle deadline on real user activity.
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!authenticated) return;
    const onActivity = () => armIdleTimer();
    const windowEvents: (keyof WindowEventMap)[] = ["pointerdown", "keydown"];
    windowEvents.forEach((e) => window.addEventListener(e, onActivity, { passive: true }));
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onActivity);
    return () => {
      windowEvents.forEach((e) => window.removeEventListener(e, onActivity));
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onActivity);
    };
  }, [authenticated, armIdleTimer]);

  const signIn = React.useCallback(
    async (pin: string) => {
      try {
        const res = await call("POST /api/auth/signin", { kind: "pin", pin });
        if ("error" in res) return { ok: false, error: res.error };
        if (res.status === "authenticated") {
          setAuthenticated(true);
          setUserId(res.userId);
          setLastSignOutReason(null);
          armIdleTimer();
          return { ok: true };
        }
        return { ok: false, error: "Unexpected sign-in status." };
      } catch {
        // A thrown sign-in call (network failure, server error) must never mint a
        // session. Surface the failure so the user retries — there is no bypass.
        return { ok: false, error: "Could not reach sign-in. Try again." };
      }
    },
    [armIdleTimer]
  );

  const value: SessionState = {
    authenticated,
    userId,
    loading,
    idleExpiresAt,
    signIn,
    signOut,
    lastSignOutReason,
  };
  return <SessionContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</SessionContext.Provider>;
}

export function useSession(): SessionState {
  const ctx = React.useContext(SessionContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error("useSession must be used within SessionProvider");
  return ctx;

 *
 * Every call is keyed on an ApiPath from the contract, so the request and
 * response types are exactly the wire shapes the Hono handlers return. A
 * contract drift becomes a type error here, not a runtime surprise.
 *
 * There is no placeholder/fallback layer: screens call real endpoints and render
 * explicit loading and empty states when data is absent (ISC-83). The PWA never
 * queues writes for offline replay (ISC-64 anti) — requests are network-only.
 */

import type { ApiContract, ApiPath, ApiError } from "@contract";

type Req<P extends ApiPath> = ApiContract[P]["req"];
type Res<P extends ApiPath> = ApiContract[P]["res"];

const BASE = ""; // same-origin; Hono serves the SPA and the API on one port (ISC-33).

function splitPath(path: ApiPath): { method: string; url: string } {
  const idx = path.indexOf(" ");
  return { method: path.slice(0, idx), url: BASE + path.slice(idx + 1) };
}

export function isApiError(res: unknown): res is ApiError {
  return typeof res === "object" && res !== null && "error" in res && "code" in res;
}

export class HttpError extends Error {
  constructor(public status: number, message: string) {
    super(message);
  }
}

/**
 * Global 401 handler (ISC-39 idle lock). The SessionProvider registers a callback
 * here; any API call that comes back 401 (the server expired or rejected the
 * session) fires it exactly once per response so the app can surface the lock and
 * redirect to sign-in, rather than rendering a generic "could not load" error.
 */
let onUnauthorized: (() => void) | null = null;
export function setUnauthorizedHandler(fn: (() => void) | null): void {
  onUnauthorized = fn;
}

/**
 * Issue a typed request. GET requests with a `req` body serialise it to query
 * params (the contract GETs carry small primitive params); everything else
 * sends JSON. Undefined/null/empty params are dropped so optional filters stay
 * optional on the wire (ISC-79, ISC-80).
 */
export async function call<P extends ApiPath>(
  path: P,
  ...args: Req<P> extends void ? [] : [body: Req<P>]
): Promise<Res<P>> {
  const { method, url } = splitPath(path);
  const body = args[0] as Req<P> | undefined;

  let finalUrl = url;
  const init: RequestInit = { method, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, credentials: "same-origin" };

  if (method === "GET") {
    if (body && typeof body === "object") {
      const entries = Object.entries(body as Record<string, unknown>).filter(
        ([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== ""
      );
      const qs = new URLSearchParams(entries.map(([k, v]) => [k, String(v)]));
      const query = qs.toString();
      if (query) finalUrl = `${url}?${query}`;
    }

    init.body = JSON.stringify(body);
  }

  const resp = await fetch(finalUrl, init);
  // A 401 means the session lapsed (idle lock or server-side expiry). Surface the
  // lock globally before the per-call error path so the app redirects to sign-in.
  if (resp.status === 401) {
    onUnauthorized?.();
    throw new HttpError(401, `${method} ${url} failed: 401`);
  }
  const text = await resp.text();
  const json = text ? JSON.parse(text) : {};
  if (!resp.ok && !isApiError(json)) {
    throw new HttpError(resp.status, `${method} ${url} failed: ${resp.status}`);
  }

    </Card>
  );

function SyncSection({ settings }: { settings: SettingsResponse }) {
  // The last sync time is the real value from GET /api/settings — never
  // fabricated (ISC-83). "Sync now" triggers the real POST /api/sync (the same
  // incremental pull the daily cron runs); no fake progress is shown.
  const invalidate = useInvalidateAfterSync();
  const [busy, setBusy] = React.useState(false);

    setBusy(true);

      const res = await call("POST /api/sync");
      if (res.ok) {
        setResult({ transactions: res.transactions });

      } else {
        setError(res.message ?? "Sync failed.");

    }

  return (
    <Card>

        <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">

        {result && (
          <p className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-success">
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" />

        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">

        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function SecuritySection({ settings }: { settings: SettingsResponse }) {
  // The change-PIN control is backed by a real endpoint; the idle lock is always
  // on (enforced in session.tsx) and shown as an informational line since nothing
  // persists a toggle for it (ISC-83).
  const mins = IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS / 60000;
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <ShieldCheck className="h-4 w-4" /> Security
        </CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>PIN and idle session lock (ISC-39).</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-4">
        <ChangePinControl deployMode={settings.deployMode} />
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-md bg-muted/50 px-3 py-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
            <Lock className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
            <span>Idle session lock ({mins} minutes)</span>
          </div>
          <Badge variant="secondary">Always on</Badge>
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          The session locks after {mins} minutes of inactivity and re-prompts via the active sign-in method.
        </p>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

function BackupSection() {
  // Real backup health from GET /api/backup/status: the last VERIFIED backup
  // timestamp is written by scripts/backup-db.ts only after the upload verifies.
  // When none is recorded yet, we say so plainly — never a fabricated time (ISC-83).
  const status = useBackupStatus().data ?? null;
  const lastBackup = status?.lastBackupAt ?? null;
  const sizeMb = status?.sizeBytes != null ? (status.sizeBytes / 1e6).toFixed(1) : null;
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <HardDriveDownload className="h-4 w-4" /> Backup
        </CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>Daily encrypted backup of the local database (ISC-46).</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-md bg-muted/50 px-3 py-2 text-sm">
          <span className="text-muted-foreground">Last verified backup</span>
          <span className="font-medium">
            {lastBackup ? new Date(lastBackup).toLocaleString("en-AU") : "None recorded yet"}
          </span>
        </div>
        {status && status.configured ? (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
            <Badge variant={lastBackup ? "success" : "outline"}>{lastBackup ? "Healthy" : "Awaiting first backup"}</Badge>
            {sizeMb && <span className="text-muted-foreground">{sizeMb} MB snapshot</span>}
          </div>
        ) : status && !status.configured ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{status.message ?? "Backups are managed by the platform."}</p>
        ) : null}
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          The database is backed up daily to an encrypted rclone crypt remote. The status above reflects the last run
          that verified its upload.
        </p>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

const EMPTY_SETTINGS: SettingsResponse = { deployMode: "local", hasPocketSmithKey: false, lastSyncAt: null };

export function SettingsPage() {
  // Settings and the this-month grid come from shared queries; the grid read is
  // deduped with the other this-month consumers. Both degrade to safe defaults on
  // error rather than fabricating values (ISC-83).
  const settings = useSettings().data ?? EMPTY_SETTINGS;
  const grid = useEnvelopes({ period: "this-month" }).data ?? null;

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-3xl space-y-5">
      <div>
        <h1 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight md:text-2xl">
          <SettingsIcon className="h-5 w-5" /> Settings
        </h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          Mode: <span className="font-medium capitalize">{settings.deployMode}</span>
        </p>
      </div>

      <Tabs defaultValue="connection">
        <TabsList className="flex w-full flex-wrap justify-start gap-1 h-auto">
          <TabsTrigger value="connection">Connection</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="accounts">Accounts</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="security">Security</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="backup">Backup</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="connection" className="space-y-4">
          <PocketSmithSection settings={settings} />
          <SyncSection settings={settings} />
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="accounts">
          <AccountsSection grid={grid} />
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="security">
          <SecuritySection settings={settings} />
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="backup">
          <BackupSection />
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}

import { ArrowRight, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle } from "lucide-react";
import type { EnvelopeRow } from "@contract";
import type { ChangeScope } from "@domain";
import { call, isApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import { useInvalidateBudget } from "@/lib/queries";
import { formatCents, cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Select, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, SelectContent, SelectItem } from "@/components/ui/select";

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  rows: readonly EnvelopeRow[];
  /** Optionally preselect the destination (e.g. opened from an envelope row). */
  defaultToId?: string;
}

/**
 * Move-money (reallocation) modal. Names an explicit source (From) and
 * destination (To); the amount leaving the source equals the amount entering
 * the destination (ISC-66). Scope is this-month-only or every-month (ongoing,
 * which edits the recurring template — ISC-67). A live indicator shows whether
 * the plan stays balanced (ISC-69): a same-envelope reallocation always
 * balances; moving from an envelope into deficit is allowed but flagged.
 */
export function MoveMoneyModal({ open, onOpenChange, rows, defaultToId }: Props) {
  const invalidateBudget = useInvalidateBudget();
  // Free rebalancing: any envelope can be a source or destination (ISC-89).
  const spendable = rows;
  const [toId, setToId] = React.useState(defaultToId ?? spendable[0]?.id ?? "");
  const [fromId, setFromId] = React.useState(spendable[1]?.id ?? spendable[0]?.id ?? "");
  const [amount, setAmount] = React.useState("");
  const [scope, setScope] = React.useState<ChangeScope>("this_month");
  const [busy, setBusy] = React.useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (open && defaultToId) setToId(defaultToId);
  }, [open, defaultToId]);

  const amountCents = Math.round((parseFloat(amount) || 0) * 100);
  const from = rows.find((r) => r.id === fromId);
  const sourceLeft = from?.leftCents ?? 0;
  // The plan stays balanced when the source can fund the move without going
  // negative. Conservation always holds (out === in); "balanced" here means the
  // source does not fall into deficit.
  const staysBalanced = amountCents > 0 && amountCents <= sourceLeft && fromId !== toId;
  const sameEnvelope = fromId === toId;

  const onSubmit = async () => {
    if (amountCents <= 0 || sameEnvelope) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setResult(null);
    try {
      // Post to the free-reallocation endpoint; the move is recorded as a
      // traceable movement (ISC-90) the History view then surfaces.
      const res = await call("POST /api/move", {
        fromEnvelopeId: fromId,
        toEnvelopeId: toId,
        amountCents,
        scope,
      });
      if (isApiError(res)) {
        setResult(res.error);
        return;
      }
      setAmount("");
      // Invalidate the shared budget queries so the grid and net-position banner
      // refresh atomically (the same money move touches both).
      invalidateBudget();
      onOpenChange(false);
    } catch (e) {
      setResult(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Could not move money.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Move money</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>Reallocate between envelopes. Every dollar is conserved.</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-[1fr_auto_1fr] sm:items-end">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>From (source)</Label>
            <Select value={fromId} onValueChange={setFromId}>
              <SelectTrigger>
                <SelectValue placeholder="Source envelope" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {spendable.map((r) => (
                  <SelectItem key={r.id} value={r.id}>
                    {r.name} ({formatCents(r.leftCents)})
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
          <div className="hidden pb-2 sm:block">
            <ArrowRight className="h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground" />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>To</Label>
            <Select value={toId} onValueChange={setToId}>
              <SelectTrigger>
                <SelectValue placeholder="Destination envelope" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {spendable.map((r) => (
                  <SelectItem key={r.id} value={r.id}>
                    {r.name} ({formatCents(r.leftCents)})
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="amount">Amount (AUD)</Label>
            <Input
              id="amount"
              type="number"
              min="0"
              step="0.01"
              inputMode="decimal"
              placeholder="0.00"
              value={amount}
              onChange={(e) => setAmount(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>Scope</Label>
            <Select value={scope} onValueChange={(v) => setScope(v as ChangeScope)}>
              <SelectTrigger>
                <SelectValue />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="this_month">This month only</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="ongoing">Every month (ongoing)</SelectItem>
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Budget-stays-balanced indicator */}
        <div
          className={cn(
            "flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm",
            sameEnvelope
              ? "bg-muted text-muted-foreground"
              : staysBalanced
                ? "bg-success/15 text-success"
                : "bg-warning/15 text-warning"
          )}
        >
          {sameEnvelope ? (
            <>Pick a different source and destination.</>
          ) : staysBalanced ? (
            <>
              <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" /> Budget stays balanced — {from?.name} keeps{" "}
              {formatCents(sourceLeft - amountCents)}.
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4" /> This move puts {from?.name} into deficit. Allowed, but the
              zero-based alert will fire.
            </>
          )}
        </div>
        {result && <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{result}</p>}

        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button onClick={onSubmit} disabled={busy || amountCents <= 0 || sameEnvelope}>
            {busy ? "Moving…" : "Move money"}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

import { Link, useParams, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { ArrowLeft, ArrowLeftRight, Clock, AlertTriangle, Pencil, Archive, ArchiveRestore } from "lucide-react";
import type { NamedPeriod } from "@contract";

  useTransactions,

} from "@/lib/queries";
import { resolveCarryoverCents, type CarryoverMode } from "@/lib/carryover";

// The monthly Trends chart pulls in recharts; lazy-load it so the detail page's
// first paint stays light (mirrors the BudgetPage chart pattern).
const EnvelopeTrendChart = React.lazy(() =>
  import("@/components/charts/EnvelopeTrendChart").then((m) => ({ default: m.EnvelopeTrendChart })),
);

/**
 * Manually adjust an envelope's carried starting balance (N1: was an IIFE inside
 * the page's JSX). Set replaces the carryover; Add/Subtract apply a delta. Saving
 * posts a traceable carryover.reset event and invalidates the budget queries.
 */
function CarryoverAdjuster({ envelopeId, currentCarryoverCents }: { envelopeId: string; currentCarryoverCents: number }) {
  const invalidateBudget = useInvalidateBudget();
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [mode, setMode] = React.useState<CarryoverMode>("set");
  const [value, setValue] = React.useState<string>("");
  const target = resolveCarryoverCents(mode, currentCarryoverCents, value);

  if (!open) {
    return (
      <Button
        variant="outline"
        size="sm"
        onClick={() => {
          setMode("set");
          setValue((currentCarryoverCents / 100).toFixed(2));
          setOpen(true);
        }}
      >
        Adjust carryover
      </Button>
    );
  }
  return (
    <>
      <div className="inline-flex rounded-md border p-0.5 text-xs">
        {(["set", "add", "subtract"] as const).map((m) => (
          <button
            key={m}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setMode(m);
              setValue(m === "set" ? (currentCarryoverCents / 100).toFixed(2) : "");
            }}
            className={cn(
              "rounded px-2 py-1 capitalize transition-colors",
              mode === m ? "bg-primary text-primary-foreground" : "text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent",
            )}
          >
            {m}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground tnum">{mode === "subtract" ? "−$" : mode === "add" ? "+$" : "$"}</span>
      <Input
        type="number"
        step="0.01"
        className="h-9 w-28 tnum"
        value={value}
        onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)}
      />
      {mode !== "set" && (
        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          → <span className="font-medium text-foreground tnum">{formatCents(target)}</span>
        </span>
      )}
      <Button
        size="sm"
        onClick={async () => {
          await call("POST /api/envelopes/carryover", { envelopeId, carryoverCents: target });
          setOpen(false);
          invalidateBudget();
        }}
      >
        Save
      </Button>
      <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
        Cancel
      </Button>
    </>
  );
}

function StatTile({ label, value, tone }: { label: string; value: number; tone?: string }) {
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardContent className="p-3">
        <div className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">{label}</div>
        <div className={cn("tnum mt-1 text-lg font-semibold", tone)}>{formatCents(value)}</div>
      </CardContent>
