}

/** Per-envelope detail with the four figures and that envelope's transactions (ISC-35). */
export function EnvelopeDetailPage() {
  const { id = "" } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const invalidateBudget = useInvalidateBudget();
  const [moveOpen, setMoveOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [editOpen, setEditOpen] = React.useState(false);
  // Period selector for the trend graph + transactions below it.
  // The envelope-overview section defaults to the financial year; the monthly tiles above it are always this month.
  const [periodSel, setPeriodSel] = React.useState<NamedPeriod | "custom">("this-fy");
  const [customFrom, setCustomFrom] = React.useState<string>("");
  const [customTo, setCustomTo] = React.useState<string>("");

  // The selected range drives the trend chart, the transactions list, and the
  // period-scoped grid figures. A half-entered custom range holds those queries.
  const range = periodSel === "custom" ? { from: customFrom, to: customTo } : namedPeriodRange(periodSel);
  const rangeReady = periodSel !== "custom" || (Boolean(customFrom) && Boolean(customTo));

  const detailQ = useEnvelopeDetail(id);
  // The Envelope-overview figures for the SELECTED period come from a period-scoped
  // detail read (ONE row), not the whole grid (Phase 4, M-detail): the endpoint now
  // carries from/to. The whole-grid read is reserved for the move/edit modals, which
  // genuinely need every envelope — so it is fetched only when a modal opens.
  const detailRangeQ = useEnvelopeDetail(id, { from: range.from, to: range.to }, { enabled: rangeReady });
  const gridQ = useEnvelopes({ from: range.from, to: range.to }, { enabled: rangeReady && (moveOpen || editOpen) });
  const trendQ = useEnvelopeTrend(id, range.from, range.to, { enabled: rangeReady });
  const txnsQ = useTransactions({ envelopeId: id, from: range.from, to: range.to }, { enabled: rangeReady });

  const loading = detailQ.isLoading;
  const detail = detailQ.data && !isApiError(detailQ.data) ? detailQ.data : null;
  const error = detailQ.isError
    ? detailQ.error instanceof Error
      ? detailQ.error.message
      : "Could not load this envelope."
    : detailQ.data && isApiError(detailQ.data)
      ? detailQ.data.error
      : null;
  const grid = gridQ.data ?? null;
  const detailRange = detailRangeQ.data && !isApiError(detailRangeQ.data) ? detailRangeQ.data : null;
  // A 404/unknown id leaves the trend and list in their honest empty state.
  const trend = trendQ.data && !isApiError(trendQ.data) ? trendQ.data : null;
  const txns = txnsQ.data && !isApiError(txnsQ.data) ? txnsQ.data.items : [];

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="py-16 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground animate-pulse">Loading envelope…</div>;
  }

  if (error || !detail) {
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-md py-16 text-center">
        <AlertTriangle className="mx-auto mb-3 h-8 w-8 text-warning" />
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{error ?? "Envelope not found."}</p>
        <Button asChild className="mt-4" variant="outline" size="sm">
          <Link to="/">Back to budget</Link>
        </Button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const env = detail.envelope;
  const leftTone = env.leftCents < 0 ? "text-destructive" : env.leftCents === 0 ? "text-muted-foreground" : "text-success";
  const isIncome = env.type === "income";
  // This envelope's figures for the SELECTED period, read as ONE row from the
  // period-scoped detail endpoint (not the whole grid), shown in the
  // Envelope-overview section so they track the dropdown.
  const periodIncome = isIncome ? detailRange?.income : undefined;
  const periodRow = !isIncome ? detailRange?.envelope : undefined;
  const tone = (v: number) => (v < 0 ? "text-destructive" : v === 0 ? "text-muted-foreground" : "text-success");
  const editTarget: BudgetEditTarget = {
    id: env.id,
    name: env.name,
    type: env.type,
    active: env.active,
    parentId: env.parentId,
    monthlyCents: env.allocationCents,
    period: env.period,
    rolloverStart: env.rolloverStart,
    // For income the allocation IS the budget; seed the income budget field from it.
    targetCents: isIncome ? env.allocationCents : 0,
  };

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-3xl space-y-5">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Button asChild variant="ghost" size="icon">
            <Link to="/" aria-label="Back to budget">
              <ArrowLeft className="h-5 w-5" />
            </Link>
          </Button>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{env.name}</h1>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              <span className="capitalize">{env.group}</span>
              <Badge variant="outline">{env.rolloverRule.replace("_", " ")}</Badge>
              {env.targetType !== "no_target" && (
                <span>Target {formatCents(env.targetAmountCents)} / {env.targetType}</span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => setEditOpen(true)}>
            <Pencil className="h-4 w-4" /> Edit
          </Button>
          {/* Archive / Unarchive (archive feature). Archiving hides the envelope from
              the grid entirely; we navigate back to the budget afterwards. Income
              envelopes are not archivable (the flag lives on the envelopes table). */}
          {!isIncome && (
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={async () => {
                await call("POST /api/envelopes/archive", { envelopeId: env.id, archived: !env.archived });
                invalidateBudget();
                navigate("/");
              }}
            >
              {env.archived ? (
                <>
                  <ArchiveRestore className="h-4 w-4" /> Unarchive
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Archive className="h-4 w-4" /> Archive
                </>
              )}
            </Button>
          )}
          <Button size="sm" onClick={() => setMoveOpen(true)}>
            <ArrowLeftRight className="h-4 w-4" /> Move money
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-muted-foreground">Monthly overview</h2>
      {isIncome && detail.income ? (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 md:grid-cols-4">
          <StatTile label="Carryover" value={detail.income.carryoverCents} />
          <StatTile label="Target" value={detail.income.budgetedCents} />
          <StatTile label="Received" value={detail.income.receivedCents} />
          <StatTile
            label="Variance"
            value={detail.income.varianceCents}
            tone={detail.income.varianceCents < 0 ? "text-destructive" : detail.income.varianceCents === 0 ? "text-muted-foreground" : "text-success"}
          />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 md:grid-cols-4">
          <StatTile label="Carryover" value={env.carryoverCents} />
          <StatTile label="Allocation" value={env.allocationCents} />
          <StatTile label="Total" value={env.totalCents} />
          <StatTile label="Left" value={env.leftCents} tone={leftTone} />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Manually adjust the carried starting balance (traceable as a reset event). */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <CarryoverAdjuster
          envelopeId={env.id}
          currentCarryoverCents={isIncome && detail.income ? detail.income.carryoverCents : env.carryoverCents}
        />
      </div>

      <h2 className="mt-3 border-t pt-4 text-sm font-semibold text-muted-foreground">Envelope overview</h2>
      {/* Shared period selector (named periods + custom range with Today and
          Rolling/Calendar 3m/6m/12m quick options) driving the figures, the trend
          chart, and the transactions list below. */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <span className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Period</span>
        <PeriodSelector
          value={periodSel}
          onChange={setPeriodSel}
          customFrom={customFrom}
          customTo={customTo}
          onCustomFrom={setCustomFrom}
          onCustomTo={setCustomTo}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Period-driven figures (track the dropdown): income shows carryover/received/
          target/variance; expense/saving/envelope shows carryover/allocation/total/left. */}
      {isIncome && periodIncome ? (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 md:grid-cols-4">
          <StatTile label="Carryover" value={periodIncome.carryoverCents} />
          <StatTile label="Received" value={periodIncome.receivedCents} />
          <StatTile label="Target" value={periodIncome.targetCents} />
          <StatTile label="Variance" value={periodIncome.varianceCents} tone={tone(periodIncome.varianceCents)} />
        </div>
      ) : periodRow ? (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 md:grid-cols-4">
          <StatTile label="Carryover" value={periodRow.carryoverCents} />
          <StatTile label="Allocation" value={periodRow.allocationCents} />
          <StatTile label="Total" value={periodRow.totalCents} />
          <StatTile label="Left" value={periodRow.leftCents} tone={tone(periodRow.leftCents)} />
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {/* Monthly Trends chart vs the budget/target line (GAP-A) */}
      {trend && (
        <React.Suspense fallback={<div className="h-[320px] rounded-lg border bg-card animate-pulse" />}>
          <EnvelopeTrendChart trend={trend} mode={isIncome ? "income" : "spend"} />
        </React.Suspense>
      )}

      <div>
        <h2 className="mb-2 text-sm font-semibold text-muted-foreground">Transactions</h2>
        <div className="rounded-lg border bg-card divide-y divide-border/40">
          {txns.length === 0 && (
            <div className="px-4 py-8 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">No transactions in this period.</div>
          )}
          {txns.map((t) => (
            <div key={t.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-3">
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="truncate text-sm font-medium">{t.payee}</span>
                  {t.isPending && (
                    <Badge variant="outline" className="gap-1 text-[10px]">
                      <Clock className="h-3 w-3" /> Pending
                    </Badge>
                  )}
                  {t.isTransfer && <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px]">Transfer</Badge>}
                </div>
                <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t.date}</div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-right">
                <div className={cn("tnum text-sm font-medium", t.amountCents < 0 ? "" : "text-success")}>
                  {formatCents(t.amountCents, { sign: true })}
                </div>
                {/* Envelope balance immediately after this transaction (running balance). */}
                <div className="tnum text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                  bal {formatCents(t.balanceAfterCents)}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          Pending transactions show here but do not decrement the balance. Posted spend decrements on its transaction date.
        </p>
      </div>

      <MoveMoneyModal
        open={moveOpen}
        onOpenChange={setMoveOpen}
        rows={grid?.rows ?? []}
        defaultToId={env.id}
      />
      <AddBudgetModal
        open={editOpen}
        onOpenChange={setEditOpen}
        rows={grid?.rows ?? []}
        editTarget={editTarget}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import { useAnchoredPosition } from "@/lib/useAnchoredPosition";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

/**
 * Cursor-anchored carryover adjustment. Clicking an envelope's Carryover figure on
 * the budget grid opens this at the pointer; saving posts to /api/envelopes/carryover,
 * which records a traceable carryover.reset event. Responsive: a floating popover on
 * desktop, a bottom sheet on touch. Closes on Escape and outside/backdrop click.
 */
export interface CarryoverAnchor {
  readonly envelopeId: string;
  readonly envelopeName: string;
  readonly currentCents: number;
  readonly x: number;
  readonly y: number;
}

export function CarryoverPopover({
  anchor,
  onClose,
}: {
  anchor: CarryoverAnchor;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const invalidateBudget = useInvalidateBudget();
  const isMobile = useIsMobile();
  const [mode, setMode] = React.useState<"set" | "add" | "subtract">("set");
  const [value, setValue] = React.useState<string>((anchor.currentCents / 100).toFixed(2));
  const [busy, setBusy] = React.useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  // Escape + outside-click dismissal and focus trap/restore (m2); the mobile
  // sheet opts out of outside-click and dismisses on its backdrop tap.
  const ref = useDismissable<HTMLDivElement>({ onClose, closeOnOutsideClick: !isMobile });
  const pos = useAnchoredPosition(ref, anchor, { enabled: !isMobile });

  // Set replaces the carryover; Add/Subtract apply a delta to the current value.
  // The endpoint always stores the resulting absolute value, so compute it here.
  const targetCents = resolveCarryoverCents(mode, anchor.currentCents, value);
  const switchMode = (m: "set" | "add" | "subtract") => {
    setMode(m);
    setValue(m === "set" ? (anchor.currentCents / 100).toFixed(2) : "");
  };

  const save = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await call("POST /api/envelopes/carryover", {
        envelopeId: anchor.envelopeId,
        carryoverCents: targetCents,
      });
      if (isApiError(res)) {
        setError(res.error);
        return;
      }
      invalidateBudget();
      onClose();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Could not save.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const body = (
    <div className="p-3">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="truncate text-sm font-semibold">{anchor.envelopeName}</div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Adjust carryover (logged as a reset)</div>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-label="Close"

            type="button"
            onClick={() => switchMode(m)}
            className={cn(

            <span className="h-1.5 w-10 rounded-full bg-muted-foreground/30" />
          </div>
          {body}
        </div>
      </div>,
      document.body
    );
  }

  return createPortal(
    <div
      ref={ref}
      role="dialog"
      aria-label={`Adjust carryover for ${anchor.envelopeName}`}
      style={{ position: "fixed", left: pos.left, top: pos.top }}
      className="z-50 w-[min(18rem,calc(100vw-1rem))] rounded-lg border bg-popover text-popover-foreground shadow-lg"
    >
      {body}
    </div>,
    document.body
  );

  const [carryoverAnchor, setCarryoverAnchor] = React.useState<CarryoverAnchor | null>(null);

    setEditTarget(null);

      name: row.name,
      type: row.type,

      <AddBudgetModal open={addOpen} onOpenChange={setAddOpen} rows={grid.rows} editTarget={editTarget} />
    </div>
  );

/**
 * Live countdown of the idle session deadline (ISC-39). The indicator does not
 * just display the deadline — it acts on it: once the remaining time reaches

 * own timer (which a backgrounded/throttled tab can stall). The pill turns amber

function IdleIndicator() {
  const { idleExpiresAt, signOut } = useSession();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [now, setNow] = React.useState(Date.now());
  const locking = React.useRef(false);

    return () => clearInterval(t);

 * mints a session cookie immediately; cloud email sign-in sends a magic link and

 * (AuthError is surfaced as a flat 401). The session route reflects the resolved

import { Hono } from "hono";
import type { Container } from "../../composition.ts";
import { AuthError, type BeginSignInInput } from "../../platform/auth.ts";
import type { ApiError, ChangePinRequest, ChangePinResponse, SessionResponse, SignInRequest, SignInResponse, VerifyLinkRequest } from "../contract.ts";
import { clearCookie, resolveSession, sessionCookie, UNAUTHENTICATED } from "../http.ts";

export function registerAuth(api: Hono, container: Container): void {
  const secure = container.config.deployMode === "cloud";

  api.post("/auth/signin", async (c) => {
    const body = (await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Partial<SignInRequest>;

    let input: BeginSignInInput;
    if (body.kind === "pin" && typeof body.pin === "string") {
      input = { kind: "pin", pin: body.pin };
    } else if (body.kind === "email" && typeof body.email === "string") {
      input = { kind: "email", email: body.email };
    } else {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Bad sign-in request.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }

    try {
      const session = await container.auth.beginSignIn(input);
      if (session) {
        // Local PIN: a session was minted immediately. Set the cookie.
        const token = await container.auth.mintToken(session);
        c.header("Set-Cookie", sessionCookie(token, secure));
        const res: SignInResponse = { status: "authenticated", userId: session.userId };
        return c.json(res);
      }
      // Cloud email: link sent, second step (verify) required.
      const res: SignInResponse = { status: "link_sent", userId: null };
      return c.json(res);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof AuthError) {
        const err: ApiError = { error: "Sign-in failed.", code: "auth_failed" };
        return c.json(err, 401);
      }
      throw e;
    }
  });

  api.post("/auth/verify", async (c) => {
    const body = (await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Partial<VerifyLinkRequest>;
    if (typeof body.token !== "string") {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "Missing token.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    try {
      const session = await container.auth.completeSignIn(body.token);
      const token = await container.auth.mintToken(session);
      c.header("Set-Cookie", sessionCookie(token, secure));
      const res: SessionResponse = {
        authenticated: true,
        userId: session.userId,
        idleExpiresAt: session.idleExpiresAt,
      };
      return c.json(res);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof AuthError) {
        const err: ApiError = { error: "Verification failed.", code: "auth_failed" };
        return c.json(err, 401);
      }
      throw e;
    }
  });

  api.get("/auth/session", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    const res: SessionResponse = session
      ? { authenticated: true, userId: session.userId, idleExpiresAt: session.idleExpiresAt }
      : { authenticated: false, userId: null, idleExpiresAt: null };
    return c.json(res);
  });

  api.post("/auth/signout", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (session) await container.auth.signOut(session);
    c.header("Set-Cookie", clearCookie());
    return c.json({ ok: true } as const);
  });

  // Change the local PIN. Must be authenticated (the session gates who can change
  // it). The current PIN is re-verified by the AuthProvider with the same scheme
  // sign-in uses; a wrong current PIN or invalid new PIN returns 400 — NEVER 401,
  // which would trip the client idle-lock and sign the user out mid-change.
  api.post("/auth/change-pin", async (c) => {
    const session = await resolveSession(c, container);
    if (!session) return c.json(UNAUTHENTICATED, 401);
    const body = (await c.req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Partial<ChangePinRequest>;
    if (typeof body.currentPin !== "string" || typeof body.newPin !== "string") {
      const err: ApiError = { error: "currentPin and newPin are required.", code: "bad_request" };
      return c.json(err, 400);
    }
    try {
      await container.auth.changePin(body.currentPin, body.newPin);
      const res: ChangePinResponse = { ok: true };
      return c.json(res);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof AuthError) {
        // Never leak whether it was the current PIN or the new PIN policy at 401;
        // surface the specific-but-safe message at 400 so the app stays signed in.
        const err: ApiError = { error: e.message, code: "pin_change_failed" };
        return c.json(err, 400);
      }
      throw e;
    }
  });

// ── Envelopes grid (with rollups) ─────────────────────────────────────────────

/** One row in the Dave Ramsey grid, with the four figures and tree position. */
export interface EnvelopeRow {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly parentId: string | null;
  readonly name: string;
  readonly group: string;
  readonly rolloverRule: RolloverRule;
  readonly targetType: TargetType;
  readonly targetAmountCents: number;
  /** Envelope type (ISC-91): income, expense, saving, envelope, or working. */
  readonly type: EnvelopeType;
  /** Active flag (ISC-100). Inactive envelopes are excluded from the budget total. */
  readonly active: boolean;
  /** Archived flag. Archived envelopes are excluded entirely from the grid. */
  readonly archived: boolean;
  /** The period the budget is entered in (ISC-94): weekly, fortnightly, monthly, annual. */
  readonly period: BudgetPeriod;
  /**
   * The date the rollover schedule is anchored on (YYYY-MM-DD), or null when no
   * baseline has been set. Editable per budget; drives the per-transaction running
   * balance schedule and seeds the Edit Budget date input.
   */
  readonly rolloverStart: string | null;
  /** Starting carryover (may be negative). */
  readonly carryoverCents: number;
  /** This-period allocation. */
  readonly allocationCents: number;
  /** carryover + allocation. */
  readonly totalCents: number;
  /** total - spent. */
  readonly leftCents: number;
  /** Depth in the tree, 0 = top level. */
  readonly depth: number;
}

/**
 * A first-class income envelope on the grid (ISC-65, ISC-88, ISC-101). It carries
 * the same four figures as an expense row so the UI can render the two identically:
 *
 *   carryoverCents  starting carryover on the income envelope (signed)
 *   budgetedCents   the budget (the expected/target income) — column 2
 *   receivedCents   actual income that landed in the range, in place of "spent"
 *   leftCents       carryover + received - budget (the running income surplus/deficit)
 *
 * `actualCents` is retained as an alias of `receivedCents`, and `varianceCents`
 * (received - target) is retained for the legacy surplus/deficit view (ISC-99).
 * The old `capitalToExpenseCents` field was removed: the income budget is itself
 * the balancing figure (ISA Changelog 2026-06-27).
 */
export interface IncomeEnvelopeView {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly name: string;
  readonly source: string;
  /** The budget: expected/target income for the range (column 2). */
  readonly budgetedCents: number;
  /** Actual income received in the range; alias of receivedCents (column 3). */
  readonly actualCents: number;
  /** Actual income received in the range, in place of "spent" (ISC-101). */
  readonly receivedCents: number;
  /** Income target for the range (defaults to the budget). */
  readonly targetCents: number;
  /** received - target. Positive = surplus, negative = deficit (ISC-99). */
  readonly varianceCents: number;
  /** Starting carryover on the income envelope, signed (column 1). */
  readonly carryoverCents: number;
  /** carryover + received - budget: the running income surplus/deficit (column 4, ISC-101). */
  readonly leftCents: number;
}

/** A named period selection for the grid (ISC-103). Australian FY = 1 Jul to 30 Jun. */
export type NamedPeriod = "this-month" | "last-month" | "this-fy" | "last-fy";

/**
 * Period selection for GET /api/envelopes (ISC-103, ISC-104). Either a named
 * period (default this-month) OR an explicit from/to custom date range. When
 * both are present, the explicit from/to wins. Omitting everything is this-month.
 */
export interface EnvelopesQuery {
  readonly period?: NamedPeriod;
  /** Inclusive custom-range lower bound (YYYY-MM-DD). */
  readonly from?: string;
  /** Inclusive custom-range upper bound (YYYY-MM-DD). */
  readonly to?: string;
}

export interface GridResponse {
  /** ISO YYYY-MM for the rendered period (the range's final month). */
  readonly period: string;
  /** Inclusive ISO date bounds of the rendered range (ISC-104). */
  readonly from: string;
  readonly to: string;
  readonly rows: readonly EnvelopeRow[];
  /** First-class income envelopes with budgeted/actual/variance (ISC-65, ISC-88). */
  readonly income: readonly IncomeEnvelopeView[];
  /**
   * False when the tenant has zero envelopes: the UI shows the empty "not set up
   * yet" state instead of a misleading zeroed balance (ISC-88).
   */
  readonly isSetUp: boolean;
  /** Total budgeted income across income envelopes (the zero-based denominator). */
  readonly budgetedIncomeCents: number;
  /** Continuous zero-based check: positive = unallocated, negative = over-allocated. */
  readonly unallocatedCents: number;
  /** True when the budget is not zero-based; an alert, never a block (ISC-30). */
  readonly zeroBasedAlert: boolean;
  /**
   * Income capital provided = sum of income budgets over the range (ISC-92). The
   * income budget is itself the balancing figure; there is no capital sub-pool.
   */
  readonly capitalProvidedCents: number;
  /** Total budgeted out: sum of active expense+saving+envelope budgets over the range (ISC-98). */
  readonly budgetedOutCents: number;
  /** capitalProvided - budgetedOut. Zero when the zero-base balances (ISC-98). */
  readonly residualCents: number;
  /**
   * Count of transactions in the rendered period that resolve to NO envelope
   * (unmapped, ISC-20). These sit outside every budget; the UI surfaces them as a
   * single "to be categorised" summary line above the budget sections.
   */
  readonly uncategorisedCount: number;
  /** Signed-cents total of those same uncategorised transactions. */
  readonly uncategorisedTotalCents: number;
  readonly asOf: number;
}

/** The budget-balancing (zero-base) figures, ISC-98 / ISC-99. */
export interface BudgetBalanceResponse {
  /** Sum of income budgets over the range: the income capital provided (ISC-92). */
  readonly capitalProvidedCents: number;
  /** Sum of active expense+saving+envelope budgets over the range: the amount budgeted out. */
  readonly budgetedOutCents: number;
  /** capitalProvided - budgetedOut. Zero when balanced; the residual otherwise. */
  readonly residualCents: number;
}

/** Time-travel view: balances as at end-of-day T (ISC-36). */
export interface AsOfRequest {
  readonly date: string;
}

// ── Envelope detail ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface TransactionView {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly date: string;
  readonly amountCents: number;
  readonly payee: string;
  readonly isPending: boolean;
  readonly isTransfer: boolean;
}

export interface EnvelopeDetailResponse {
  readonly envelope: EnvelopeRow;
  readonly transactions: readonly TransactionView[];
  /**
   * Present only when the resolved envelope is an income envelope (id prefix
   * `inc-`). The four-figure `envelope` row above is synthesised from this view
   * (carryover, budget→allocation, carryover+received→total, left) so the detail
   * UI renders income identically; `income` carries the lossless income figures
   * (budgeted/received/target/variance) for richer rendering (ISC-65, ISC-101).
   */
  readonly income?: IncomeEnvelopeView;
}

// ── Envelope trend: spend-over-time series (GAP-A, ISC-16) ─────────────────────

/** Query for GET /api/envelopes/trend: one envelope, optional inclusive date window. */
export interface TrendQuery {
  readonly id: string;

  const idx = path.indexOf(" ");

}

export function isApiError(res: unknown): res is ApiError {
  return typeof res === "object" && res !== null && "error" in res && "code" in res;
}

export class HttpError extends Error {
  constructor(public status: number, message: string) {
    super(message);
  }

 * here; any API call that comes back 401 (the server expired or rejected the
 * session) fires it exactly once per response so the app can surface the lock and
 * redirect to sign-in, rather than rendering a generic "could not load" error.
 */
let onUnauthorized: (() => void) | null = null;
export function setUnauthorizedHandler(fn: (() => void) | null): void {
  onUnauthorized = fn;
}

 * params (the contract GETs carry small primitive params); everything else
 * sends JSON. Undefined/null/empty params are dropped so optional filters stay
 * optional on the wire (ISC-79, ISC-80).

export async function call<P extends ApiPath>(
  path: P,

): Promise<Res<P>> {

  const body = args[0] as Req<P> | undefined;

  let finalUrl = url;

  if (method === "GET") {

  }

  // A 401 means the session lapsed (idle lock or server-side expiry). Surface the
  // lock globally before the per-call error path so the app redirects to sign-in.
  if (resp.status === 401) {
    onUnauthorized?.();
    throw new HttpError(401, `${method} ${url} failed: 401`);
  }

  const json = text ? JSON.parse(text) : {};

/**
 * Cursor-anchored carryover adjustment. Clicking an envelope's Carryover figure on
 * the budget grid opens this at the pointer; saving posts to /api/envelopes/carryover,
 * which records a traceable carryover.reset event. Responsive: a floating popover on
 * desktop, a bottom sheet on touch. Closes on Escape and outside/backdrop click.
 */
export interface CarryoverAnchor {
  readonly envelopeId: string;
  readonly envelopeName: string;
  readonly currentCents: number;
  readonly x: number;
  readonly y: number;
}

export function CarryoverPopover({
  anchor,
  onClose,
}: {
  anchor: CarryoverAnchor;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const invalidateBudget = useInvalidateBudget();
  const isMobile = useIsMobile();
  const [mode, setMode] = React.useState<"set" | "add" | "subtract">("set");
  const [value, setValue] = React.useState<string>((anchor.currentCents / 100).toFixed(2));
  const [busy, setBusy] = React.useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  // Escape + outside-click dismissal and focus trap/restore (m2); the mobile

  const ref = useDismissable<HTMLDivElement>({ onClose, closeOnOutsideClick: !isMobile });
  const pos = useAnchoredPosition(ref, anchor, { enabled: !isMobile });

  // Set replaces the carryover; Add/Subtract apply a delta to the current value.
  // The endpoint always stores the resulting absolute value, so compute it here.
  const targetCents = resolveCarryoverCents(mode, anchor.currentCents, value);
  const switchMode = (m: "set" | "add" | "subtract") => {
    setMode(m);
    setValue(m === "set" ? (anchor.currentCents / 100).toFixed(2) : "");
  };

  const save = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await call("POST /api/envelopes/carryover", {
        envelopeId: anchor.envelopeId,
        carryoverCents: targetCents,
      });
      if (isApiError(res)) {
        setError(res.error);
        return;
      }
      invalidateBudget();
      onClose();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Could not save.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const body = (
    <div className="p-3">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="truncate text-sm font-semibold">{anchor.envelopeName}</div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Adjust carryover (logged as a reset)</div>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-label="Close"
          onClick={onClose}
          className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground"
        >
          <X className="h-4 w-4" />
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-2 inline-flex rounded-md border p-0.5 text-xs">
        {(["set", "add", "subtract"] as const).map((m) => (
          <button
            key={m}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => switchMode(m)}
            className={cn(
              "rounded px-2 py-1 capitalize transition-colors",
              mode === m ? "bg-primary text-primary-foreground" : "text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent",
            )}
          >
            {m}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
        <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground tnum">{mode === "subtract" ? "−$" : mode === "add" ? "+$" : "$"}</span>
        <Input
          type="number"
          step="0.01"
          className="h-9 w-28 tnum"
          value={value}
          autoFocus
          onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === "Enter") void save();
          }}
        />
        <Button size="sm" onClick={() => void save()} disabled={busy}>
          {busy ? "Saving…" : "Save"}
        </Button>
      </div>
      {mode !== "set" && (
        <div className="mt-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          {formatCents(anchor.currentCents)} → <span className="font-medium text-foreground tnum">{formatCents(targetCents)}</span>
        </div>
      )}
      {error && <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-destructive">{error}</div>}
    </div>
  );

  if (isMobile) {
    return createPortal(
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50">
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-foreground/40" onClick={onClose} aria-hidden="true" />
        <div
          ref={ref}
          role="dialog"
          aria-modal="true"
          aria-label={`Adjust carryover for ${anchor.envelopeName}`}
          className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 rounded-t-2xl border-t bg-popover text-popover-foreground shadow-2xl"
        >
          <div className="flex justify-center pt-2" aria-hidden="true">
            <span className="h-1.5 w-10 rounded-full bg-muted-foreground/30" />
          </div>
          {body}
        </div>
      </div>,
      document.body
    );
  }

  return createPortal(
    <div
      ref={ref}
      role="dialog"
      aria-label={`Adjust carryover for ${anchor.envelopeName}`}
      style={{ position: "fixed", left: pos.left, top: pos.top }}
      className="z-50 w-[min(18rem,calc(100vw-1rem))] rounded-lg border bg-popover text-popover-foreground shadow-lg"
    >
      {body}
    </div>,
    document.body
  );
}

import { ArrowRight, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle } from "lucide-react";
import type { EnvelopeRow } from "@contract";
import type { ChangeScope } from "@domain";
import { call, isApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import { useInvalidateBudget } from "@/lib/queries";
import { formatCents, cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Select, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, SelectContent, SelectItem } from "@/components/ui/select";

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  rows: readonly EnvelopeRow[];
  /** Optionally preselect the destination (e.g. opened from an envelope row). */
  defaultToId?: string;
}

/**
 * Move-money (reallocation) modal. Names an explicit source (From) and
 * destination (To); the amount leaving the source equals the amount entering
 * the destination (ISC-66). Scope is this-month-only or every-month (ongoing,
 * which edits the recurring template — ISC-67). A live indicator shows whether
 * the plan stays balanced (ISC-69): a same-envelope reallocation always
 * balances; moving from an envelope into deficit is allowed but flagged.
 */
export function MoveMoneyModal({ open, onOpenChange, rows, defaultToId }: Props) {
  const invalidateBudget = useInvalidateBudget();
  // Free rebalancing: any envelope can be a source or destination (ISC-89).
  const spendable = rows;
  const [toId, setToId] = React.useState(defaultToId ?? spendable[0]?.id ?? "");
  const [fromId, setFromId] = React.useState(spendable[1]?.id ?? spendable[0]?.id ?? "");
  const [amount, setAmount] = React.useState("");
  const [scope, setScope] = React.useState<ChangeScope>("this_month");
  const [busy, setBusy] = React.useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (open && defaultToId) setToId(defaultToId);
  }, [open, defaultToId]);

  const amountCents = Math.round((parseFloat(amount) || 0) * 100);
  const from = rows.find((r) => r.id === fromId);
  const sourceLeft = from?.leftCents ?? 0;
  // The plan stays balanced when the source can fund the move without going
  // negative. Conservation always holds (out === in); "balanced" here means the
  // source does not fall into deficit.
  const staysBalanced = amountCents > 0 && amountCents <= sourceLeft && fromId !== toId;
  const sameEnvelope = fromId === toId;

  const onSubmit = async () => {
    if (amountCents <= 0 || sameEnvelope) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setResult(null);
    try {
      // Post to the free-reallocation endpoint; the move is recorded as a
      // traceable movement (ISC-90) the History view then surfaces.
      const res = await call("POST /api/move", {
        fromEnvelopeId: fromId,
        toEnvelopeId: toId,
        amountCents,
        scope,
      });
      if (isApiError(res)) {
        setResult(res.error);
        return;
      }
      setAmount("");
      // Invalidate the shared budget queries so the grid and net-position banner
      // refresh atomically (the same money move touches both).
      invalidateBudget();
      onOpenChange(false);
    } catch (e) {
      setResult(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Could not move money.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Move money</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>Reallocate between envelopes. Every dollar is conserved.</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-[1fr_auto_1fr] sm:items-end">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>From (source)</Label>
            <Select value={fromId} onValueChange={setFromId}>
              <SelectTrigger>
                <SelectValue placeholder="Source envelope" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {spendable.map((r) => (
                  <SelectItem key={r.id} value={r.id}>
                    {r.name} ({formatCents(r.leftCents)})
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
          <div className="hidden pb-2 sm:block">
            <ArrowRight className="h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground" />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>To</Label>
            <Select value={toId} onValueChange={setToId}>
              <SelectTrigger>
                <SelectValue placeholder="Destination envelope" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {spendable.map((r) => (
                  <SelectItem key={r.id} value={r.id}>
                    {r.name} ({formatCents(r.leftCents)})
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="amount">Amount (AUD)</Label>
            <Input
              id="amount"
              type="number"
              min="0"
              step="0.01"
              inputMode="decimal"
              placeholder="0.00"
              value={amount}
              onChange={(e) => setAmount(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>Scope</Label>
            <Select value={scope} onValueChange={(v) => setScope(v as ChangeScope)}>
              <SelectTrigger>
                <SelectValue />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="this_month">This month only</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="ongoing">Every month (ongoing)</SelectItem>
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Budget-stays-balanced indicator */}
        <div
          className={cn(
            "flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm",
            sameEnvelope
              ? "bg-muted text-muted-foreground"
              : staysBalanced
                ? "bg-success/15 text-success"
                : "bg-warning/15 text-warning"
          )}
        >
          {sameEnvelope ? (
            <>Pick a different source and destination.</>
          ) : staysBalanced ? (
            <>
              <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" /> Budget stays balanced — {from?.name} keeps{" "}
              {formatCents(sourceLeft - amountCents)}.
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4" /> This move puts {from?.name} into deficit. Allowed, but the
              zero-based alert will fire.
            </>
          )}
        </div>
        {result && <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{result}</p>}

        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button onClick={onSubmit} disabled={busy || amountCents <= 0 || sameEnvelope}>
            {busy ? "Moving…" : "Move money"}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

Work ONLY under web/src/ (plus web test files). Do NOT touch src/, scripts/, docs/, package.json. Another agent is working on src/server in parallel — stay out of it.

Conventions: bun only (never npm), TypeScript strict, match existing code style. Gates that must stay green: `bun test web/`, `tsc -p web/tsconfig.json --noEmit`, `tsc -p web/tsconfig.test.json --noEmit`, `bun run lint`. Run them before finishing. Add focused tests for each fix.

FIX 1 — Idle-timer render storm [High]. web/src/lib/session.tsx: armIdleTimer (lines ~48-53) calls setIdleExpiresAt(Date.now()+30min) from window-level pointerdown/keydown listeners (~92-102), and the context value is a fresh object every render (~126-135). Every keystroke re-renders the entire app tree. Fix: keep the live deadline in a ref; only setState when the displayed minute actually changes (the indicator in AppShell.tsx:88 shows whole minutes) or at ~30s granularity; memoise the context value with useMemo. The idle-lock behaviour (lock fires when deadline passes) must be preserved exactly — check how the lock timeout is scheduled and keep it correct against the ref value. Add/extend a test proving rapid events don't cause unbounded re-renders (e.g. render-count probe component) and that lock still fires.

FIX 2 — call() typed lie [Medium]. web/src/lib/api.ts (~82-87): on !resp.ok, an ApiError-shaped body is RETURNED under the success type; a grid 400 renders BudgetPage's "No budget set up yet" empty state. Fix: make call() THROW on every !resp.ok — an ApiCallError (new class, exported) carrying status and the server's error string when parseable. Keep in-band ApiError unions working for 200-status domain errors. Then audit call sites: places that relied on isApiError-after-non-OK now need try/catch or will surface via React Query error states (that's desired). Ensure 401 handling (session expiry) still works — check how session.tsx and queries handle unauthenticated; preserve that path. Add a test: non-OK response → useEnvelopes/isError true, and BudgetPage does NOT render the empty state on error (error UI instead).

FIX 3 — Settings key save claims success on failure [Medium]. web/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx (~29-36, 69-73): `.catch(() => undefined)` then unconditional setSaved(true) and "Key stored in the secret store." Fix: mirror ChangePinControl's pattern (~190-208): try/catch, busy state, error message rendered, saved only on success. Test it.

FIX 4 — Fire-and-forget mutations [Medium]. web/src/pages/EnvelopeDetailPage.tsx (~89-98 CarryoverAdjuster save, ~226-245 Archive/Unarchive) and web/src/components/budget/CarryoverPopover.tsx: awaits inside onClick with no try/catch, no disabled-while-busy, no error surface; double-clicks double-post. Fix: busy/disabled state + error display, consistent with MoveMoneyModal's pattern (~61-88). A small shared helper hook is fine if it stays simple.

FIX 5 — MoveMoneyModal empty seeding on detail page [Medium]. web/src/components/MoveMoneyModal.tsx (~41-50): fromId/toId useState initialisers run with rows=[] (EnvelopeDetailPage enables useEnvelopes only when modal opens, EnvelopeDetailPage.tsx:141) and never re-run; only toId gets patched by the defaultToId effect. Fix: derive/repair both defaults when rows arrive while open (effect keyed on rows readiness), or key the modal's inner content on data readiness. First-open on the detail page must show a valid From selection. Test it with delayed rows.

OUT OF SCOPE: ARIA grid restructure, ReconcilePage/TransactionPopover query migration, keepPreviousData indicator, query-cache clear on lock. Do not do them.

FINAL MESSAGE (raw markdown): per fix — what changed (files), how verified (test names + gate output). Quote the final `bun test web/` and typecheck/lint results. If any fix proved riskier than described, say what you did instead and why.

import { call, setUnauthorizedHandler } from "@/lib/api";
import type { SessionResponse } from "@contract";

export const IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000;

  authenticated: boolean;

    setUserId(null);
    setIdleExpiresAt(null);

    if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current);

   * rejected us). Fired by the global 401 handler so any expired request locks
   * the app and routes back to sign-in (ISC-39).

    setUserId(null);
    setIdleExpiresAt(null);
    setLastSignOutReason("idle");

    setUnauthorizedHandler(lock);
    return () => setUnauthorizedHandler(null);
  }, [lock]);

    let cancelled = false;

    loading,
    idleExpiresAt,
    signIn,
    signOut,
    lastSignOutReason,

  const ctx = React.useContext(SessionContext);

import type { ApiContract, ApiPath, ApiError } from "@contract";

type Req<P extends ApiPath> = ApiContract[P]["req"];
type Res<P extends ApiPath> = ApiContract[P]["res"];

const BASE = ""; // same-origin; Hono serves the SPA and the API on one port (ISC-33).

function splitPath(path: ApiPath): { method: string; url: string } {
  const idx = path.indexOf(" ");
  return { method: path.slice(0, idx), url: BASE + path.slice(idx + 1) };
}

export function isApiError(res: unknown): res is ApiError {
  return typeof res === "object" && res !== null && "error" in res && "code" in res;
}

export class HttpError extends Error {
  constructor(public status: number, message: string) {
    super(message);
  }

/**
 * Global 401 handler (ISC-39 idle lock). The SessionProvider registers a callback
 * here; any API call that comes back 401 (the server expired or rejected the
 * session) fires it exactly once per response so the app can surface the lock and
 * redirect to sign-in, rather than rendering a generic "could not load" error.
 */
let onUnauthorized: (() => void) | null = null;
export function setUnauthorizedHandler(fn: (() => void) | null): void {
  onUnauthorized = fn;
}

/**
 * Issue a typed request. GET requests with a `req` body serialise it to query
 * params (the contract GETs carry small primitive params); everything else
 * sends JSON. Undefined/null/empty params are dropped so optional filters stay
 * optional on the wire (ISC-79, ISC-80).

export async function call<P extends ApiPath>(
  path: P,
  ...args: Req<P> extends void ? [] : [body: Req<P>]
): Promise<Res<P>> {

  let finalUrl = url;
  const init: RequestInit = { method, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, credentials: "same-origin" };

    init.body = JSON.stringify(body);
  }

  // A 401 means the session lapsed (idle lock or server-side expiry). Surface the
  // lock globally before the per-call error path so the app redirects to sign-in.
  if (resp.status === 401) {
    onUnauthorized?.();
    throw new HttpError(401, `${method} ${url} failed: 401`);
  }

  const json = text ? JSON.parse(text) : {};

function PocketSmithSection({ settings }: { settings: SettingsResponse }) {
  const [key, setKey] = React.useState("");
  const [saved, setSaved] = React.useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = React.useState(false);

  const onSave = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    // The key is write-only: posted to the SecretStore, never echoed back (ISC-56).
    await call("POST /api/settings/pocketsmith-key", { developerKey: key }).catch(() => undefined);
    setBusy(false);
    setSaved(true);
    setKey("");
  };

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <KeyRound className="h-4 w-4" /> PocketSmith developer key
        </CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          Held per-user in the secret store. Never shown again after saving, never logged.
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
          <Badge variant={settings.hasPocketSmithKey ? "success" : "outline"}>
            {settings.hasPocketSmithKey ? "Key set" : "No key"}
          </Badge>
          <span className="text-muted-foreground">X-Developer-Key header auth</span>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="pskey">{settings.hasPocketSmithKey ? "Replace key" : "Set key"}</Label>
          <Input
            id="pskey"
            type="password"
            autoComplete="off"
            placeholder="Paste your PocketSmith developer key"
            value={key}
            onChange={(e) => setKey(e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>
        <Button onClick={onSave} disabled={busy || key.length === 0}>
          {busy ? "Saving…" : "Save key"}
        </Button>
        {saved && (
          <p className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-success">
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" /> Key stored in the secret store.
          </p>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

function SyncSection({ settings }: { settings: SettingsResponse }) {
  // The last sync time is the real value from GET /api/settings — never
  // fabricated (ISC-83). "Sync now" triggers the real POST /api/sync (the same
  // incremental pull the daily cron runs); no fake progress is shown.
  const invalidate = useInvalidateAfterSync();
  const [busy, setBusy] = React.useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [result, setResult] = React.useState<{ transactions: number } | null>(null);
  const lastSync = settings.lastSyncAt;

  const onSyncNow = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    setResult(null);
    try {
      const res = await call("POST /api/sync");
      if (res.ok) {
        setResult({ transactions: res.transactions });
        invalidate();
      } else {
        setError(res.message ?? "Sync failed.");
      }
    } catch {
      setError("Could not reach the server. Try again.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" /> Sync status
        </CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>Daily pull from PocketSmith. No webhooks, no push.</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-md bg-muted/50 px-3 py-2 text-sm">
          <span className="text-muted-foreground">Last successful sync</span>
          <span className="font-medium">{lastSync ? new Date(lastSync).toLocaleString("en-AU") : "Never"}</span>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={onSyncNow} disabled={busy}>
          <RefreshCw className={busy ? "h-4 w-4 animate-spin" : "h-4 w-4"} /> {busy ? "Syncing…" : "Sync now"}
        </Button>
        {result && (
          <p className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-success">
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" />
            {result.transactions === 0
              ? "Up to date — no new transactions."
              : `Synced ${result.transactions.toLocaleString("en-AU")} transaction${result.transactions === 1 ? "" : "s"}.`}
          </p>
        )}
        {error && <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{error}</p>}
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          Sync also runs daily and automatically. Use this to pull the latest right now.
        </p>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

import { ArrowRight, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle } from "lucide-react";
import type { EnvelopeRow } from "@contract";
import type { ChangeScope } from "@domain";
import { call, isApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import { useInvalidateBudget } from "@/lib/queries";
import { formatCents, cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Select, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, SelectContent, SelectItem } from "@/components/ui/select";

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  rows: readonly EnvelopeRow[];
  /** Optionally preselect the destination (e.g. opened from an envelope row). */
  defaultToId?: string;
}

/**
 * Move-money (reallocation) modal. Names an explicit source (From) and
 * destination (To); the amount leaving the source equals the amount entering
 * the destination (ISC-66). Scope is this-month-only or every-month (ongoing,
 * which edits the recurring template — ISC-67). A live indicator shows whether
 * the plan stays balanced (ISC-69): a same-envelope reallocation always
 * balances; moving from an envelope into deficit is allowed but flagged.
 */
export function MoveMoneyModal({ open, onOpenChange, rows, defaultToId }: Props) {
  const invalidateBudget = useInvalidateBudget();
  // Free rebalancing: any envelope can be a source or destination (ISC-89).
  const spendable = rows;
  const [toId, setToId] = React.useState(defaultToId ?? spendable[0]?.id ?? "");
  const [fromId, setFromId] = React.useState(spendable[1]?.id ?? spendable[0]?.id ?? "");
  const [amount, setAmount] = React.useState("");
  const [scope, setScope] = React.useState<ChangeScope>("this_month");
  const [busy, setBusy] = React.useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (open && defaultToId) setToId(defaultToId);
  }, [open, defaultToId]);

  const amountCents = Math.round((parseFloat(amount) || 0) * 100);
  const from = rows.find((r) => r.id === fromId);
  const sourceLeft = from?.leftCents ?? 0;
  // The plan stays balanced when the source can fund the move without going
  // negative. Conservation always holds (out === in); "balanced" here means the
  // source does not fall into deficit.
  const staysBalanced = amountCents > 0 && amountCents <= sourceLeft && fromId !== toId;
  const sameEnvelope = fromId === toId;

  const onSubmit = async () => {
    if (amountCents <= 0 || sameEnvelope) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setResult(null);
    try {
      // Post to the free-reallocation endpoint; the move is recorded as a
      // traceable movement (ISC-90) the History view then surfaces.
      const res = await call("POST /api/move", {
        fromEnvelopeId: fromId,
        toEnvelopeId: toId,
        amountCents,
        scope,
      });
      if (isApiError(res)) {
        setResult(res.error);
        return;
      }
      setAmount("");
      // Invalidate the shared budget queries so the grid and net-position banner
      // refresh atomically (the same money move touches both).
      invalidateBudget();
      onOpenChange(false);
    } catch (e) {
      setResult(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Could not move money.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Move money</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>Reallocate between envelopes. Every dollar is conserved.</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-[1fr_auto_1fr] sm:items-end">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>From (source)</Label>
            <Select value={fromId} onValueChange={setFromId}>
              <SelectTrigger>
                <SelectValue placeholder="Source envelope" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {spendable.map((r) => (
                  <SelectItem key={r.id} value={r.id}>
                    {r.name} ({formatCents(r.leftCents)})
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
          <div className="hidden pb-2 sm:block">
            <ArrowRight className="h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground" />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>To</Label>
            <Select value={toId} onValueChange={setToId}>
              <SelectTrigger>
                <SelectValue placeholder="Destination envelope" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {spendable.map((r) => (
                  <SelectItem key={r.id} value={r.id}>
                    {r.name} ({formatCents(r.leftCents)})
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="amount">Amount (AUD)</Label>
            <Input
              id="amount"
              type="number"
              min="0"
              step="0.01"
              inputMode="decimal"
              placeholder="0.00"
              value={amount}
              onChange={(e) => setAmount(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>Scope</Label>
            <Select value={scope} onValueChange={(v) => setScope(v as ChangeScope)}>
              <SelectTrigger>
                <SelectValue />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="this_month">This month only</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="ongoing">Every month (ongoing)</SelectItem>
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Budget-stays-balanced indicator */}
        <div
          className={cn(
            "flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm",
            sameEnvelope
              ? "bg-muted text-muted-foreground"
              : staysBalanced
                ? "bg-success/15 text-success"
                : "bg-warning/15 text-warning"
          )}
        >
          {sameEnvelope ? (
            <>Pick a different source and destination.</>
          ) : staysBalanced ? (
            <>
              <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" /> Budget stays balanced — {from?.name} keeps{" "}
              {formatCents(sourceLeft - amountCents)}.
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4" /> This move puts {from?.name} into deficit. Allowed, but the
              zero-based alert will fire.
            </>
          )}
        </div>
        {result && <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{result}</p>}

        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button onClick={onSubmit} disabled={busy || amountCents <= 0 || sameEnvelope}>
            {busy ? "Moving…" : "Move money"}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

// The monthly Trends chart pulls in recharts; lazy-load it so the detail page's
// first paint stays light (mirrors the BudgetPage chart pattern).
const EnvelopeTrendChart = React.lazy(() =>
  import("@/components/charts/EnvelopeTrendChart").then((m) => ({ default: m.EnvelopeTrendChart })),
);

/**
 * Manually adjust an envelope's carried starting balance (N1: was an IIFE inside
 * the page's JSX). Set replaces the carryover; Add/Subtract apply a delta. Saving
 * posts a traceable carryover.reset event and invalidates the budget queries.
 */
function CarryoverAdjuster({ envelopeId, currentCarryoverCents }: { envelopeId: string; currentCarryoverCents: number }) {
  const invalidateBudget = useInvalidateBudget();
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [mode, setMode] = React.useState<CarryoverMode>("set");
  const [value, setValue] = React.useState<string>("");
  const target = resolveCarryoverCents(mode, currentCarryoverCents, value);

  if (!open) {
    return (
      <Button
        variant="outline"
        size="sm"
        onClick={() => {
          setMode("set");
          setValue((currentCarryoverCents / 100).toFixed(2));
          setOpen(true);
        }}
      >
        Adjust carryover
      </Button>
    );
  }
  return (
    <>
      <div className="inline-flex rounded-md border p-0.5 text-xs">
        {(["set", "add", "subtract"] as const).map((m) => (
          <button
            key={m}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setMode(m);
              setValue(m === "set" ? (currentCarryoverCents / 100).toFixed(2) : "");
            }}
            className={cn(
              "rounded px-2 py-1 capitalize transition-colors",
              mode === m ? "bg-primary text-primary-foreground" : "text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent",
            )}
          >
            {m}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground tnum">{mode === "subtract" ? "−$" : mode === "add" ? "+$" : "$"}</span>
      <Input
        type="number"
        step="0.01"
        className="h-9 w-28 tnum"
        value={value}
        onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)}
      />
      {mode !== "set" && (
        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          → <span className="font-medium text-foreground tnum">{formatCents(target)}</span>
        </span>
      )}
      <Button
        size="sm"
        onClick={async () => {
          await call("POST /api/envelopes/carryover", { envelopeId, carryoverCents: target });
          setOpen(false);
          invalidateBudget();
        }}
      >
        Save
      </Button>
      <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
        Cancel
      </Button>
    </>
  );
}

function StatTile({ label, value, tone }: { label: string; value: number; tone?: string }) {
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardContent className="p-3">
        <div className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">{label}</div>
        <div className={cn("tnum mt-1 text-lg font-semibold", tone)}>{formatCents(value)}</div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

          <StatTile label="Received" value={detail.income.receivedCents} />
          <StatTile
            label="Variance"
            value={detail.income.varianceCents}
            tone={detail.income.varianceCents < 0 ? "text-destructive" : detail.income.varianceCents === 0 ? "text-muted-foreground" : "text-success"}
          />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 md:grid-cols-4">
          <StatTile label="Carryover" value={env.carryoverCents} />
          <StatTile label="Allocation" value={env.allocationCents} />
          <StatTile label="Total" value={env.totalCents} />
          <StatTile label="Left" value={env.leftCents} tone={leftTone} />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Manually adjust the carried starting balance (traceable as a reset event). */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <CarryoverAdjuster
          envelopeId={env.id}
          currentCarryoverCents={isIncome && detail.income ? detail.income.carryoverCents : env.carryoverCents}
        />
      </div>

      <h2 className="mt-3 border-t pt-4 text-sm font-semibold text-muted-foreground">Envelope overview</h2>
      {/* Shared period selector (named periods + custom range with Today and
          Rolling/Calendar 3m/6m/12m quick options) driving the figures, the trend
          chart, and the transactions list below. */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <span className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">Period</span>
        <PeriodSelector
          value={periodSel}
          onChange={setPeriodSel}
          customFrom={customFrom}
          customTo={customTo}
          onCustomFrom={setCustomFrom}
          onCustomTo={setCustomTo}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Period-driven figures (track the dropdown): income shows carryover/received/
          target/variance; expense/saving/envelope shows carryover/allocation/total/left. */}
      {isIncome && periodIncome ? (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 md:grid-cols-4">
          <StatTile label="Carryover" value={periodIncome.carryoverCents} />
          <StatTile label="Received" value={periodIncome.receivedCents} />
          <StatTile label="Target" value={periodIncome.targetCents} />
          <StatTile label="Variance" value={periodIncome.varianceCents} tone={tone(periodIncome.varianceCents)} />
        </div>
      ) : periodRow ? (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 md:grid-cols-4">
          <StatTile label="Carryover" value={periodRow.carryoverCents} />
          <StatTile label="Allocation" value={periodRow.allocationCents} />
          <StatTile label="Total" value={periodRow.totalCents} />
          <StatTile label="Left" value={periodRow.leftCents} tone={tone(periodRow.leftCents)} />
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {/* Monthly Trends chart vs the budget/target line (GAP-A) */}
      {trend && (
        <React.Suspense fallback={<div className="h-[320px] rounded-lg border bg-card animate-pulse" />}>
          <EnvelopeTrendChart trend={trend} mode={isIncome ? "income" : "spend"} />
        </React.Suspense>
      )}

      <div>
        <h2 className="mb-2 text-sm font-semibold text-muted-foreground">Transactions</h2>
        <div className="rounded-lg border bg-card divide-y divide-border/40">
          {txns.length === 0 && (
            <div className="px-4 py-8 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">No transactions in this period.</div>
          )}
          {txns.map((t) => (
            <div key={t.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-3">
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="truncate text-sm font-medium">{t.payee}</span>
                  {t.isPending && (
                    <Badge variant="outline" className="gap-1 text-[10px]">
                      <Clock className="h-3 w-3" /> Pending
                    </Badge>
                  )}
                  {t.isTransfer && <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px]">Transfer</Badge>}
                </div>
                <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t.date}</div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-right">
                <div className={cn("tnum text-sm font-medium", t.amountCents < 0 ? "" : "text-success")}>
                  {formatCents(t.amountCents, { sign: true })}
                </div>
                {/* Envelope balance immediately after this transaction (running balance). */}
                <div className="tnum text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                  bal {formatCents(t.balanceAfterCents)}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          Pending transactions show here but do not decrement the balance. Posted spend decrements on its transaction date.
        </p>
      </div>

      <MoveMoneyModal
        open={moveOpen}
        onOpenChange={setMoveOpen}
        rows={grid?.rows ?? []}
        defaultToId={env.id}
      />
      <AddBudgetModal
        open={editOpen}
        onOpenChange={setEditOpen}
        rows={grid?.rows ?? []}
        editTarget={editTarget}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { X } from "lucide-react";
import { call, isApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import { useInvalidateBudget } from "@/lib/queries";
import { resolveCarryoverCents } from "@/lib/carryover";
import { cn, formatCents } from "@/lib/utils";
import { useIsMobile } from "@/lib/useMediaQuery";
import { useDismissable } from "@/lib/useDismissable";
import { useAnchoredPosition } from "@/lib/useAnchoredPosition";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

/**
 * Cursor-anchored carryover adjustment. Clicking an envelope's Carryover figure on
 * the budget grid opens this at the pointer; saving posts to /api/envelopes/carryover,
 * which records a traceable carryover.reset event. Responsive: a floating popover on
 * desktop, a bottom sheet on touch. Closes on Escape and outside/backdrop click.
 */
export interface CarryoverAnchor {
  readonly envelopeId: string;
  readonly envelopeName: string;
  readonly currentCents: number;
  readonly x: number;
  readonly y: number;
}

export function CarryoverPopover({
  anchor,
  onClose,
}: {
  anchor: CarryoverAnchor;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const invalidateBudget = useInvalidateBudget();
  const isMobile = useIsMobile();
  const [mode, setMode] = React.useState<"set" | "add" | "subtract">("set");
  const [value, setValue] = React.useState<string>((anchor.currentCents / 100).toFixed(2));
  const [busy, setBusy] = React.useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  // Escape + outside-click dismissal and focus trap/restore (m2); the mobile
  // sheet opts out of outside-click and dismisses on its backdrop tap.
  const ref = useDismissable<HTMLDivElement>({ onClose, closeOnOutsideClick: !isMobile });
  const pos = useAnchoredPosition(ref, anchor, { enabled: !isMobile });

  // Set replaces the carryover; Add/Subtract apply a delta to the current value.
  // The endpoint always stores the resulting absolute value, so compute it here.
  const targetCents = resolveCarryoverCents(mode, anchor.currentCents, value);
  const switchMode = (m: "set" | "add" | "subtract") => {
    setMode(m);
    setValue(m === "set" ? (anchor.currentCents / 100).toFixed(2) : "");
  };

  const save = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await call("POST /api/envelopes/carryover", {
        envelopeId: anchor.envelopeId,
        carryoverCents: targetCents,
      });
      if (isApiError(res)) {
        setError(res.error);
        return;
      }
      invalidateBudget();
      onClose();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Could not save.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const body = (
    <div className="p-3">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="truncate text-sm font-semibold">{anchor.envelopeName}</div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Adjust carryover (logged as a reset)</div>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-label="Close"
          onClick={onClose}
          className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground"
        >
          <X className="h-4 w-4" />
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-2 inline-flex rounded-md border p-0.5 text-xs">
        {(["set", "add", "subtract"] as const).map((m) => (
          <button
            key={m}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => switchMode(m)}
            className={cn(
              "rounded px-2 py-1 capitalize transition-colors",
              mode === m ? "bg-primary text-primary-foreground" : "text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent",
            )}
          >
            {m}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
        <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground tnum">{mode === "subtract" ? "−$" : mode === "add" ? "+$" : "$"}</span>
        <Input
          type="number"
          step="0.01"
          className="h-9 w-28 tnum"
          value={value}
          autoFocus
          onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === "Enter") void save();
          }}
        />
        <Button size="sm" onClick={() => void save()} disabled={busy}>
          {busy ? "Saving…" : "Save"}
        </Button>
      </div>
      {mode !== "set" && (
        <div className="mt-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          {formatCents(anchor.currentCents)} → <span className="font-medium text-foreground tnum">{formatCents(targetCents)}</span>
        </div>
      )}
      {error && <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-destructive">{error}</div>}
    </div>
  );

  if (isMobile) {
    return createPortal(
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50">
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-foreground/40" onClick={onClose} aria-hidden="true" />
        <div
          ref={ref}
          role="dialog"
          aria-modal="true"
          aria-label={`Adjust carryover for ${anchor.envelopeName}`}
          className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 rounded-t-2xl border-t bg-popover text-popover-foreground shadow-2xl"
        >
          <div className="flex justify-center pt-2" aria-hidden="true">
            <span className="h-1.5 w-10 rounded-full bg-muted-foreground/30" />
          </div>
          {body}
        </div>
      </div>,
      document.body
    );
  }

  return createPortal(
    <div
      ref={ref}
      role="dialog"
      aria-label={`Adjust carryover for ${anchor.envelopeName}`}
      style={{ position: "fixed", left: pos.left, top: pos.top }}
      className="z-50 w-[min(18rem,calc(100vw-1rem))] rounded-lg border bg-popover text-popover-foreground shadow-lg"
    >
      {body}
    </div>,
    document.body
  );
}

/**
 * Live countdown of the idle session deadline (ISC-39). The indicator does not
 * just display the deadline — it acts on it: once the remaining time reaches
 * zero it locks the session and routes to sign-in, a backstop for the provider's
 * own timer (which a backgrounded/throttled tab can stall). The pill turns amber
 * inside the final two minutes so the impending lock is visible.
 */
function IdleIndicator() {
  const { idleExpiresAt, signOut } = useSession();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [now, setNow] = React.useState(Date.now());
  const locking = React.useRef(false);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const t = setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), 5_000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, []);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!idleExpiresAt) return;
    if (now >= idleExpiresAt && !locking.current) {

  React.useEffect(() => {

    if (idleExpiresAt) locking.current = false;

  const total = IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS / 60000;
  const soon = remaining <= 2 * 60_000;

 * Invalidation contract (Phase 2, M2): a mutation's success calls
 * `useInvalidateBudget`, and any component subscribed to a dependent query must
 * refetch. This is the mechanism that keeps the net-position banner fresh after a
 * money move without pushing the value into it. The API client is mocked so we
 * can count fetches of the ['net-position'] query.
 */
import * as React from "react";
import { describe, it, expect, mock } from "bun:test";
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import * as realApi from "@/lib/api";
import { TestQueryProvider } from "@/test/utils";

let netCalls = 0;

const call = mock(async (path: string) => {
  if (path === "GET /api/net-position") {
    netCalls += 1;
    return {
      ok: true,
      cashOnHandCents: 0,
      cardOwedCents: 0,
      totalLeftCents: 0,
      reconciledDeltaCents: 0,
      sectionLeftCents: { income: 0, saving: 0, expense: 0, envelope: 0, working: 0 },
    };
  }
  return {};
});

mock.module("@/lib/api", () => ({ ...realApi, call }));

const { useNetPosition, useInvalidateBudget } = await import("@/lib/queries");

function Harness() {
  const { data } = useNetPosition();
  const invalidateBudget = useInvalidateBudget();
  return (
    <div>
      <span data-testid="loaded">{data ? "yes" : "no"}</span>
      <button onClick={() => invalidateBudget()}>invalidate</button>
    </div>
  );
}

describe("useInvalidateBudget — dependent queries refetch on invalidation", () => {
  it("refetches ['net-position'] after a mutation invalidates the budget", async () => {
    netCalls = 0;
    render(
      <TestQueryProvider>
        <Harness />
      </TestQueryProvider>
    );

    // The subscribed net-position query fetches once on mount.
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByTestId("loaded")).toHaveTextContent("yes"));
    expect(netCalls).toBe(1);

    // Simulate a money move: invalidate the budget queries.
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "invalidate" }));

    // The banner's query re-reads from the server (fresh net position).
    await waitFor(() => expect(netCalls).toBe(2));
  });
});
